ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.Projectil:
-- Logical projectile only. Caller owns scheduling and cosmetic representation.
local Query=require(script.Parent.ShotQuery)
local Sim={} Sim.__index=Sim
function Sim.new(options)
 return setmetatable({options=options,position=options.origin,velocity=options.direction.Unit*options.speed,
  age=0,distance=0,hits=0,ignored=table.clone(options.ignore or {}),active=true},Sim)
end
function Sim:Cancel(reason) self.active=false self.reason=reason or "cancelled" end
function Sim:Step(dt)
 if not self.active or dt<=0 or dt~=dt or dt==math.huge then return end
 local o=self.options local remaining=math.min(dt,o.lifetime-self.age)
 -- Bounded curvature error; no elapsed time is thrown away at low FPS.
 while self.active and remaining>1e-7 do
  local h=math.min(remaining,1/120) remaining-=h
  local acceleration=o.acceleration or Vector3.zero
  local delta=self.velocity*h+acceleration*(h*h*.5)
  local length=math.min(delta.Magnitude,o.range-self.distance)
  if length>1e-7 then
   local result=Query.Trace({origin=self.position,direction=delta,range=length,shooter=o.shooter,ignore=self.ignored,
    radius=o.radius,initial=self.age==0,raycast=o.raycast,spherecast=o.spherecast,classify=o.classify,maxTargets=o.maxTargets,
    hitOffset=self.hits,distanceOffset=self.distance,penetrationLoss=o.penetrationLoss,
    onHit=function(hit,model,index,multiplier,distance)
     local accepted=not o.onHit or o.onHit(hit,model,index,multiplier,distance)
     if accepted then table.insert(self.ignored,model) end return accepted
    end})
   self.distance+=(result.endpoint-self.position).Magnitude self.position=result.endpoint self.hits=result.hits
   if result.reason~="range" then self.result=result self:Cancel(result.reason) end
  end
  self.velocity+=acceleration*h self.age+=h
  if self.distance>=o.range-1e-6 then self:Cancel("range") end
  if self.age>=o.lifetime-1e-7 then self:Cancel("lifetime") end
 end
 return self.result
end
return Sim
ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.AimAssist:
-- Device eligibility is independent of target selection and shot authority.
local Intent={TouchTimeout=.1}
function Intent.Resolve(c)
 if c.focused==false or c.blocked then return Vector2.zero end
 local look=c.look or Vector2.zero
 if look.X~=look.X or look.Y~=look.Y or math.abs(look.X)==math.huge or math.abs(look.Y)==math.huge then return Vector2.zero end
 if c.device=="touch" then
  local age=(c.now or 0)-(c.touchAt or -math.huge)
  if not c.touchOwned or age<0 or age>Intent.TouchTimeout then return Vector2.zero end
 elseif c.device~="gamepad" then return Vector2.zero end
 return look.Magnitude>1 and look.Unit or look
end
function Intent.TouchLook(previous,radians,dt,owned,age)
 if not owned or age<0 or age>Intent.TouchTimeout then return Vector2.zero end
 if radians.Magnitude==0 then return previous or Vector2.zero end
 local look=Vector2.new(-radians.X,-radians.Y)/(math.max(dt,.001)*2.4)
 return look.Magnitude>1 and look.Unit or look
end
return table.freeze(Intent)

ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ShotCosme:
-- Bounded reusable lines and one updater, disconnected when idle. No damage.
local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local Simulation=require(script.Parent.ProjectileSimulation)
local Cosmetics={} local pool={} local active={} local connection local created=0
local function line()
 local part=table.remove(pool)
 if part then return part end
 if created>=128 then return end
 created+=1 part=Instance.new("Part") part.Name="ShotTrace"
 part.Anchored=true part.CanCollide=false part.CanTouch=false part.CanQuery=false part.CastShadow=false
 part.Material=Enum.Material.Neon return part
end
local function release(entry)
 if entry.part then entry.part.Parent=nil table.insert(pool,entry.part) entry.part=nil end
 active[entry]=nil
end
local function draw(entry,start,finish)
 local delta=finish-start
 if not entry.part or delta.Magnitude<.001 then return end
 entry.part.Size=Vector3.new(entry.width,entry.width,delta.Magnitude)
 entry.part.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(start+delta*.5,finish)
end
local function update(dt)
 for entry in active do
  entry.age+=dt
  if entry.sim then
   local before=entry.sim.position entry.sim:Step(dt)
   draw(entry,before,entry.sim.position)
   if not entry.sim.active then release(entry) end
  else
   local delta=entry.endpoint-entry.origin local distance=delta.Magnitude
   local head=math.min(distance,entry.age*entry.speed) local tail=math.max(0,head-entry.length)
   if distance>.001 then draw(entry,entry.origin+delta.Unit*tail,entry.origin+delta.Unit*head) end
   if entry.age>=distance/entry.speed+.045 then release(entry) end
  end
 end
 if next(active)==nil and connection then connection:Disconnect() connection=nil end
end
local function start(entry,color)
 local part=line() if not part then return end
 entry.part=part entry.width=entry.width or .035 entry.age=0
 part.Color=color or Color3.fromRGB(255,220,140) part.Transparency=.12 part.Size=Vector3.new(.035,.035,.035)
 part.CFrame=CFrame.new(entry.origin) part.Parent=workspace active[entry]=true
 if not connection then connection=(Run:IsClient() and Run.RenderStepped or Run.Heartbeat):Connect(update) end
 return entry
end
function Cosmetics.Trace(origin,endpoint,color,visual)
 visual=visual or {} return start({origin=origin,endpoint=endpoint,speed=math.clamp(visual.Speed or 3000,1,20000),length=visual.Length or 18,width=visual.Width},color)
end
function Cosmetics.Cancel(entry)
 if entry and active[entry] then if entry.sim then entry.sim:Cancel() end release(entry) end
end
function Cosmetics.Correct(entry,endpoint)
 if entry and active[entry] then
  if entry.sim then entry.sim.position=endpoint entry.sim:Cancel("confirmed") else entry.endpoint=endpoint end
 end
end
function Cosmetics.Projectile(actor,id,origin,direction,options)
 local sim=Simulation.new({origin=origin,direction=direction,speed=options.speed,lifetime=options.lifetime,range=options.range,
  acceleration=options.acceleration,radius=options.radius,shooter=options.shooter or actor,
  classify=options.classify or function() return "block" end,maxTargets=options.maxTargets,penetrationLoss=options.penetrationLoss})
 return start({origin=origin,sim=sim,actor=actor,id=id,width=options.visual and options.visual.Width})
end
function Cosmetics.Finish(actor,id,endpoint)
 for entry in active do if entry.actor==actor and entry.id==id then Cosmetics.Correct(entry,endpoint) end end
end
function Cosmetics.Stats() local n=0 for _ in active do n+=1 end return {active=n,pooled=#pool,created=created,connected=connection~=nil} end
return Cosmetics
ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.IronSight:
-- Imported weapons use several names for native irons. Never match an added optic
-- or an integrated receiver/rail, even when their names contain "sight".
local Visibility={}
function Visibility.IsName(name)
 local n=name:lower():gsub('[^%w]','')
 if n:find('rail',1,true) or n:find('receiver',1,true) or n:find('scope',1,true) or n:find('optic',1,true) or n:find('laser',1,true) then return false end
 if n:match('^frontsight') or n:match('^rearsight') or n:match('^fliprearsight') or n:match('^frontiron') or n:match('^reariron') or n:match('^backiron') or n:match('^ironsight') or n:match('^rearglowsight') then return true end
 return n=='iron' or n=='sight' or n=='sights' or n=='sightbase' or n=='sightsbase' or n=='basesight' or n=='sightpart' or n=='sightparts' or n=='sightpost' or n=='ringsight' or n=='barrelsight' or n=='sightrib' or n=='sightend' or n=='sightmark' or n:match('^sightsaaaa')~=nil
end
function Visibility.IsSourcePart(part,root)
 local p=part
 while p do
  if p:GetAttribute('VisualAttachmentId') then return false end
  if p:GetAttribute('IronSightPart')==true or Visibility.IsName(p.Name) then return true end
  if p==root then break end p=p.Parent
 end
 return false
end
function Visibility.Apply(model,equipped)
 for _,p in model:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA('BasePart') and not p:GetAttribute('VisualAttachmentId') and p:GetAttribute('IronSightPart') then
  if p:GetAttribute('IronSightOriginalTransparency')==nil then p:SetAttribute('IronSightOriginalTransparency',p.Transparency) end
  p:SetAttribute('IronSightHidden',equipped==true)
  p.Transparency=equipped and 1 or p:GetAttribute('IronSightOriginalTransparency')
  for _,v in p:GetDescendants() do if v:IsA('Decal') or v:IsA('Texture') then
   if v:GetAttribute('IronSightOriginalTransparency')==nil then v:SetAttribute('IronSightOriginalTransparency',v.Transparency) end
   v.Transparency=equipped and 1 or v:GetAttribute('IronSightOriginalTransparency')
  end end
 end end
end
return Visibility
ReplicatedStorage.ControlPolicy:
-- Shared, deterministic control policy. No services: safe to exercise in isolation.
local Policy={}
local combat={"ctf","arena"}
local world={"ctf","arena","survivor","hacking","beast","waiting","hub","admin"}
Policy.Contexts={
 ScopeZoomIn=combat,ScopeZoomOut=combat,SniperZoom=combat,Fire=combat,Aim=combat,Sprint=combat,Perspective=combat,SwitchWeapon=combat,ShiftLock=combat,Shoulder=combat,
 Jump=combat,ReloadInteract={"ctf","arena","survivor","beast"},
 Menu={"ctf","arena","survivor","hacking","beast","waiting","hub","admin","menu"},
 KitMenu={"ctf"},VoteMenu={"ctf","arena"},Leave={"ctf","arena","survivor","hacking","beast","waiting"},
 AdminMode=world,AdminSpeedUp={"admin"},AdminSpeedDown={"admin"},AdminPreviousMap={"admin"},AdminNextMap={"admin"},AdminClean={"admin"},
 GetOutCrawl={"survivor"},GetOutAttack={"beast"},GetOutDrop={"beast"},GetOutCheck={"hacking"},GetOutHacker={"beast"},
 MenuPrevious={"menu"},MenuNext={"menu"},
}
function Policy.Context(s)
 if s.modal then return "menu" end
 if s.admin then return "admin" end
 if s.mode=="get_out" then
  if not s.alive or s.result and s.result~="active" then return "waiting" end
  if s.role=="beast" then return "beast" end
  if s.role=="survivor" then return s.hacking and "hacking" or "survivor" end
  return "waiting"
 end
 return s.mode
end
function Policy.Conflicts(a,b)
 local zoom={ScopeZoomIn=true,ScopeZoomOut=true}
 local contextual={KitMenu=true,VoteMenu=true,AdminSpeedUp=true,AdminSpeedDown=true}
 if zoom[a] and contextual[b] or zoom[b] and contextual[a] then return false end
 if a=="SniperZoom" and b=="Sprint" or a=="Sprint" and b=="SniperZoom" then return false end
 -- Zoom requires ADS in combat; admin mode is unavailable during a match.
 if a=="SniperZoom" and b=="AdminMode" or a=="AdminMode" and b=="SniperZoom" then return false end
 if a=="Slide" and b=="Leave" or a=="Leave" and b=="Slide" then return false end
 local first,second=Policy.Contexts[a],Policy.Contexts[b]
 if not first or not second then return true end
 for _,context in first do if table.find(second,context) then return true end end
 return false
end
function Policy.Available(action,s)
 if s.suspended then return false,"suspended" end
 if action=="Slide" and not s.sprinting then return false,"not-sprinting" end
 if action=="Leave" and s.sprinting and (s.mode=="ctf" or s.mode=="arena") then return false,"sprinting" end
 local context=Policy.Context(s)
 if not table.find(Policy.Contexts[action] or {},context) then return false,"context:"..tostring(context) end
 if action:match("^Admin") and not s.authorized then return false,"permission" end
 if action=="Menu" and s.modal and not s.settingsMenu then return false,"another-menu" end
 if action=="AdminMode" and (s.inMatch or s.mode=="arena" and s.arenaPlaying) and not s.admin then return false,"in-match" end
 if action=="GetOutCrawl" and s.victim~="Active" and s.victim~="Crawling" then return false,"victim" end
 if action=="GetOutDrop" and not s.dragging then return false,"no-victim" end
 if context=="ctf" or context=="arena" then
    if action~="Menu" and action~="KitMenu" and action~="VoteMenu" and action~="Leave" and action~="AdminMode" then
     if not s.alive or s.spectating or context=="ctf" and not s.inMatch and not s.practiceRange or context=="arena" and not s.arenaPlaying then return false,"inactive" end
  end
 end
 return true
end
function Policy.Resolve(actions,s)
 local winner
 for _,action in actions do
  if Policy.Available(action,s) and (not winner or Policy.Priority(action)>Policy.Priority(winner) or Policy.Priority(action)==Policy.Priority(winner) and action<winner) then winner=action end
 end
 return winner
end
function Policy.Priority(action)
 if action=="MenuPrevious" or action=="MenuNext" then return 800 end
 if action=="Menu" then return 700 end
 if action=="AdminMode" then return 600 end
 if action:match("^Admin") then return 500 end
 return 100
end
-- Shared keys are intentional. Runtime context/priority arbitrates them; rebinding
-- one action must never steal the key from another action.
function Policy.Plan(definitions,bindings,action,device,name)
 if not definitions.Actions[action] or not definitions:IsAllowed(device,name,action) then return nil,"invalid" end
 local plan=table.clone(bindings) plan[action]=name
 return plan
end
function Policy.Normalize(definitions,bindings,device)
 local result={}
 for action,data in definitions.Actions do
  local key=bindings[action]
  if not definitions:IsAllowed(device,key,action) then key=data[device] end
  if not definitions:IsAllowed(device,key,action) then return nil,"invalid-default:"..action end
  result[action]=key
 end
 return result
end
return Policy

ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponLoc:
-- Cosmetic carry/run pose. This never changes speed, cooldown or aim direction.
local Motion={} Motion.__index=Motion
function Motion.new() return setmetatable({phase=0,weight=0,side=0},Motion) end
function Motion:Reset() self.phase=0 self.weight=0 self.side=0 end
function Motion:Update(dt,velocity,grounded,sprinting,aiming,firing,amount)
 dt=math.clamp(dt,0,.05) amount=math.clamp(amount or 0,0,1)
 local speed=Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude
 local target=grounded and sprinting and speed>1 and not aiming and not firing and math.clamp(speed/25,0,1) or 0
 local alpha=1-math.exp(-dt*14) self.weight+=(target-self.weight)*alpha
 self.side+=(math.clamp(velocity.X/25,-1,1)-self.side)*alpha
 if speed>.6 and grounded then self.phase+=dt*(sprinting and 7 or 8)*math.clamp(speed/18,.25,1.4) end
 local w=self.weight*math.sqrt(amount) local wave=math.sin(self.phase) local step=math.cos(self.phase*2)
 local offset=Vector3.new(-.16*w+wave*.30*w,-.16*w+step*.075*w,.13*w)
 local rotation=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-18*w+step*2.5*w),math.rad(10*w),math.rad(-12*w+wave*7*w-self.side*2*amount))
 return CFrame.new(offset)*rotation,w,self.phase
end
return Motion

local crossgrounds=script.Parent:FindFirstChild("Crossgrounds")
if crossgrounds then
 game:GetService("Players").CharacterAutoLoads=false

  warn("Crossgrounds bootstrap: "..tostring(err))
 end
else
 -- Compatibility path for recovering the original CTF without the hub package.

 GameManager:Initialize()
 
 while true do
 	repeat
 		GameManager:RunIntermission()
 	until GameManager:GameReady()
 	
 	GameManager:StopIntermission()
 	GameManager:StartRound()	
 	
 	repeat
 		GameManager:Update()
 		wait()
 	until GameManager:RoundOver()
 	
 	GameManager:RoundCleanup()
 end
end

 x16={kind='magazine',angle=-13,travel=.82},Glock18={kind='magazine',angle=-13,travel=.82},Pistol={kind='magazine',angle=-13,travel=.82},

 magnum_357={kind='revolver'},Magnum={kind='revolver'},Luger={kind='toggle',angle=-15,travel=.87},ArenaPistol={kind='magazine',angle=-17,travel=.86},

local function smooth(a,b,t)
 local x=math.clamp((t-a)/(b-a),0,1)
 return x*x*x*(x*(x*6-15)+10)

local function pulse(a,b,c,d,t) return smooth(a,b,t)*(1-smooth(c,d,t)) end
function Motion.Profile(id) return profiles[id] end

  speedloader=CFrame.identity,breakAction=CFrame.identity,shell=CFrame.identity,tubeShell=CFrame.identity,hand=Vector3.zero,handRotation=CFrame.identity,active=active,
  visibility={Magazine=0,Speedloader=1}}
 if profile.kind=='revolver' then
  local opened=pulse(.10,.24,.79,.91,t)
  local eject=pulse(.26,.34,.39,.45,t)
  local load=pulse(.44,.53,.65,.73,t)

function Shot.Finite(v)

function Shot.Config(data)

 if (count or 1)>1 then
  local rng=Random.new(((seed or 1)+(id or 0)*7919)%2147483646+1)
  local angle=rng:NextNumber(0,math.pi*2)+(pellet-1)*2.3999632297

  return CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,direction.Unit):VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*radius,math.sin(angle)*radius,-1).Unit)
 end
 local rng=Random.new(((seed or 1)+(id or 0)*7919+(pellet or 1)*104729)%2147483646+1)
 return (CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,direction.Unit)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rng:NextNumber(-.5,.5)*(spread or 0)),math.rad(rng:NextNumber(-.5,.5)*(spread or 0)),0)).LookVector

-- AX-50 presentation prototype. No ammo, damage or fire-rate writes.
local Motion={}
Motion.Recoil={Push=.50,Pitch=4.1,Roll=.48,Spring=155,Damping=20}
local function smooth(a,b,t)
 local x=math.clamp((t-a)/(b-a),0,1) return x*x*(3-2*x)
end
function Motion.Bolt(elapsed,cooldown,reloading)
 local t=elapsed/math.clamp(cooldown or 1.5,.65,3)
 if reloading or t<0 or t>=.94 then return {active=0,weapon=CFrame.identity,bolt=CFrame.identity,hand=Vector3.zero} end
 local reach=smooth(.10,.23,t)*(1-smooth(.77,.94,t))
 local lift=smooth(.22,.32,t)*(1-smooth(.69,.79,t))
 local pull=smooth(.32,.46,t)*(1-smooth(.55,.69,t))
 return {active=reach,
  weapon=CFrame.new(.07*reach,-.09*reach,.09*reach)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-2*reach),0,math.rad(-7*reach)),
  bolt=CFrame.new(0,0,.43*pull)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-48*lift)),
  hand=Vector3.new(.20*reach,.40*reach+.12*lift,-.45*reach+.43*pull)}
end
function Motion.new()
 local self={position=Vector2.zero,velocity=Vector2.zero}
 function self:Reset() self.position=Vector2.zero self.velocity=Vector2.zero end
 function self:Kick(side,ads)
  local scale=ads and .78 or 1
  self.velocity+=Vector2.new((side or 1)*.055,.66)*scale
 end
 function self:Update(dt)
  -- Analytic underdamped spring: same recovery at 30, 60 and 120 FPS.
  local t=math.clamp(dt,0,.25) local decay,frequency=9,12
  local a=self.position local b=(self.velocity+a*decay)/frequency
  local c,s=math.cos(frequency*t),math.sin(frequency*t) local e=math.exp(-decay*t)
  self.position=(a*c+b*s)*e
  self.velocity=((b*frequency-a*decay)*c-(a*frequency+b*decay)*s)*e
  return self.position
 end
 return self
end
return Motion

-- Two-bone support pose for Motor6D and AvatarJointUpgrade rigs.
local Pose={}
local function rotateBone(startWorld,endWorld,startLocal,endLocal,normal)
 local localDir=endLocal-startLocal local worldDir=endWorld-startWorld
 if localDir.Magnitude<.001 or worldDir.Magnitude<.001 then return end
 local reference=math.abs(localDir.Unit.Y)>.95 and Vector3.xAxis or Vector3.yAxis
 local rotation=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,worldDir,normal).Rotation*CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,localDir,reference).Rotation:Inverse()
 return CFrame.new(startWorld)*rotation*CFrame.new(-startLocal)
end
local function setJoint(joint,partFrame,parentFrame)
 if joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
  joint.Transform=(parentFrame*joint.Attachment0.CFrame):ToObjectSpace(partFrame*joint.Attachment1.CFrame)
 else joint.Transform=(parentFrame*joint.C0):ToObjectSpace(partFrame*joint.C1) end
end
local function joint(part,name)
 local legacy
 for _,value in part:GetChildren() do
  if value.Name==name then
   if value:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then return value
   elseif value:IsA("Motor6D") then legacy=value end
  end
 end
 return legacy
end
function Pose.Chain(character,side)
 local torso=character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") local upper=character:FindFirstChild(side.."UpperArm") local lower=character:FindFirstChild(side.."LowerArm") local hand=character:FindFirstChild(side.."Hand")
 if not torso or not upper or not lower or not hand then return end
 local shoulder=joint(upper,side.."Shoulder") local elbow=joint(lower,side.."Elbow") local wrist=joint(hand,side.."Wrist")
 if not shoulder or not elbow or not wrist then return end
 for _,joint in {shoulder,elbow,wrist} do if not joint:IsA("Motor6D") and not joint:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then return end end
 local sa0=torso:FindFirstChild(side.."ShoulderRigAttachment") local sa1=upper:FindFirstChild(side.."ShoulderRigAttachment")
 local ea0=upper:FindFirstChild(side.."ElbowRigAttachment") local ea1=lower:FindFirstChild(side.."ElbowRigAttachment")
 local wa0=lower:FindFirstChild(side.."WristRigAttachment") local wa1=hand:FindFirstChild(side.."WristRigAttachment") local grip=hand:FindFirstChild(side.."GripAttachment")
 if not sa0 or not sa1 or not ea0 or not ea1 or not wa0 or not wa1 or not grip then return end
 return {torso=torso,shoulder=shoulder,elbow=elbow,wrist=wrist,sa0=sa0,sa1=sa1,ea0=ea0,ea1=ea1,wa0=wa0,wa1=wa1,grip=grip,side=side}
end
function Pose.Solve(c,target,worldFrame)
 local handCF=(worldFrame or target.WorldCFrame)*c.grip.CFrame:Inverse()
 local start=(c.torso.CFrame*c.sa0.CFrame).Position local finish=(handCF*c.wa1.CFrame).Position
 local l1=(c.ea0.Position-c.sa1.Position).Magnitude local l2=(c.wa0.Position-c.ea1.Position).Magnitude
 if l1<.002 or l2<.002 then return end
 local delta=finish-start if delta.Magnitude<.001 then return end
 local distance=math.clamp(delta.Magnitude,math.abs(l1-l2)+.001,l1+l2-.001)
 local dir=delta.Unit local pole=c.torso.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(c.side=="Left" and -1 or 1,-.7,.25))
 local bend=pole-dir*pole:Dot(dir) if bend.Magnitude<.001 then bend=c.torso.CFrame.RightVector end bend=bend.Unit
 local along=(l1*l1-l2*l2+distance*distance)/(2*distance)
 local height=math.sqrt(math.max(0,l1*l1-along*along))
 local elbowPos=start+dir*along+bend*height local wristPos=start+dir*distance
 local normal=dir:Cross(bend).Unit
 local upperCF=rotateBone(start,elbowPos,c.sa1.Position,c.ea0.Position,normal)
 local lowerCF=rotateBone(elbowPos,wristPos,c.ea1.Position,c.wa0.Position,normal)
 if not upperCF or not lowerCF then return end
 local desiredHand=CFrame.new(wristPos-finish)*handCF
 setJoint(c.shoulder,upperCF,c.torso.CFrame) setJoint(c.elbow,lowerCF,upperCF) setJoint(c.wrist,desiredHand,lowerCF)
end
return Pose

        local key = "legacy_" .. id
        Catalog.Weapons[key] = {
            id = key,
            name = data.Name,
            category = "LEGACY",

            status = "Playable",

            assetId = id,
            slots = {},

end

    table.insert(Catalog.Weapons.m4a1.slots,"magazine")
Catalog.Weapons.m4a1.mountPoints.magazine="M4MagazineWell"
return Catalog.Weapons[id]

function Catalog.List(slot)
    local out = {}
    for _, weapon in Catalog.Weapons do
        if not weapon.supersededBy and (
            (slot == "secondary" and weapon.category == "PISTOLS")
            or (slot == "melee" and weapon.category == "MELEE")
            or (slot == "primary" and weapon.category ~= "PISTOLS" and weapon.category ~= "MELEE")
        ) then
            table.insert(out, weapon)
        end
    end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b)
        return a.name < b.name
    end)
    return out
end

 return friction,tracking+centering,centering
end

-- Shared ray/sphere queries. Caller decides authority and damage.
local Ballistics={}
local Shot=require(script.Parent.ShotMath)
function Ballistics.ModelFromPart(part)
 local node=part
 while node and node~=workspace do
  if node:IsA("Model") and node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return node end
  node=node.Parent
 end
end
-- Hats and invisible rig roots are not damage hitboxes.
function Ballistics.IsBodyPart(part,model)
 if not part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Parent~=model then return false end
 if part.Name=="HumanoidRootPart" and (model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) then return false end
 return true
end
function Ballistics.Trace(options)
 local origin=options.origin local direction=options.direction
 if not Shot.Finite(origin) or not Shot.Finite(direction) or direction.Magnitude<.0001 then return {endpoint=origin,hits=0,reason="direction"} end
 local range=math.clamp(options.range,0,15000) local ray=direction.Unit*range
 local ignored={} if options.shooter then table.insert(ignored,options.shooter) end
 for _,value in options.ignore or {} do table.insert(ignored,value) end
 local params=RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 local limit=math.clamp(options.maxTargets or 1,1,8) local hits=options.hitOffset or 0
 local cast=options.raycast or function(o,d,filter)
  if (options.radius or 0)>0 then
   if options.initial and not options.spherecast then
    local overlap=OverlapParams.new() overlap.FilterType=filter.FilterType overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=filter.FilterDescendantsInstances
    for _,part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(o,options.radius,overlap) do
     local surface=part:GetClosestPointOnSurface(o) local offset=o-surface
     if offset.Magnitude<=options.radius then
      return {Instance=part,Position=o,Distance=0,Normal=offset.Magnitude>.0001 and offset.Unit or -d.Unit,Material=part.Material}
     end
    end
   end
   return (options.spherecast or function(a,r,b,p) return workspace:Spherecast(a,r,b,p) end)(o,options.radius,d,filter)
  end
  return workspace:Raycast(o,d,filter)
 end
 for _=1,64 do
  params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignored
  local result=cast(origin,ray,params)
  if not result then return {endpoint=origin+ray,hits=hits,reason="range"} end
  local model=Ballistics.ModelFromPart(result.Instance)
  local relation=model and options.classify(model) or "block"
  if model and not Ballistics.IsBodyPart(result.Instance,model) then table.insert(ignored,result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") or result.Instance)
  elseif relation=="ignore" then table.insert(ignored,model)
  elseif relation=="target" then
   local index=hits+1 local multiplier=(1-(options.penetrationLoss or 0))^(index-1)
   local accepted=not options.onHit or options.onHit(result,model,index,multiplier,(options.distanceOffset or 0)+(result.Position-origin).Magnitude)
   if not accepted then return {endpoint=result.Position,hits=hits,reason="protected",result=result} end
   hits=index
   if hits>=limit then return {endpoint=result.Position,hits=hits,reason="targets",result=result} end
   table.insert(ignored,model)
  else return {endpoint=result.Position,hits=hits,reason="wall",result=result} end

end
local function finite(v)

end
-- FP origins are constrained near the head and behind a cover check, never trusted blindly.
function Ballistics.ResolveOrigin(character,tool,aim,requested,classify,cast)

 local handle=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") local muzzle=handle and handle:FindFirstChild("Muzzle")
 local origin=muzzle and muzzle.WorldPosition or head.Position
 if (origin-head.Position).Magnitude>8 then origin=head.Position end
 if not finite(aim) then return end
 local aimDelta=aim-head.Position
 if finite(requested) and aimDelta.Magnitude>.05 then
  local offset=requested-head.Position local axial=offset:Dot(aimDelta.Unit)
  local radial=(offset-aimDelta.Unit*axial).Magnitude
  if offset.Magnitude<=6.5 and axial>=-1 and axial<=6 and radial<=2 then origin=requested end
 end

 if delta.Magnitude>.01 then
  local check=Ballistics.Trace({origin=head.Position,direction=delta,range=delta.Magnitude,shooter=character,raycast=cast,
   classify=function(model) return classify(model)=="ignore" and "ignore" or "block" end})
  if check.result then return origin,check.result end
 end
 return origin
end
return Ballistics

 local clean

 sequence=sequence or self:NextSequence()
 self.drafts[Drafts.Path(scope,key)]={sequence=sequence,value=clean,present=not inherit}

end

 local value=bucket and bucket[key] return value,value~=nil
end

 if value==nil then value=Definition.Rules[key].Default end

end

 local before={}
 for key in Definition.Rules do for _,scope in scopes do if Definition:Allows(key,scope) then
  local value,custom=self:Stored(key,scope) before[Drafts.Path(scope,key)]={value=value,custom=custom}
 end end end
 self.profile=Profile.Migrate(snapshot.profile) self.revision=snapshot.revision
 for path,sequence in snapshot.acks do
  if typeof(sequence)=="number" and sequence==sequence and sequence>0 and sequence<2147483648 and sequence%1==0 then
   self.sequence=math.max(self.sequence,sequence)
   local draft=self.drafts[path] if draft and sequence>=draft.sequence then self.drafts[path]=nil end
  end

 for key in Definition.Rules do for _,scope in scopes do if Definition:Allows(key,scope) then
  local old=before[Drafts.Path(scope,key)] local value,custom=self:Stored(key,scope)

 end end end

end

local Effects=require(script.Parent.AttachmentEffects)
local Root = script.Parent

local Catalog = require(Root.WeaponCatalog)
local Attachments = require(Root.AttachmentCatalog)
local Config = require(Root.WeaponVisualConfiguration)
local Kits = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.KitDefinitions)
local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Stats = {statsSchemaVersion = 1}
local cache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local numericFields = {
	Damage = true,
	MinDamage = true,
	Range = true,
	FalloffStart = true,
	FalloffEnd = true,
	ProjectileSpeed = true,
	AdsSpeedMultiplier = true,
	MovementSpeedMultiplier = true,
	Cooldown = true,
	Magazine = true,
	Reserve = true,
	ReloadTime = true,
	Spread = true,
}

local vectorFields = {
	CameraRecoilMin = true,
	CameraRecoilMax = true,
}

local function finite(value)
	return typeof(value) == "number"
		and value == value
		and math.abs(value) < 1000000
end

-- Calcula os atributos de uma arma com acessórios.
function Stats.Resolve(weaponId, configuration)
	local weapon = Catalog.Get(weaponId)
	local base = weapon and Kits.Weapons[weapon.combatId]

	if not base then
		return nil
	end

	local clean = Config.Validate(
		weaponId,
		configuration or {},
		true
	)

	if not clean then
		return nil
	end

	local data = table.clone(base)
	data.AdsSpeedMultiplier = data.AdsSpeedMultiplier or 1
	data.MovementSpeedMultiplier = data.MovementSpeedMultiplier or 1

	local selected={} local slots={}
 for key in clean do table.insert(slots,key) end table.sort(slots)
 for _,key in slots do table.insert(selected,Attachments[clean[key]]) end
 for _, attachment in selected do

		for field, factor in attachment.statMultipliers or {} do
			local value = data[field]

			if field == "VisualRecoil"
				and typeof(factor) == "table"
				and typeof(value) == "table" then
				local recoil = table.clone(value)
				for recoilField, recoilFactor in factor do
					if finite(recoilFactor)
						and recoilFactor > 0
						and finite(recoil[recoilField]) then
						recoil[recoilField] *= recoilFactor
					end
				end
				data.VisualRecoil = recoil

			elseif finite(factor) and factor > 0 then
				if numericFields[field] and finite(value) then
					data[field] = value * factor

				elseif vectorFields[field]
					and typeof(value) == "Vector2" then
					data[field] = value * factor
				end
			end
		end

 end
 for _,attachment in selected do
		for field, amount in attachment.statAdd or {} do
			local value = data[field]

			if numericFields[field]
				and finite(value)
				and finite(amount) then
				data[field] = value + amount
			end
		end
	end

 -- Exact capacity overrides are restricted to integer magazine capacities.
 for _,attachment in selected do
  for field,value in attachment.statOverrides or {} do
   if field~="Magazine" or not finite(value) or value%1~=0 or value<1 or value>200 then return nil end
   data.Magazine=value
  end
 end
	-- Proteções para valores utilizados no combate.
	data.Cooldown = math.max(0.03, data.Cooldown)
	data.Magazine = math.max(1, math.floor(data.Magazine + 0.5))
	data.Reserve = math.max(0, math.floor(data.Reserve + 0.5))
	data.ReloadTime = math.max(0.1, data.ReloadTime)
	data.Range = math.max(1, data.Range)
	data.Spread = math.max(0, data.Spread)
	data.Damage = math.max(0, data.Damage)

	if data.MinDamage then
		data.MinDamage = math.clamp(
			data.MinDamage, 0, data.Damage
		)
	end

	return data
end

-- Obtém os atributos da Tool real.
-- Também funciona com armas sem acessórios.
function Stats.ResolveTool(tool)
	if not tool then
		return nil
	end

	local id = tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId")
 if tool:GetAttribute("ArenaWeapon")==true then return Kits.Weapons[id] end
	local visualId = tool:GetAttribute("VisualWeaponId")
	local raw = tool:GetAttribute("VisualConfiguration") or ""

	local old = cache[tool]

	if old
		and old.id == id
		and old.visualId == visualId
		and old.raw == raw then
		return old.data
	end

	local data = Kits.Weapons[id]

	if data and typeof(visualId) == "string" then
		local weapon = Catalog.Get(visualId)

		if weapon and weapon.combatId == id then
			local ok, configuration = pcall(
				Http.JSONDecode, Http, raw
			)

			if ok and typeof(configuration) == "table" then
				data = Stats.Resolve(visualId, configuration) or data
			end
		end
	end

	cache[tool] = {
		id = id,
		visualId = visualId,
		raw = raw,
		data = data,
	}

	return data
end

local function visible(data)
	return {
		damage = data.Damage,
		range = data.Range,
		spreadDegrees = data.Spread,
		rpm = data.Cooldown and 60 / data.Cooldown,
		capacity = data.Magazine,
		reloadSeconds = data.ReloadTime,
  controlRollDegrees = data.VisualRecoil and data.VisualRecoil.Roll,
  movementMultiplier = data.MovementSpeedMultiplier or 1,
  adsMultiplier = data.AdsSpeedMultiplier or 1,
  falloffStart = data.FalloffStart,
  falloffEnd = data.FalloffEnd,
  projectileSpeed = data.ProjectileSpeed,
	}
end

-- Mantém compatibilidade com os menus existentes.
function Stats.Get(id, configuration)
	local weapon = Catalog.Get(id)
	local base = weapon and Kits.Weapons[weapon.combatId]

	if not base then
		return {
			statsSchemaVersion = 1,
			provisional = true,
			baseStats = {},
			attachmentStatIntent = {},
			effectiveGameplayStats = {},
		}
	end

	local effective = Stats.Resolve(id, configuration or {}) or base

	return {
		statsSchemaVersion = 1,
		provisional = true,
		baseStats = visible(base),
		attachmentStatIntent = {},
		effectiveGameplayStats = visible(effective),
		combatId = weapon.combatId,
	}
end

function Stats.Compare(current, candidate)
	local a = Stats.Get(current).baseStats
	local b = Stats.Get(candidate).baseStats
	local result = {}

	for key, value in b do

			and typeof(a[key]) == "number" then
			result[key] = {
				current = a[key],
				candidate = value,
				delta = value - a[key],
			}
		end
	end

	return result
end

-- Cosmetic weapon-only spring, independent from camera orientation and shot direction.
local Recoil={} Recoil.__index=Recoil
function Recoil.new() return setmetatable({push=0,pitch=0,roll=0,pushV=0,pitchV=0,rollV=0},Recoil) end
function Recoil:Reset() self.push=0 self.pitch=0 self.roll=0 self.pushV=0 self.pitchV=0 self.rollV=0 end
function Recoil:Kick(profile,side)
 self.pushV=math.min(self.pushV+(profile.Push or .1)*18,28)
 self.pitchV=math.min(self.pitchV+(profile.Pitch or 2)*18,220)
 self.rollV=math.clamp(self.rollV+(side or 1)*(profile.Roll or .4)*15,-40,40)
end
function Recoil:Update(dt,profile)
 local time=math.clamp(dt,0,.1) local spring=profile.Spring or 200 local damping=profile.Damping or 27
 while time>0 do
  local step=math.min(time,1/120) time-=step
  self.pushV+=(-spring*self.push-damping*self.pushV)*step
  self.pitchV+=(-spring*self.pitch-damping*self.pitchV)*step
  self.rollV+=(-spring*self.roll-damping*self.rollV)*step
  self.push=math.clamp(self.push+self.pushV*step,0,1)
  self.pitch=math.clamp(self.pitch+self.pitchV*step,0,10)
  self.roll=math.clamp(self.roll+self.rollV*step,-4,4)
 end
 return self.push,self.pitch,self.roll
end
return Recoil

local Burst={}
function Burst.Config(data,converted)
 local count=data.BurstCount
 if converted then count=3 end
 if not count then return end
 return {count=count,interval=data.BurstInterval or .1,pause=data.BurstPause or .28}
end
function Burst.Ready(state,now)
 return not state.nextAt or now+.025>=state.nextAt
end
function Burst.Commit(state,now,config)
 if state.last and now-state.last>.6 then state.count=0 end
 state.count=(state.count or 0)+1 state.last=now
 local scheduled=math.max(now,state.nextAt or now)
 if state.count>=config.count then state.count=0 state.nextAt=scheduled+config.pause else state.nextAt=scheduled+config.interval end
end
return Burst

-- Cosmetic camera translation/roll only. Does not modify aim direction or recoil.
local Motion={} Motion.__index=Motion
function Motion.new() return setmetatable({phase=0,offset=Vector3.zero,roll=0,pitch=0},Motion) end
function Motion:Reset() self.phase=0 self.offset=Vector3.zero self.roll=0 self.pitch=0 end
function Motion:Update(dt,localVelocity,grounded,sprinting,aiming,amount,turnRate)
 dt=math.clamp(dt,0,.05) amount=math.clamp(amount or 0,0,1)
 local speed=Vector3.new(localVelocity.X,0,localVelocity.Z).Magnitude
 local moving=grounded and speed>.6 local intensity=math.clamp(speed/(sprinting and 25 or 18),0,1)
 if moving then self.phase+=dt*(sprinting and 12 or 8)*math.max(.35,intensity) end
 local weight=moving and amount*intensity*(aiming and .22 or 1) or 0
 local amplitude=sprinting and .19 or .075
 local target=Vector3.new(math.sin(self.phase)*amplitude*.45,math.cos(self.phase*2)*amplitude,0)*weight
 local targetRoll=math.rad(math.clamp(-localVelocity.X/18,-1,1)*(sprinting and 3.8 or 2.2)+math.sin(self.phase)*(sprinting and .85 or .2)-math.clamp(turnRate or 0,-3,3)*.6)*weight
 local targetPitch=math.rad(math.cos(self.phase*2)*(sprinting and .75 or .15))*weight
 local alpha=1-math.exp(-dt*13)
 self.offset=self.offset:Lerp(target,alpha) self.roll+=(targetRoll-self.roll)*alpha self.pitch+=(targetPitch-self.pitch)*alpha
 return self.offset,self.roll,self.pitch
end
return Motion

-- Exact ray distance to a rounded OBB; used for rewound sphere shots, not expanded-box corners.
return function(origin,direction,range,cf,size,radius)
 local o=cf:PointToObjectSpace(origin) local d=cf:VectorToObjectSpace(direction.Unit)
 local half=size*.5 local axes={Vector3.xAxis,Vector3.yAxis,Vector3.zAxis}
 local breaks={0,range}
 for _,axis in axes do local v=d:Dot(axis)
  if math.abs(v)>1e-9 then for _,sign in {-1,1}do local t=(sign*half:Dot(axis)-o:Dot(axis))/v if t>0 and t<range then table.insert(breaks,t)end end end
 end
 table.sort(breaks)
 for i=1,#breaks-1 do
  local lo,hi=breaks[i],breaks[i+1] local mid=(lo+hi)*.5 local a,b,c=0,0,-radius*radius
  for _,axis in axes do
   local p,v,h=o:Dot(axis),d:Dot(axis),half:Dot(axis)
   local at=p+v*mid local q
   if at < -h then q=p+h elseif at>h then q=p-h end
   if q then a+=v*v b+=2*q*v c+=q*q end
  end
  local t
  if a*lo*lo+b*lo+c<=1e-8 then t=lo
  elseif a>1e-12 then local disc=b*b-4*a*c if disc>=0 then local root=(-b-math.sqrt(disc))/(2*a) if root>=lo-1e-7 and root<=hi+1e-7 then t=math.max(lo,root)end end end
  if t then
   local point=o+d*t local nearest=Vector3.new(math.clamp(point.X,-half.X,half.X),math.clamp(point.Y,-half.Y,half.Y),math.clamp(point.Z,-half.Z,half.Z))
   local normal=point-nearest
   return t,cf:VectorToWorldSpace(normal.Magnitude>1e-7 and normal.Unit or -d)
  end
 end
end

-- One authority for menus, saved configurations and server-side construction.
local Compatibility = {Version = 2}
local cache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = 'k'})

local function contains(list, value)
	return typeof(list) == "table" and table.find(list, value) ~= nil
end

function Compatibility.Check(weapon, attachment)
	if not weapon or not attachment then return false, "Registro desconhecido." end
	local platform = weapon.platform
	if contains(attachment.blockedWeapons, weapon.id)
		or platform and contains(attachment.blockedPlatforms, platform) then
		return false, "Bloqueado para esta arma."
	end
	if attachment.pendingAudit or attachment.status ~= "Available"
		or attachment.auditStatus ~= "Verified" then
		return false, "Montagem pendente de verificação."
	end
	if not contains(weapon.slots, attachment.slot) then
		return false, "A arma não possui este slot."
	end
	local mount = weapon.mountPoints and weapon.mountPoints[attachment.slot]
	if not mount or mount ~= attachment.mountType then
		return false, "Ponto de montagem incompatível."
	end
	local mode = attachment.compatibilityMode
	if mode == "SpecificWeapon" then
		if not contains(attachment.compatibleWeapons, weapon.id) then return false, "Incompatível com esta arma." end
	elseif mode == "SpecificPlatform" then
		if not platform or not contains(attachment.compatiblePlatforms, platform) then return false, "Plataforma incompatível." end
	elseif mode == "Universal" then
		-- A shared rail alone is not evidence that the geometry clears this weapon.
		if not contains(attachment.verifiedMountWeapons, weapon.id) then return false, "Encaixe não verificado." end
	else
		return false, "Compatibilidade desconhecida."
	end
	return true
end

function Compatibility.Invalidate()
	Compatibility.Version += 1
	table.clear(cache)
end

function Compatibility.ForSlot(weapon, catalog, slot)
	local record = cache[weapon]
	if not record or record.version ~= Compatibility.Version or record.catalog ~= catalog then
		record = {version = Compatibility.Version, catalog = catalog, slots = {}}
		cache[weapon] = record
	end
	if not record.slots[slot] then
		local entries = {}
		for _,attachment in catalog do
			if attachment.slot == slot then
				local available,reason = Compatibility.Check(weapon,attachment)
				table.insert(entries,{attachment=attachment,available=available,reason=reason})
			end
		end
		table.sort(entries,function(a,b) return a.attachment.name < b.attachment.name end)
		record.slots[slot] = entries
	end
	return record.slots[slot]
end

return Compatibility

  if enabled=="catalog" then return true,require(script.Parent.MapLibrary).PhotoCatalog() end
  if busy[player] or os.clock()-(rates[player] or -10)<.3 then return false,"Aguarde." end
  rates[player]=os.clock()
  if enabled=="preview" then
   if not sessions[player] then return false,"Ative a câmera livre primeiro." end
   local source,mode,id=require(script.Parent.MapLibrary).PhotoGet(mapId)
   if not source then return false,"Mapa indisponível." end
   local session=sessions[player]
   busy[player]=true
   local ok,result=pcall(function()
    clearTerrain(player)
    if previews[player] then dispose(previews[player]) previews[player]=nil end
    local preview=Instance.new("Model") preview.Name="AdminPhoto_"..player.UserId
    preview:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsAdminPhoto",true) preview:SetAttribute("MapId",mapId) preview.Parent=workspace previews[player]=preview
    local geometry=source.Geometry:Clone()
    local infrastructure=source:FindFirstChild("CTFInfrastructure")
    if infrastructure then infrastructure:Clone().Parent=geometry end
    local offset=Vector3.new(8192+session.slot*2048,512,0)
    for i,obj in geometry:GetDescendants() do
     if obj:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then obj:Destroy()
     elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then obj.CFrame+=offset obj.Anchored=true
     elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then obj.Playing=false end
     if i%500==0 then task.wait() end
    end
    publish(geometry,preview)
    if mode=="CTF" then
     local fallback=game.ServerStorage.CTFMaps:FindFirstChild("riverside")
     local terrainSource=source:FindFirstChild("TerrainData") and source or fallback
     local terrain=terrainSource and terrainSource:FindFirstChild("TerrainData")
     local origin=terrainSource and terrainSource:GetAttribute("TerrainOrigin")
     if terrain and terrain:IsA("TerrainRegion") and typeof(origin)=="Vector3" then
      local cell=origin+offset/4
      local minimum=Vector3.new(cell.X,cell.Y,cell.Z)*4
      local cells=terrain.SizeInCells
      terrainAreas[player]=Region3.new(minimum,minimum+Vector3.new(cells.X,cells.Y,cells.Z)*4):ExpandToGrid(4)
      workspace.Terrain:PasteRegion(terrain,Vector3int16.new(cell.X,cell.Y,cell.Z),true)
     end
    end
    if sessions[player]~=session then error("Sessão de captura encerrada.") end
    local cf,size=preview:GetBoundingBox()
    player:SetAttribute("AdminPhotoMap",mapId)player:SetAttribute("AdminPhotoLightingProfile",source:GetAttribute("LightingProfile")or mapId)
    return {name=source:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or mapId,focus=cf.Position,position=cf.Position+Vector3.new(.7,.8,1).Unit*math.max(size.X,size.Z,80)*1.1}
   end)
   busy[player]=nil
   if not ok then clearTerrain(player) if previews[player] then dispose(previews[player]) previews[player]=nil end warn(result) return false,"Falha ao preparar cópia para captura." end
   return true,result
  end
  if typeof(enabled)~="boolean" then return false,"Comando inválido." end
  if not enabled then stop(player) return true end
  if sessions[player] then return true end
  busy[player]=true
  local ok,result,message=pcall(function()
   if player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") then return false,"Aguarde a transição atual." end
   if coordinator.context:GetMode(player)~="hub" then
    coordinator:Command(player,{action="returnHub"})
    local deadline=os.clock()+15
    repeat
     if not player.Parent then return false,"Sessão encerrada." end
     if coordinator.context:GetMode(player)=="hub" and not player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") then break end
     task.wait(.1)
    until os.clock()>=deadline
   end
   if coordinator.context:GetMode(player)~="hub" or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") then return false,"Não foi possível sair da partida." end
   local queue=coordinator.queue:Get(player)
   if queue.state~="idle" then coordinator.queue:Clear(player) coordinator:Publish(player) end
   local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   if not root or player:GetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady")~=true then return false,"Aguarde o personagem ficar pronto." end
   local used={} for _,session in sessions do used[session.slot]=true end
   local slot=1 while used[slot] do slot+=1 end
   if slot>50 then return false,"Todas as áreas de captura estão ocupadas." end
   sessions[player]={root=root,anchored=root.Anchored,slot=slot}
   player:SetAttribute("AdminPhotoUnlimited",true)
   root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero root.Anchored=true
   player:SetAttribute("AdminFreecam",true)
   return true
  end)
  busy[player]=nil
  if not ok then stop(player) warn(result) return false,"Falha ao preparar câmera admin." end
  return result,message
 end

local Config=require(script.Parent.WeaponVisualConfiguration)
local Attachments=require(script.Parent.AttachmentCatalog)
local Effects={}
function Effects.Configuration(id,configuration)
 local clean,err=Config.Validate(id,configuration or {},true)
 if not clean then return nil,err end
 local suppressed=false local noise=1
 for _,attachmentId in clean do local a=Attachments[attachmentId] if a.suppressed then suppressed=true noise=math.min(noise,a.noiseMultiplier or 1) end end
 return {noise=noise,spread=clean.underbarrel=="foregrips_commando_foregrip" and .6 or 1,horizontal=clean.underbarrel=="foregrips_commando_foregrip" and .85 or 1,suppressed=suppressed}
end
-- Combat data is already resolved once by WeaponStats on both peers.
function Effects.Spread(data,tool) return data.Spread or 0 end
function Effects.Recoil(data,tool)
 local p=table.clone(data.VisualRecoil or {Push=.08,Roll=.4})
 return p
end
function Effects.Apply(tool,id,configuration)
 local m,err=Effects.Configuration(id,configuration) if not m then return nil,err end
 tool:SetAttribute("Suppressed",m.suppressed) tool:SetAttribute("ShotNoiseMultiplier",m.noise)
 tool:SetAttribute("AttachmentSpreadMultiplier",m.spread) tool:SetAttribute("AttachmentHorizontalMultiplier",m.horizontal)
 local sound=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") and tool.Handle:FindFirstChild("FireSound")
 if sound then
  local base=sound:GetAttribute("UnsuppressedVolume") or sound.Volume sound:SetAttribute("UnsuppressedVolume",base)
  sound.Volume=base*(m.suppressed and .6 or 1)
  local eq=sound:FindFirstChild("SuppressorEQ") if eq then eq:Destroy() end
  if m.suppressed then eq=Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect") eq.Name="SuppressorEQ" eq.HighGain=-20 eq.MidGain=-8 eq.LowGain=-3 eq.Parent=sound end
 end
 return tool
end
return Effects

local Definition=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ExperienceSettings)
local Profile={}
function Profile.New() return {Version=2,ControlBindingVersion=1,Global={},Modes={ctf={},arena={}},Devices={Keyboard={},Gamepad={},Touch={}}} end
function Profile.Container(profile,scope)
 if scope=="Global" then return profile.Global end
 local kind,id=scope:match("^(%w+):(%w+)$")
 if kind=="Mode" then return typeof(profile.Modes)=="table" and profile.Modes[id] elseif kind=="Device" then return typeof(profile.Devices)=="table" and profile.Devices[id] end
end
function Profile.Resolve(profile,key,mode)
 local rule=Definition.Rules[key] if not rule then return end
 local value=profile.Global[key] local source=value~=nil and "Global" or "Default"
 if value==nil then value=rule.Default end
 if rule.ModeOverride and profile.Modes[mode] and profile.Modes[mode][key]~=nil then value=profile.Modes[mode][key] source="Mode:"..mode end
 if rule.PreferenceDevice and profile.Devices[rule.PreferenceDevice][key]~=nil then value=profile.Devices[rule.PreferenceDevice][key] source="Device:"..rule.PreferenceDevice end
 return value,source
end
function Profile.Set(profile,scope,key,value,inherit)
 if not Definition:Allows(key,scope) then return false end
 local container=Profile.Container(profile,scope) if not container then return false end
 if inherit then container[key]=nil return true end
 local clean=Definition:Sanitize(key,value) if clean==nil then return false end
 container[key]=clean return true
end
function Profile.Migrate(saved)
 local profile=Profile.New() if typeof(saved)~="table" then return profile end
 if saved.Version==nil then
  for key,value in saved do local rule=Definition.Rules[key] if rule then Profile.Set(profile,rule.PreferenceDevice and "Device:"..rule.PreferenceDevice or "Global",key,value) end end
 else
  for _,scope in {"Global","Mode:ctf","Mode:arena","Device:Keyboard","Device:Gamepad","Device:Touch"} do
   local container=Profile.Container(saved,scope)
   if typeof(container)=="table" then local count=0 for key,value in container do count+=1 if count>256 then break end if typeof(key)=="string" then Profile.Set(profile,scope,key,value) end end end
  end
 end
 -- Preserve legacy accent choices as the nearest free preset.
 local legacy=saved.Version==nil and saved or typeof(saved.Global)=='table' and saved.Global
 if legacy and legacy.ThemePreset==nil and typeof(legacy.AccentHue)=='number' and legacy.AccentHue==legacy.AccentHue and math.abs(legacy.AccentHue)<math.huge then
  Profile.Set(profile,'Global','ThemePreset',require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ThemeCatalog).NearestHue(legacy.AccentHue))
 end
 -- One-time recovery from the old collision normalizer. Later custom choices
 -- retain this marker and are preserved, including shared keys.
 if saved.ControlBindingVersion~=1 then Profile.Set(profile,'Device:Gamepad','BindSwitchWeaponGamepad',Definition.Rules.BindSwitchWeaponGamepad.Default) end
 return profile
end
return Profile

-- Locomotor state follows actual grounding/velocity; no fixed airborne timers.
local Motion={} Motion.__index=Motion
function Motion.new() return setmetatable({phase=0,slide=0,air=0,land=0,grounded=nil,minY=0},Motion) end
function Motion:Update(dt,velocity,grounded,sliding)
 dt=math.clamp(dt,0,.05)
 if self.grounded==false and grounded and self.minY< -5 then self.land=math.clamp((-self.minY-5)/45,.1,1) end

--!strict
local Library = require(script.Parent.MapLibrary)
local Manifest = require(script.Parent.GetOutManifest)
local Spawns = require(script.Parent.MapSpawns)
local SliceValidator = require(script.Parent.GetOutSliceValidator)
local Maps = {}
Maps.__index = Maps

function Maps.new()
    return setmetatable({ world = nil, manifest = nil, routeId = nil, mapId = nil }, Maps)
end

function Maps:Catalog(implemented)
    local out = {}
    for _, entry in Library.Catalog("GetOut") do
        local source = Library.Get("GetOut", entry.id)
        local manifest = source and Manifest.Read(source)
        if manifest and SliceValidator.Read(source,manifest) then
            for route in manifest.routes do
                if not implemented or implemented[route] then table.insert(out, entry) break end
            end
        end
    end
    return out
end

function Maps:Clear()
    if self.world then self.world:Destroy() end
    self.world = nil
    self.manifest = nil
    self.routeId = nil
    self.mapId = nil
    workspace:SetAttribute("GetOutMapId", nil)
end

function Maps:Load(id, selectionPolicy, implemented, canContinue)
    local source = Library.Get("GetOut", id)
    local sourceManifest, reason = Manifest.Read(source)
    if not sourceManifest then return false, reason end
    local valid,diagnostics=SliceValidator.Read(source,sourceManifest)
    if not valid then return false,table.concat(diagnostics,"; ") end
    local routeId, selectionReason = Manifest.Choose(sourceManifest, selectionPolicy, implemented)
    if not routeId then return false, selectionReason end
    self:Clear()
    local world = Instance.new("Model")
    world.Name = "CrossgroundsGetOutRound"
    world:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsOwned", true)
    world:SetAttribute("Sanitized", true)
    world.Parent = workspace
    self.world = world
    local geometry = Instance.new("Folder") geometry.Name = "Geometry" geometry.Parent = world
    for _, batch in source.Geometry:GetChildren() do
        if canContinue and not canContinue() then self:Clear() return false, "Carregamento interrompido." end
        batch:Clone().Parent = geometry
        task.wait()
    end
    sourceManifest.root:Clone().Parent = world
    local liveManifest, liveReason = Manifest.Read(world)
    if not liveManifest or not liveManifest.routes[routeId] then
        self:Clear() return false, liveReason or "Manifesto de rota inválido após a cópia."
    end
    if not Spawns.Validate(world, liveManifest.beastSpawn.CFrame) then
        self:Clear() return false, "Spawn da Besta bloqueado."
    end
    for _, spawn in liveManifest.survivorSpawns do
        if not Spawns.Validate(world, spawn.CFrame) then
            self:Clear() return false, "Spawn de sobrevivente bloqueado."
        end
    end
    self.manifest = liveManifest
    self.routeId = routeId
    self.mapId = id
    workspace:SetAttribute("GetOutMapId", id)
    return true, liveManifest, routeId, liveManifest.routes[routeId]
end

return Maps

 tokens=math.min(Config.PathsPerSecond,tokens+(now-stamp)*Config.PathsPerSecond) stamp=now
 while busy<Config.ConcurrentPaths and tokens>=1 and #queue>0 do
  local job=table.remove(queue,1) local self=job.nav
  if self.alive and job.generation==self.generation then
   busy+=1 tokens-=1 Navigation.Metrics.computations+=1 Navigation.Metrics.maxConcurrent=math.max(busy,Navigation.Metrics.maxConcurrent)
   task.spawn(function()
    local path=Pathfinding:CreatePath({AgentRadius=2.1,AgentHeight=5.5,AgentCanJump=true,AgentCanClimb=true,WaypointSpacing=4,Costs={Water=25}})
    local ok=pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(self.root.Position,job.goal) end)
    busy-=1
    if not self.alive or job.generation~=self.generation then path:Destroy() return end
    self.pending=false
    if ok and path.Status==Enum.PathStatus.Success then
     self:_clearRoute() self.route=path self.waypoints=path:GetWaypoints() self.index=2 self.failures=0 self.plannedAt=os.clock()
     self.blocked=path.Blocked:Connect(function(index) if self.alive and job.generation==self.generation and index>=self.index then self.replan=true self.reason="blocked" end end)
     if Run:IsStudio() and workspace:GetAttribute("BotDiagnosticsEnabled") then
      local debugFolder=Instance.new("Folder") debugFolder.Name="BotRoute" debugFolder.Parent=self.bot self.debugFolder=debugFolder
      for i=2,math.min(#self.waypoints,24) do
       local a,b=self.waypoints[i-1].Position,self.waypoints[i].Position local delta=b-a
       if delta.Magnitude>.1 then local p=Instance.new("Part") p.Name="Waypoint" p.Anchored=true p.CanCollide=false p.CanTouch=false p.CanQuery=false p.Size=Vector3.new(.07,.07,delta.Magnitude) p.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt((a+b)*.5,b) p.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,220,90) p.Material=Enum.Material.Neon p.Parent=debugFolder end
      end
     end
    else
     path:Destroy() self.failures+=1 Navigation.Metrics.failures+=1 self.nextPlan=os.clock()+math.min(5,self.failures*1.2)
     self.reason="no_path" self:_clearRoute()
     if self.failures>=3 then self:Abandon(os.clock()) end
    end
   end)
  end

end
function Navigation.new(bot)
 local self=setmetatable({bot=bot,root=bot.HumanoidRootPart,humanoid=bot.Humanoid,alive=true,generation=0,index=2,failures=0,nextPlan=0,plannedAt=0,lastMove=0,lastProgress=os.clock(),travel=0,recovery=0},Navigation)

end
function Navigation:_clearRoute()
 if self.blocked then self.blocked:Disconnect() self.blocked=nil end
 if self.route then self.route:Destroy() self.route=nil end
 if self.debugFolder then self.debugFolder:Destroy() self.debugFolder=nil end self.waypoints=nil self.command=nil
end
function Navigation:Clear(from,to)
 local delta=to-from
 if delta.Magnitude>18 or math.abs(delta.Y)>4 then return false end
 local params=RaycastParams.new() params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances={self.bot} params.RespectCanCollide=true

function Navigation:SetGoal(goal,now)
 if self.failedGoal and now<(self.failedUntil or 0) and (goal-self.failedGoal).Magnitude<12 then return false end
 if not self.goal or (self.goal-goal).Magnitude>10 then
  self.goal=goal self.generation+=1 self.pending=false self.replan=true self.nextPlan=math.max(now,self.nextPlan) self.reason="goal_changed"
  self:_clearRoute() self.lastProgress=now self.position=self.root.Position self.recovery=0
 end

end
function Navigation:Abandon(now)
 self.failedGoal=self.goal self.failedUntil=now+7 self.goal=nil self.generation+=1 self.pending=false self:_clearRoute()

end
function Navigation:Pause()
 self.goal=nil self.generation+=1 self.pending=false self:_clearRoute() self.humanoid:MoveTo(self.root.Position)
end
function Navigation.ReachedWaypoint(position,waypoint)
 local delta=position-waypoint
 -- Path waypoints are on the navmesh floor; HumanoidRootPart is above it.

end
function Navigation:Update(now)
 if not self.goal or not self.alive then return end
 local root,h=self.root,self.humanoid local distance=(root.Position-self.goal).Magnitude
 local progress=(root.Position-self.position).Magnitude self.travel+=progress self.position=root.Position
 local step=math.min(.5,now-self.updatedAt) self.updatedAt=now
 if progress<.1 then self.idleSeconds+=math.max(0,step) end
 if distance<3.5 then self.lastProgress=now self.recovery=0 h:Move(Vector3.zero) self.command=nil return end
 if (root.Position-self.progressPosition).Magnitude>1.2 then self.lastProgress=now self.recovery=0 self.progressPosition=root.Position end
 if now-self.lastProgress>2.5 then
  self.recovery+=1 self.stuckCount+=1 self.lastProgress=now Navigation.Metrics.stuck+=1 self.reason="recover_"..self.recovery
  if self.recovery==1 then
   local delta=self.goal-root.Position local side=Vector3.new(-delta.Z,0,delta.X)
   if side.Magnitude>.1 then local point=root.Position+side.Unit*3 if self:Clear(root.Position,point) then h:MoveTo(point) self.localUntil=now+.5 Navigation.Metrics.recoveries+=1 end end
  elseif self.recovery==2 then self.localUntil=now+.45 h:Move(Vector3.zero)
  elseif self.recovery<5 then self.replan=true self.nextPlan=now self:_clearRoute()
  else self:Abandon(now) return end
 end
 if now<(self.localUntil or 0) then return end
 if now>=(self.nextProbe or 0) then self.direct=self:Clear(root.Position,self.goal) self.nextProbe=now+.4 end
 if not self.direct and not self.pending and now>=self.nextPlan and (not self.waypoints or self.replan or now-self.plannedAt>6) then
  self.pending=true self.replan=false self.nextPlan=now+1.5 table.insert(queue,{nav=self,generation=self.generation,goal=self.goal})
 end
 local waypoint=self.waypoints and self.waypoints[self.index]
 if waypoint and Navigation.ReachedWaypoint(root.Position,waypoint.Position) then
  if waypoint.Action==Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then h.Jump=true end
  self.index+=1 waypoint=self.waypoints[self.index]
 end
 local destination=self.direct and self.goal or waypoint and waypoint.Position
 if not destination then h:Move(Vector3.zero) self.command=nil return end
 if waypoint and not self.direct and waypoint.Action==Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then h.Jump=true end
 if not self.command or (destination-self.command).Magnitude>1 or now-self.lastMove>2 then h:MoveTo(destination) self.command=destination self.lastMove=now end
end
function Navigation:Destroy()
 if not self.alive then return end self.alive=false self.generation+=1 self:_clearRoute()
 for i=#queue,1,-1 do if queue[i].nav==self then table.remove(queue,i) end end
end
function Navigation.Stats() local copy=table.clone(Navigation.Metrics) copy.queued=#queue copy.concurrent=busy return copy end

  local member=self.members[player]
  if not member or not self:IsPlaying(player) or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") then return end
  local h=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if not h or h.Health<=0 then return end
  if on==nil then on=not player:GetAttribute("SprintActive") end
  local active=on==true and member.stamina>=20
    local tool=player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") local data=tool and WeaponStats.ResolveTool(tool)
    player:SetAttribute("SprintActive",active) h.WalkSpeed=(active and Kits.Profiles.Regular.SprintSpeed or Kits.Profiles.Regular.WalkSpeed)*(data and data.MovementSpeedMultiplier or 1)
 end

  elapsed+=dt if elapsed<.1 then return end local step=elapsed elapsed=0
  for player,member in self.members do
   local h=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   if h and h.Health>0 then
    if self:IsPlaying(player) and player:GetAttribute("SprintActive") and h.MoveDirection.Magnitude>.05 then
     member.stamina=math.max(0,member.stamina-step*Sprint.DrainPerSecond) member.lastDrain=os.clock()
    if member.stamina<=0 then player:SetAttribute("SprintActive",false) h.WalkSpeed=Kits.Profiles.Regular.WalkSpeed end
    elseif os.clock()-member.lastDrain>=1 then member.stamina=math.min(100,member.stamina+step*15) end
    if self:IsPlaying(player) and player:GetAttribute("SlideActive")~=true then
    local tool=player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") local data=tool and WeaponStats.ResolveTool(tool)
    local baseSpeed=player:GetAttribute("SprintActive") and Kits.Profiles.Regular.SprintSpeed or Kits.Profiles.Regular.WalkSpeed
    h.WalkSpeed=baseSpeed*(data and data.MovementSpeedMultiplier or 1)
    end
    player:SetAttribute("Stamina",math.floor(member.stamina+.5))
    if self:IsPlaying(player) and player.Character:GetPivot().Position.Y<(self.maps.killPlaneY or 30) then h.Health=0 end
   end
  end
  if next(self.members) and not self.paused and self.endsAt>0 and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>=self.endsAt then
   if self.phase=="voting" then task.spawn(function() self:FinishVote() end)
   elseif self.phase=="playing" then self.phase="results" self.endsAt=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+Def.ResultsDuration for player in self.members do self:Spawn(player) end self:Publish()
   elseif self.phase=="results" then self:BeginVote() end
  end
 end))
end

-- Local admission requests only: no matchmaking, reservations or cross-server queue.
local Queue={}
Queue.__index=Queue
function Queue.new() return setmetatable({entries={},serial=0},Queue) end
function Queue:Get(player)
 local item=self.entries[player]
 return item and table.clone(item) or {state="idle",message="Escolha uma modalidade."}
end
function Queue:Join(player,gameId,variant)
 local current=self:Get(player)
 if current.state~="idle" and current.state~="failed" then return false,"Já existe uma solicitação em andamento." end
 self.serial+=1
 local item={state="joining",gameId=gameId,variant=variant,ticket=self.serial,message="Verificando a entrada no protótipo..."}
 self.entries[player]=item return true,table.clone(item)
end
function Queue:Ready(player,ticket,route)
 local current=self.entries[player]
 if not current or current.ticket~=ticket or current.state~="joining" then return false end
 current.state="ready" current.route=route current.message=route=="local" and "Entrada local disponível. Não é fila nem reserva entre servidores." or "Destino verificado. Confirme para viajar."
 return true
end
function Queue:Cancel(player,ticket)
 local current=self.entries[player]
 if not current or current.ticket~=ticket then return false,"Solicitação expirada." end
 if current.state~="joining" and current.state~="ready" then return false,"A entrada já começou; não foi cancelada." end
 self.entries[player]=nil return true
end
function Queue:Consume(player,ticket)
 local current=self.entries[player]
 if not current or current.ticket~=ticket or current.state~="ready" then return false,"A entrada ainda não está pronta ou expirou." end
 current.state="entering" current.message="Entrando na modalidade..."
 return true,table.clone(current)
end
function Queue:Travelling(player)
 local current=self.entries[player] if not current or current.state~="entering" then return false end
 current.state="travelling" current.message="Viagem solicitada. Aguardando o Roblox..." return true
end
function Queue:Fail(player,message,ticket)
 local current=self.entries[player]
 if ticket and (not current or current.ticket~=ticket) then return false end
 current=current or {} current.state="failed" current.message=message self.entries[player]=current return true
end
function Queue:Clear(player) self.entries[player]=nil end
function Queue:Destroy() table.clear(self.entries) end
return Queue

ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.Practic:
local Service={}
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage=game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local slots={} local used={} local targets={}
local pairsBySpawn={} local template local world local targetsFolder local started=false

local function buildPairs(model)
 local center=model:GetBoundingBox()
 local floors={}
 for _,part in model:GetDescendants() do
  if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide and part.Size.X>=8 and part.Size.Z>=8 and part.CFrame.UpVector.Y>.85 and part.Position.Y<center.Position.Y then
   local delta=part.Position-center.Position
   table.insert(floors,{part=part,distance=delta.X*delta.X+delta.Z*delta.Z})
  end
 end
 table.sort(floors,function(a,b)return a.distance<b.distance end)
 local reserved={} local pairs={}
 for _,entry in floors do
  if not reserved[entry.part] then
   local source=entry.part
   local best,bestScore
   for _,candidate in floors do
    local delta=candidate.part.Position-source.Position
    local flat=Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
    if candidate.part~=source and math.abs(flat.Magnitude-15)<1.5 and math.abs(delta.Y)<1 then
     local score=math.abs(flat.Magnitude-15)+math.abs(flat.X)*.02
     if not bestScore or score<bestScore then best=candidate.part bestScore=score end
    end
   end
   if best then
    local spawn=source.Position+Vector3.new(0,source.Size.Y*.5+3.5,0)
    local target=best.Position+Vector3.new(0,best.Size.Y*.5+3,0)
    table.insert(pairs,{spawn=CFrame.lookAt(spawn,target),target=CFrame.lookAt(target,spawn)})
    reserved[source]=true reserved[best]=true
   end
  end
 end
 return pairs
end

local function ensureWorld()
 if world and world.Parent then return true end
 if not template then return false end
 world=Instance.new("Folder") world.Name="CTFPracticeRange" world:SetAttribute("PracticeRangeWorld",true)
 local map=template:Clone() map.Name="Boot Camp" map.Parent=world
 targetsFolder=Instance.new("Folder") targetsFolder.Name="PassivePracticeBots" targetsFolder.Parent=world
 world.Parent=workspace
 return true
end

local function makeTarget(player,index)
 local source=ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("CTFBotTemplate")
 if not source then return nil end
 local target=source:Clone() target.Name="Practice Bot "..tostring(index)
 target:SetAttribute("PracticeDummy",true) target:SetAttribute("BotAlias","Bot de treino")
 target:SetAttribute("CTFBot",nil) target:SetAttribute("CTFTeam",nil)
 for _,item in target:GetDescendants() do
  if item:IsA("Tool") or item:IsA("BaseScript") then item:Destroy()
  elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then item.Anchored=true item.CanCollide=false item.CanTouch=false item.CanQuery=true end
 end
 local humanoid=target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not humanoid then target:Destroy() return nil end
 humanoid.DisplayName="BOT DE TREINO" humanoid.WalkSpeed=0 humanoid.AutoRotate=false humanoid.HealthDisplayType=Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
 humanoid.MaxHealth=200 humanoid.Health=200
 local root=target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if root then target.PrimaryPart=root end
 target:PivotTo(pairsBySpawn[index].target) target.Parent=targetsFolder
 return target
end

function Service:Start()
 if started then return self:Available() end
 started=true
 local folder=ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("CrossgroundsPracticeAssets") or Instance.new("Folder")
 folder.Name="CrossgroundsPracticeAssets" folder.Parent=ServerStorage
 template=folder:FindFirstChild("Boot Camp") or workspace:FindFirstChild("Boot Camp")
 if template and template.Parent==workspace then
  template:SetAttribute("PracticeRangeAsset",true)
  template.Parent=folder
 end
 if template then pairsBySpawn=buildPairs(template) end
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) self:Leave(player) end)
 return self:Available()
end

function Service:Available()
 return template~=nil and #pairsBySpawn>0 and ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("CTFBotTemplate")~=nil
end

function Service:Join(player)
 if not self:Available() then return false,"Boot Camp ou o bot de treino está indisponível." end
 if slots[player] then return true end
 if not ensureWorld() then return false,"Não foi possível carregar o Boot Camp." end
 local index
 for candidate=1,#pairsBySpawn do if not used[candidate] then index=candidate break end end
 if not index then return false,"O Practice Range está cheio." end
 local target=makeTarget(player,index)
 if not target then return false,"Não foi possível criar o bot de treino." end
 slots[player]=index used[index]=player targets[player]=target
 return true
end

function Service:IsActive(player)
 return slots[player]~=nil and player:GetAttribute("CTFPracticeRange")==true
end

function Service:PlaceCharacter(player,character)
 local index=slots[player]
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not index or not root then return false end
 character:PivotTo(pairsBySpawn[index].spawn)
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
 return true
end

function Service:Leave(player)
 local index=slots[player]
 slots[player]=nil
 if index then used[index]=nil end
 local target=targets[player] targets[player]=nil
 if target and target.Parent then target:Destroy() end
 player:SetAttribute("CTFPracticeRange",false)
 local any=false for _ in slots do any=true break end
 if not any and world then world:Destroy() world=nil targetsFolder=nil end
end

return Service

ServerScriptService.Realism Mod.Blood:
local playerService = game:GetService("Players")
local debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local folder

playerService.PlayerAdded:Connect(function (plr)
	
	if not workspace:FindFirstChild("Blood") then
		folder = Instance.new("Folder", workspace)
		folder.Name = "Blood"
	end
	
	local charFolder = Instance.new("Folder", folder)
	charFolder.Name = plr.Name
	
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function (char)	
		
		local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		
		humanoid.Died:Connect(function ()
			pcall(function ()
				
				local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or nil
				local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
				local base
				
				local function bloodPool (part, limbCenter)
					
					local pool = Instance.new("Part", charFolder)
					pool.CanCollide = false
					pool.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Crimson")
					pool.Material = Enum.Material.Sand
					pool.Transparency = .2
					pool.CastShadow = false
					pool.Shape = "Cylinder"
					pool.Anchored = true
					
					pool.Size = Vector3.new(.1, 0, 0)		
					pool.CFrame = part.CFrame	
					
					if limbCenter then
						pool.CFrame = CFrame.new(torso.Position.X + math.random(-4, 4), base.Position.Y - (base.Size.Y / 2) + math.random(0, .2), torso.Position.Z + math.random(-4, 4)) 
					else
						pool.CFrame = CFrame.new(torso.Position.X + math.random(-4, 4), base.Position.Y + (base.Size.Y / 2), torso.Position.Z + math.random(-4, 4)) 
					end
					
					pool.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 90)
					tweenService:Create(pool, TweenInfo.new(math.random(.4, 4), Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = Vector3.new(.1, math.random(3, 7), math.random(3, 7))}):Play()
					
					debris:AddItem(pool, 9)
				end
			
				if char.Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
					wait(.2)
					if not char:FindFirstChild("Head") and workspace:FindFirstChild(plr.Name .. "-2") then
						char = workspace[plr.Name .. "-2"]
					end
				end
					
				repeat wait() until math.floor(torso.Velocity.Magnitude) == 0
				local baseBlacklist = char:GetChildren()
				
				pcall(function ()
					for _,plr in pairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
						if plr.Character then
							for _,v in pairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
								if v:IsA("BasePart") then
									table.insert(baseBlacklist, v)
								elseif v:IsA("Accoutrement") then
									table.insert(baseBlacklist, v:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
								elseif v:IsA("Tool") then
                                    -- Ignore survivors equipment when locating the floor.
                                    table.insert(baseBlacklist, v)
								end
							end
						end
						if workspace:FindFirstChild(plr.Name .. "-2") then
							for _,p in pairs(workspace[plr.Name .. "-2"]:GetChildren()) do
								if p:IsA("BasePart") then
									table.insert(baseBlacklist, p)

-- Small utility selector. Inputs contain observations, never hidden target positions.
local Decision={}
function Decision.Choose(memory,resources,personality,objective,now,current,since)
 local seen=memory.visible and memory.target~=nil
 local scores={Objective=objective and (.65+personality.Objective+(objective.critical and .7 or 0)) or -1,
  Engage=seen and (.58+personality.Engage+(resources.distance<55 and .12 or 0)) or -1,
  Retreat=seen and ((1-resources.health)*.85+personality.Cover+(resources.ammo==0 and .35 or 0)-personality.Risk) or -1,
  Search=not seen and memory.position and memory.confidence>.1 and (.82+memory.confidence*.1+personality.Engage*.3) or -1,Patrol=.1}
 if resources.health<.18 and seen then scores.Retreat+=.6 end
 for key,value in scores do if value>=0 then scores[key]=math.clamp(value,0,1) end end
 if resources.reserve==0 and resources.ammo==0 then scores.Engage=-1 end
 local best,score="Patrol",scores.Patrol
 for _,key in {"Objective","Engage","Retreat","Search"} do if scores[key]>score then best=key score=scores[key] end end
 local critical=resources.health<.18 and seen or objective and objective.critical
 if not critical and current and (scores[current] or -1)>=0 and now-since<.85 then best=current
 elseif not critical and current and (scores[current] or -1)>=score-.12 then best=current end
 return best,scores,critical and "critical" or "utility"
end
return Decision
