function Coordinator.new(context,travel,preferences,remotes)
 return setmetatable({context=context,travel=travel,preferences=preferences,remotes=remotes,queue=Queue.new(),adapters={},errors={},connections={},playerConnections={},rates={},snapshotRates={},revisions={}},Coordinator)
end
function Coordinator:Register(adapter)
 assert(Catalog:Get(adapter.id) and not self.adapters[adapter.id],"Adaptador duplicado ou não registrado.")
 self.adapters[adapter.id]=adapter
 if adapter.Changed then table.insert(self.connections,adapter.Changed:Connect(function()
  for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do if self.context:GetMode(p)==adapter.id then self:Publish(p) end end
 end)) end
end
function Coordinator:Route(id)
 local definition=Catalog:Get(id)
 if id~="hub" and (not definition or definition.status=="planned") then return nil,"Modalidade em desenvolvimento; não possui entrada nem fila." end
 local adapter=self.adapters[id]
 return self.travel:Route(id,adapter and adapter:IsAvailable() or false)
end
function Coordinator:Snapshot(player)
 local list=Catalog:List()
 for _,definition in list do
  if definition.status~="planned" then
   local route,reason=self:Route(definition.id)
   definition.canEnter=route~=nil definition.route=route and route.kind or "unconfigured" definition.reason=reason
  else definition.canEnter=false definition.reason="Em desenvolvimento. Sem fila disponível." end
 end
 local mode=self.context:GetMode(player)
 local adapter=self.adapters[mode]
 return {version=Protocol.Version,revision=self.revisions[player] or 0,mode=mode,catalog=list,queue=self.queue:Get(player),session=adapter and adapter:Snapshot(player) or {state="hub"},error=self.errors[player],preferences=self.preferences:Describe(),prototype=self.travel.config.PlaceRole=="combinedPrototype"}
end
function Coordinator:Publish(player)
 if player.Parent then self.revisions[player]=(self.revisions[player] or 0)+1 self.remotes.State:FireClient(player,self:Snapshot(player)) end
end
function Coordinator:Error(player,message) self.errors[player]=message self:Publish(player) end
function Coordinator:CallAdapter(adapter,method,player)
 if not adapter or typeof(adapter[method])~="function" then return false,"Adaptador indisponível." end
 local ok,result,message=pcall(adapter[method],adapter,player)
 if not ok then warn("Crossgrounds adapter "..method..": "..tostring(result)) return false,"A modalidade não concluiu a transição. Tente novamente." end
 return result,message
end
function Coordinator:Command(player,command)
 local now=os.clock()
 local budget=self.rates[player]
 if not budget or now-budget.at>=1 then budget={at=now,count=0} self.rates[player]=budget end
 budget.count+=1 if budget.count>15 then if budget.count==16 then self:Error(player,"Muitas solicitações. Aguarde um instante.") end return end
 local valid,reason=Protocol:Validate(command) if not valid then self:Error(player,reason) return end
 self.errors[player]=nil
 local action=command.action
 if (action=="join"or action=="enter")and (workspace:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsBootReady")~=true or player:GetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady")~=true or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition"))then
  self:Error(player,"Aguarde o carregamento do lobby e do personagem.")return
 end
 if action=="join" then
  if self.context:GetMode(player)~="hub" then self:Error(player,"Volte ao Crossgrounds antes de escolher outra modalidade.") return end
  local definition=Catalog:Get(command.gameId)
  if not definition or definition.status=="planned" then self:Error(player,"Modalidade em desenvolvimento; não existe fila para ela.") return end
    local ok,item=self.queue:Join(player,command.gameId,command.variant)
  if not ok then self:Error(player,item) return end
  self:Publish(player)
  task.defer(function()
   local route,message=self:Route(item.gameId)
   if not player.Parent then return end
   if not route then self.queue:Fail(player,message,item.ticket)
   else self.queue:Ready(player,item.ticket,route.kind) end
   self:Publish(player)
  end)
 elseif action=="cancel" then
  local ok,message=self.queue:Cancel(player,command.ticket)
  if not ok then self:Error(player,message) return end
  self:Publish(player)
 elseif action=="dismiss" then
  local state=self.queue:Get(player).state
  if state=="failed" then self.queue:Clear(player) end
  self:Publish(player)
 elseif action=="enter" then
  if self.context:GetMode(player)~="hub" then self:Error(player,"Você já saiu do catálogo.") return end
  local ok,item=self.queue:Consume(player,command.ticket)
  if not ok then self:Error(player,item) return end
  self:Publish(player)
  task.spawn(function()
   local route,message=self:Route(item.gameId)
   if not player.Parent then return end
   if not route then self.queue:Fail(player,message,item.ticket) self:Publish(player) return end
   player:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition",true)
   if route.kind=="local" then
    local method=item.variant=="practice" and "EnterPractice" or "Enter"
    local entered,err=self:CallAdapter(self.adapters[item.gameId],method,player)
    if not player.Parent then return end
    player:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition",false)
    if entered then self.errors[player]=nil self.queue:Clear(player)
    else
     self:CallAdapter(self.adapters[item.gameId],"Leave",player)
     if not player.Parent then return end
     self.queue:Fail(player,err,item.ticket)
    end
   else
    self.queue:Travelling(player) self:Publish(player)
    local sent,err=self.travel:Begin(player,route,function(failure)
     if not player.Parent then return end
     player:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition",false) self.queue:Fail(player,failure,item.ticket) self:Publish(player)
    end)
    if not sent then player:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition",false) self.queue:Fail(player,err,item.ticket) end
   end
   self:Publish(player)
  end)
 elseif action=="returnHub" then
  local activeMode=self.context:GetMode(player)
  if activeMode=="hub" then self:Error(player,"Você já está no Crossgrounds.") return end
  local adapter=self.adapters[activeMode]
  if player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") then self:Error(player,"Aguarde a transição atual; nenhuma saída foi confirmada.") return end
  local route,message=self:Route("hub")
  if not player.Parent then return end
  if player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") then self:Error(player,"Aguarde a transição atual.") return end
  if not route then self:Error(player,message) return end
  self.queue:Clear(player) local _,ticket=self.queue:Join(player,"hub") self.queue:Ready(player,ticket.ticket,route.kind) self.queue:Consume(player,ticket.ticket)
  player:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition",true) self:Publish(player)
  task.spawn(function()
   if route.kind=="local" then
    local left,err=self:CallAdapter(adapter,"Leave",player)
    if not player.Parent then return end
    player:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition",false)
    if left then self.errors[player]=nil self.queue:Clear(player) else self.queue:Fail(player,err,ticket.ticket) end
   else
    self.queue:Travelling(player) self:Publish(player)
    local sent,err=self.travel:Begin(player,route,function(failure)
     if not player.Parent then return end
     player:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition",false) self.queue:Fail(player,failure,ticket.ticket) self:Publish(player)
    end)
    if not sent then player:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition",false) self.queue:Fail(player,err,ticket.ticket) end
   end
   self:Publish(player)
  end)
 end
end
function Coordinator:Start()

 local function added(player)

 if p.Character==s.character and s.humanoid.Parent and s.humanoid.Health>0 and playing(p) then
  local data=s.tool and WeaponStats.ResolveTool(s.tool)

end

 if on==false then self:Stop(p,"cancelled") return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now-(requests[p] or -100)<.12 then return false end requests[p]=now
 if active[p] then return false end

 local flat=Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,0,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)

 pcall(function() root:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)
 active[p]={character=c,humanoid=h,root=root,attachment=attachment,velocity=velocity,

 last[p]=now h.WalkSpeed=0

  if typeof(pitch)~="number" or pitch~=pitch or math.abs(pitch)>1.3 or typeof(aiming)~="boolean" then return end

  local c=p.Character local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

   elseif not playing(p) or p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")~=s.mode or blocked(p) then reason="context"

   end
  end
 end)

 if gameId=="arena" and self.config.PlaceRole=="combinedPrototype" and self.config.EnableLocalArenaPrototype and localAvailable then return {kind="local",gameId="arena"} end
 if gameId=="get_out" and self.config.PlaceRole=="combinedPrototype" and self.config.EnableLocalGetOutPrototype and localAvailable then return {kind="local",gameId="get_out"} end
 if gameId=="hub" and self.config.PlaceRole=="combinedPrototype" then return {kind="local",gameId="hub"} end
 local destination=gameId=="ctf" and self.config.CTFPlaceId or gameId=="arena" and self.config.ArenaPlaceId or gameId=="hub" and self.config.HubPlaceId

 if not ok then return nil,reason end

end

-- Recover inventory without replacing valid tools, health, ammo or the current loadout.
local Service={}

local Kits=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.KitDefinitions)
local Factory=require(game.ServerScriptService.MainGameScript.GameManager.WeaponFactory)

	game.ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.ArsenalLoadouts
)

local Visuals = require(
	game.ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.ImportedWeaponVisuals
)
local states={}
function Service.Expected(player)
	local mode = player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") or "ctf"

	if mode == "arena" then
		return Kits.ArenaWeapons
	end

	if mode == "ctf" then
		local custom = Arsenal.Backends(player)
		if custom then return custom end

		local profile = Kits.Profiles[player:GetAttribute("SelectedKit") or "Regular"]

		return profile and profile.Weapons

end
function Service.Ensure(player)
 local c=player.Character local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") local bag=player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
 local state=states[player]
 if not state or state.repairing or not h or h.Health<=0 or not bag or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") or player:GetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady")~=true then return end
 local ids=Service.Expected(player) if not ids then return end
 state.repairing=true
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local found={}
  for _,container in {c,bag} do for _,tool in container:GetChildren() do
   local id=tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId")
   if id and table.find(ids,id) then
    if not tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then tool:Destroy()
    else
	 found[id] = tool
	 local data = Stats.ResolveTool(tool) or Kits.Weapons[id]
     if tool:GetAttribute("WeaponKind")==nil then tool:SetAttribute("WeaponKind",data.Kind) end
     if data.Kind=="Gun" and tool:GetAttribute("Ammo")==nil then tool:SetAttribute("Ammo",data.Magazine) tool:SetAttribute("ReserveAmmo",data.Reserve) end
    end
   end
  end end
  local repaired=0
		for index, id in ids do
			if not found[id] then
				local tool = Factory:Create(
					id,
					player:GetAttribute("ArenaPistolVisual")
				)

				-- Restaura modelos e acessórios do loadout CTF.
				local active = Arsenal.Resolve(player)

				if player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") == "ctf"
					and active
					and (index == 2 or index == 3) then

					local visualId = index == 2
						and active.primaryWeaponId
						or active.secondaryWeaponId

					local configuration = index == 2
						and active.primaryAttachments
						or active.secondaryAttachments

					Visuals.Apply(tool, visualId, configuration)
				end

				local data = Stats.ResolveTool(tool) or Kits.Weapons[id]

				tool:SetAttribute(
					"ArenaWeapon",
					player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") == "arena"
				)

				if data.Kind == "Gun" then
					tool:SetAttribute("Ammo", data.Magazine)
					tool:SetAttribute("ReserveAmmo", data.Reserve)
					tool:SetAttribute("Reloading", false)
				end

				tool:SetAttribute("RecoveredEquipment", true)
				tool.Parent = bag
				found[id] = tool
				repaired += 1
			end
		end
  local held=c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  if not held then
   local chosen=state.lastEquipped and found[state.lastEquipped]
   if not chosen then for _,id in ids do if Kits.Weapons[id].Kind=="Gun" then chosen=found[id] break end end end
   chosen=chosen or found[ids[1]]
   if chosen and player.Character==c then h:EquipTool(chosen) end
  end
  if repaired>0 then player:SetAttribute("EquipmentRecoveries",(player:GetAttribute("EquipmentRecoveries") or 0)+repaired) end
 end)
 state.repairing=false
 if not ok then warn("Equipment recovery: "..tostring(err)) end
end
local function schedule(player)
 local state=states[player] if not state or state.pending then return end state.pending=true
 task.delay(.35,function() if states[player]~=state then return end state.pending=false if player.Parent then Service.Ensure(player) end end)
end
function Service:Start()
 if self.started then return end self.started=true
 local function added(p)
  if states[p] then return end
  local state={connections={}} states[p]=state
  local function watch(c)
   if state.characterConnections then for _,v in state.characterConnections do v:Disconnect() end end
   state.characterConnections={
    c.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(t) if t:IsA("Tool") then schedule(p) end end),
    c.ChildAdded:Connect(function(t) if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("WeaponId") then state.lastEquipped=t:GetAttribute("WeaponId") end end),
   }
   schedule(p)
  end
  table.insert(state.connections,p.CharacterAdded:Connect(watch))
  table.insert(state.connections,p:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ModeCharacterReady"):Connect(function() schedule(p) end))
  task.spawn(function()
   local bag=p:WaitForChild("Backpack",15)
   if bag and states[p]==state then table.insert(state.connections,bag.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(t) if t:IsA("Tool") then schedule(p) end end)) end
  end)
  if p.Character then watch(p.Character) end
 end
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(added)
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
  local s=states[p] if not s then return end
  for _,c in s.connections do c:Disconnect() end for _,c in s.characterConnections or {} do c:Disconnect() end states[p]=nil
 end)
 for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do added(p) end
 local elapsed=0 Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) elapsed+=dt if elapsed<1 then return end elapsed=0 for p in states do Service.Ensure(p) end end)
end
return Service

end

end

   if data then
    for i=1,math.min(Config.MaxLoadouts,math.max(5,type(data.presets)=='table' and #data.presets or 0)) do local valid=Config.Loadout(type(data.presets)=="table" and data.presets[i]) r.presets[i]=valid or Config.Default(i) end

   model.Name="Preview_"..Http:GenerateGUID(false) model.Parent=cache return true,model.Name

function Gameplay:Pod(marker)
 local p=self.dragged local r=actor(p) local br=actor(self.adapter.beast) local s=p and self.states[p]
 if not p or not r or not br or not s or s.kind~="Dragged" or marker:GetAttribute("OccupantUserId") or marker:GetAttribute("PodState")=="Consumed" or (br.Position-marker.Position).Magnitude>9 or (r.Position-marker.Position).Magnitude>13 or not self:Visible(br.Position,marker.Position,{p.Character,self.adapter.beast.Character}) then return false end
 self:Drop() self:SetState(p,"Captured") s=self.states[p] s.pod=marker
 marker:SetAttribute("OccupantUserId",p.UserId) marker:SetAttribute("PodState","Occupied")
 self.adapter.pods[p]={marker=marker}
 r.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero r.Anchored=true p.Character:PivotTo(marker.CFrame)
 p:SetAttribute("GetOutPodState",true) sound(marker,.8) return true
end
function Gameplay:Rescue(marker,rescuer)
 if not self:CanAct(rescuer) or rescuer==self.adapter.beast then return false,"rescuer_not_active" end
 local target for p,s in self.states do if s.pod==marker and s.kind=="Captured" then target=p break end end
 if not target then return false,"pod_empty" end
 local r=actor(target) if not r then return false,"victim_character_missing" end
 local exit=marker:FindFirstChild("RescueExit") local cf=exit and exit.WorldCFrame or marker.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,-6)
 local params=OverlapParams.new() params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances={target.Character,rescuer.Character,marker} params.RespectCanCollide=true
 local blockers=workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf,Vector3.new(2.5,5,2.5),params)
 if #blockers>0 then return false,"rescue_exit_blocked:"..blockers[1]:GetFullName() end
 self.states[target].pod=nil self.adapter.pods[target]=nil marker:SetAttribute("OccupantUserId",nil) marker:SetAttribute("PodState","Available")
 r.Anchored=false r.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero target.Character:PivotTo(cf)
 self:SetState(target,"Active") target:SetAttribute("GetOutPodState",false)
 if not T.CumulativeFreeze then self.states[target].freeze=0 end
 sound(marker,1.2) return true
end
function Gameplay:StartHack(p,id,slot)
 local terminal=self.terminals[id]
 if not terminal or not self:CanAct(p) or p==self.adapter.beast or terminal.completed or now()<terminal.errorUntil then return end
 local r=actor(p) if not r or (r.Position-slot.WorldPosition).Magnitude>4.5 then return end
 for _,job in terminal.users do if job.slot==slot then return end end
 self:CancelHack(p)
 local job={terminal=terminal,id=id,slot=slot,nextCheck=now()+T.CheckInterval,sequence=0}
 terminal.users[p]=job self.jobs[p]=job p:SetAttribute("GetOutHacking",true)
end
function Gameplay:FailHack(p,job)
 local t=job.terminal t.errorUntil=now()+T.ErrorSeconds t.marker.Color=Color3.fromRGB(214,65,65)
 sound(t.marker,.6)
 local a=self.adapter if a.beast and a.beast.Parent then a.feedbackRemote:FireClient(a.beast,"HackError",t.marker.Position) end
 self:CancelHack(p)
end
function Gameplay:Check(p,sequence)
 local job=self.jobs[p] if not job or not job.checkAt or sequence~=job.sequence then return end
 if now()<job.checkAt or now()>job.checkAt+T.CheckWindow then self:FailHack(p,job) return end
 job.checkAt=nil job.nextCheck=now()+T.CheckInterval sound(job.terminal.marker,1.2)
end
function Gameplay:DoorClear(door)
 local params=OverlapParams.new() params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude params.FilterDescendantsInstances={self.adapter.maps.world}
 for _,p in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(door.closed,door.part.Size+Vector3.new(6,0,2),params) do
  if p.CanCollide or p:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") and p:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"):FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return false end
 end return true
end
function Gameplay:ToggleDoor(door)
 if door.busy or not self:DoorClear(door) then return false end
 door.busy=true local opening=not door.open
 door.marker:SetAttribute("DoorState",opening and "Opening" or "Closing")
 door.part.CanCollide=false
 door.blocker.CanCollide=true
 local target=opening and door.hinge*CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/2,0)*door.offset or door.closed
 door.tween=Tween:Create(door.part,TweenInfo.new(T.DoorCloseSeconds),{CFrame=target}) sound(door.part)
 door.tween:Play()
 task.spawn(function()
  local state=door.tween.Completed:Wait()
  if not door.part.Parent or state~=Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then return end
  door.open=opening door.busy=false door.part.CanCollide=not opening door.blocker.CanCollide=false
  door.marker:SetAttribute("DoorState",opening and "Open" or "Closed")
  for _,p in door.prompts do p.ActionText=opening and "Fechar porta" or "Abrir porta" end
 end)
 return true
end
function Gameplay:Build()
 local a=self.adapter local data=a.maps.manifest.routes.locks
 for id,marker in data.computers do
  local t={marker=marker,progress=0,errorUntil=0,users={},completed=false} self.terminals[id]=t
  for _,slot in marker:GetChildren() do if slot:IsA("Attachment") and slot.Name:match("^HackSlot") then
   local prompt=a:Prompt(marker,"Hackear terminal",.2,"survivor",function(p) self:StartHack(p,id,slot) end)
   prompt.Parent=slot prompt.MaxActivationDistance=4
  end end
 end
 for _,marker in data.pods do
  marker:SetAttribute("PodState","Available")
  a:Prompt(marker,"Aprisionar vítima",.6,"beast",function() if self:Pod(marker) then a:Publish() end end)
  a:Prompt(marker,"Resgatar aliado",T.RescueSeconds,"survivor",function(p) if self:Rescue(marker,p) then a:Publish() end end)
 end
 local traversal=a.maps.manifest.root:FindFirstChild("Traversal")
 for _,marker in traversal and traversal:GetChildren() or {} do
  if marker:GetAttribute("Kind")=="Window"then table.insert(self.windows,marker)end
  if marker:GetAttribute("Kind")=="RegularDoor" then
   local part for _,v in a.maps.world.Geometry:GetDescendants() do if v:GetAttribute("RegularDoorId")==marker:GetAttribute("DoorId") then part=v break end end
   if part then
    local hinge=marker:GetAttribute("Hinge") local blocker=part:Clone() blocker.Name="DoorSafetyBlocker" blocker.Transparency=1 blocker.CanCollide=false blocker.Parent=part.Parent blocker:SetAttribute("RegularDoorId",nil)
    local door={part=part,closed=part.CFrame,hinge=hinge,offset=hinge:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame),marker=marker,prompts={},blocker=blocker}
    table.insert(self.doors,door) marker:SetAttribute("DoorState","Closed")
    for _,role in {"survivor","beast"} do table.insert(door.prompts,a:Prompt(marker,"Abrir porta",role=="beast" and T.DoorSecondsBeast or T.DoorSecondsSurvivor,role,function() self:ToggleDoor(door) end)) end
   end
  end
 end
end
function Gameplay:Attach(p)
 local r=actor(p) if not r then return end
 local prompt=self.adapter:Prompt(r,"Prender corda",.4,"beast",function() if self:Leash(p) then self.adapter:Publish() end end)
 prompt.Name="GetOutCapture" prompt.MaxActivationDistance=T.LeashRange
end
function Gameplay:Crawl(p,held)
 local s=self.states[p]if not s then return end
 s.crawlHeld=held==true
 if not self:CanAct(p)or p==self.adapter.beast then return end
 local kind=held and "Crawling"or"Standing"
 if self.traversal:Set(p,kind)then
  self:CancelHack(p)s.kind=kind=="Standing"and"Active"or kind p:SetAttribute("GetOutVictimState",s.kind)
 end
end
function Gameplay:Action(p,action,value)
 if not self:Active(p) then return end
 if action=="Attack" then self:Attack(p)
 elseif action=="CrawlMove" and self.states[p] and self.states[p].kind=="Crawling" then self.traversal:Move(p,value)
 elseif action=="Drop" and p==self.adapter.beast then self:Drop()
 elseif action=="Check" and typeof(value)=="number" then self:Check(p,value)
 elseif action=="CancelHack" then self:CancelHack(p)
 elseif action=="Crawl"and typeof(value)=="boolean"then self:Crawl(p,value)
 end
end
function Gameplay:Snapshot(p)
 local s=self.states[p] local job=self.jobs[p]
 return {victim=s and s.kind,freeze=s and s.freeze or 0,freezePaused=s and s.paused,dragging=p==self.adapter.beast and self.dragged and self.dragged.DisplayName or nil,
  hack=job and {progress=job.terminal.progress,checkAt=job.checkAt,checkEnd=job.checkAt and job.checkAt+T.CheckWindow,sequence=job.sequence} or nil}
end
function Gameplay:Tick(dt)
 local a=self.adapter local time=now()
 for p,job in self.jobs do
  local r=actor(p)
  if not self:CanAct(p) or not r or (r.Position-job.slot.WorldPosition).Magnitude>4.5 then self:CancelHack(p)
  elseif job.checkAt and time>job.checkAt+T.CheckWindow then self:FailHack(p,job)
  elseif not job.checkAt and time>=job.nextCheck then job.sequence+=1 job.checkAt=time+T.CheckLead end
 end
 for id,t in self.terminals do
  if not t.completed and time>=t.errorUntil then
   local users=0 local participant
   for p in t.users do users+=1 participant=p end
   t.progress=math.min(1,t.progress+dt*users/T.HackSeconds)
   t.marker:SetAttribute("HackProgress",t.progress)
   t.marker.Color=Color3.fromRGB(59,136,173)
   if t.progress>=1 and participant and a.round:CompleteComputer(participant,id) then
    t.completed=true t.marker.Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,196,157) sound(t.marker,1.5)
    for _,prompt in t.marker:GetDescendants() do if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then prompt.Enabled=false end end
    local list={} for p in t.users do table.insert(list,p) end for _,p in list do self:CancelHack(p) end
    if a.round.exitReady then for _,lock in a.maps.manifest.routes.locks.locks do lock.Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,196,157) end for _,prompt in a.crankPrompts do prompt.Enabled=true end end
   end
  end
 end
 local br=actor(a.beast)
 for _,pod in a.maps.manifest.routes.locks.pods do
  local occupied=pod:GetAttribute("OccupantUserId")~=nil
  for _,prompt in pod:GetChildren() do if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
   prompt.Enabled=prompt:GetAttribute("GetOutRole")=="beast" and not occupied and pod:GetAttribute("PodState")~="Consumed" and self.dragged~=nil or prompt:GetAttribute("GetOutRole")=="survivor" and occupied
  end end
 end
 for p,s in self.states do
  local r=actor(p)
  local prompt=r and r:FindFirstChild("GetOutCapture") if prompt then prompt.Enabled=s.kind=="Downed" and not self.dragged end
  if s.kind=="Crawling"and not s.crawlHeld and self.traversal:CanStand(p)then self:Crawl(p,false)
  elseif s.kind=="Downed" and time>=(s.recoverAt or math.huge) then
   if not s.crawlHeld and self.traversal:CanStand(p)then self:SetState(p,"Active")else self:SetState(p,"Crawling")end
  elseif s.kind=="Dragged" then
   if r and br and not self:Visible(br.Position,r.Position,{p.Character,a.beast.Character}) then s.blockedFor=(s.blockedFor or 0)+dt else s.blockedFor=0 end
   if not r or not br or (r.Position-br.Position).Magnitude>T.DragBreakDistance or s.blockedFor>2 then self:Drop() end
  elseif s.kind=="Captured" and s.pod then
   s.paused=br~=nil and (br.Position-s.pod.Position).Magnitude<T.AntiCampRadius
   if not s.paused then s.freeze=math.min(1,(s.freeze or 0)+dt/T.PodSeconds) end
   p:SetAttribute("GetOutFreeze",s.freeze) p:SetAttribute("GetOutFreezePaused",s.paused)
   if s.freeze>=1 then
    local marker=s.pod s.pod=nil marker:SetAttribute("OccupantUserId",nil) marker:SetAttribute("PodState",T.PodReusable and "Available" or "Consumed")
    a.pods[p]=nil self:SetState(p,"Frozen") if r then r.Anchored=false p.Character:PivotTo(a:StagingPosition(p)) p.Character.Humanoid:MoveTo(r.Position) end
    a.round:Capture(p) p:SetAttribute("GetOutResult","captured") a:CheckRoundFinished()
   end
  end
 end
 local traversal=a.maps.manifest.root:FindFirstChild("Traversal")
 for _,marker in traversal and traversal:GetChildren() or {} do
  if marker:GetAttribute("Kind")=="HideSpot" then
   local occupant
   for p in a.members do
    local r=actor(p) local hidden=false
    if r and p~=a.beast and self:CanAct(p) and not occupant then
     local v=marker.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(r.Position) local half=marker.Size*.5
     hidden=math.abs(v.X)<half.X and math.abs(v.Y)<half.Y and math.abs(v.Z)<half.Z
     if hidden then occupant=p end
    end
    p:SetAttribute("GetOutHidden",hidden)
   end
   marker:SetAttribute("OccupantUserId",occupant and occupant.UserId or nil)
  end
 end
end
function Gameplay:Rollback()
 for id,t in self.terminals do if t.completed and not self.adapter.round.completedPCs[id] then
  t.completed=false t.progress=0 t.marker:SetAttribute("HackProgress",0)
  for _,prompt in t.marker:GetDescendants() do if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then prompt.Enabled=true end end
 end end
end
return Gameplay
ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.BotRunt:
local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local Profiles=require(script.Parent.BotProfiles)
local Navigation=require(script.Parent.BotNavigation)
local Perception=require(script.Parent.BotPerception)
local Decision=require(script.Parent.BotDecision)
local Combat=require(script.Parent.BotCombat)
local Objectives=require(script.Parent.CTFBotObjectives)
local Damage=require(game.ServerScriptService.MainGameScript.GameManager.DamageService)
local Runtime={} local agents={} local connection local accumulator=0 local vision=24 local visionAt=os.clock()
local metrics={ticks=0,cpu=0,decisions=0,vision=0,peakTick=0,activeSeconds=0,decisionDelay=0,started=os.clock()}
local function spendVision()
 if vision<1 then return false end vision-=1 metrics.vision+=1 return true
end
local function diagnose(agent,now)
 if not Run:IsStudio() or not workspace:GetAttribute("BotDiagnosticsEnabled") then return end
 local bot,memory,nav=agent.bot,agent.sensor.memory,agent.nav
 bot:SetAttribute("BotDecision",agent.state) bot:SetAttribute("BotDecisionAge",now-agent.since)
 bot:SetAttribute("BotDecisionReason",agent.reason) bot:SetAttribute("BotGoal",nav.goal)
 bot:SetAttribute("BotLastSeen",memory.position) bot:SetAttribute("BotLastHeard",memory.heard) bot:SetAttribute("BotConfidence",memory.confidence)
 bot:SetAttribute("BotLOS",memory.visible) bot:SetAttribute("BotTarget",memory.target and memory.target.Name)
 bot:SetAttribute("BotRouteReason",nav.reason) bot:SetAttribute("BotWaypoint",nav.index) bot:SetAttribute("BotTravel",nav.travel)
 bot:SetAttribute("BotWaypointPosition",nav.waypoints and nav.waypoints[nav.index] and nav.waypoints[nav.index].Position)
 bot:SetAttribute("BotMoveCommand",nav.command) bot:SetAttribute("BotPathPending",nav.pending==true)
 bot:SetAttribute("BotIdleSeconds",nav.idleSeconds) bot:SetAttribute("BotStuckCount",nav.stuckCount) bot:SetAttribute("BotTargetChanges",memory.changes or 0)
 bot:SetAttribute("BotFOV",140) bot:SetAttribute("BotWeapon",agent.combat.tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId")) bot:SetAttribute("BotReloading",agent.combat.tool:GetAttribute("Reloading"))
 bot:SetAttribute("BotRecovery",nav.recovery) bot:SetAttribute("BotFireReason",agent.combat.denied)
 bot:SetAttribute("BotShots",agent.combat.shots) bot:SetAttribute("BotHits",agent.combat.hits) bot:SetAttribute("BotFirstShotDelay",agent.combat.firstShotDelay)
 bot:SetAttribute("BotUtility",game.HttpService:JSONEncode(agent.scores or {}))
end
local function decide(agent,now)
 local memory=agent.sensor.memory local root=agent.bot.HumanoidRootPart local h=agent.bot.Humanoid
 local objective=agent.adapter:Objective(memory,now)
 local resources={health=h.Health/h.MaxHealth,ammo=agent.combat.tool:GetAttribute("Ammo") or 0,reserve=agent.combat.tool:GetAttribute("ReserveAmmo") or 0,distance=memory.position and (memory.position-root.Position).Magnitude or 1000}
 local state,scores,reason=Decision.Choose(memory,resources,agent.personality,objective,now,agent.state,agent.since)
 if state~=agent.state then agent.state=state agent.since=now end agent.scores=scores agent.reason=reason metrics.decisions+=1
 local destination,label
 if state=="Objective" and objective then destination=objective.position label=objective.label
 elseif state=="Search" then
  local offset=now-(memory.seenAt or memory.heardAt or now)>1 and Vector3.new(math.sin(now+agent.phase)*4,0,math.cos(now+agent.phase)*4) or Vector3.zero
  destination=memory.position and memory.position+offset label="Investigating"
 elseif state=="Retreat" and memory.position then
  destination=agent.adapter:Cover(memory.position)
  if not destination then local delta=root.Position-memory.position if delta.Magnitude>.01 then destination=root.Position+delta.Unit*10 end end label="TakingCover"
 elseif state=="Engage" and memory.position then
  local delta=memory.position-root.Position local preferred=agent.combat.data.Range>400 and 75 or agent.combat.data.Range>250 and 45 or 28
  if delta.Magnitude<preferred*.55 then destination=root.Position-delta.Unit*8
  elseif delta.Magnitude>preferred*1.4 then destination=memory.position
  else
   local side=Vector3.new(-delta.Z,0,delta.X)
   if side.Magnitude>.1 then destination=root.Position+side.Unit*math.sin(now*.7+agent.phase)*6 end
  end label="Engaging"
 else destination=objective and objective.position label="Patrol" end
 if destination then
  if not agent.nav:SetGoal(destination,now) then local alternate=agent.adapter:Alternate() if alternate then agent.nav:SetGoal(alternate,now) end label="Recovering" end
 elseif agent.nav.goal then agent.nav:Pause() end
 agent.bot:SetAttribute("CTFState",label or state) agent.bot:SetAttribute("CTFLane",agent.adapter.lane)
 agent.bot:SetAttribute("BotAlert",memory.visible or memory.confidence>.1)
end
local function tick(dt)
 local at=os.clock() local now=at
 metrics.activeSeconds+=dt
 vision=math.min(24,vision+(now-visionAt)*Profiles.Budget.VisionPerSecond) visionAt=now
 Navigation.Pump(now)
 for bot,agent in agents do
  if not bot.Parent or agent.h.Health<=0 or not agent.active() then Runtime:Stop(bot)
  else
   local ok,err=xpcall(function()
   if now>=agent.nextSense then
    local before=agent.sensor.memory.changes or 0 agent.sensor:Scan(now)
    metrics.targetChanges=(metrics.targetChanges or 0)+(agent.sensor.memory.changes or 0)-before
    agent.nextSense=now+agent.profile.Scan+agent.rng:NextNumber(0,.05)
   end
   if now>=agent.nextDecision then metrics.decisionDelay+=now-agent.nextDecision decide(agent,now) agent.nextDecision=now+Profiles.Budget.DecisionInterval+agent.rng:NextNumber(0,.12) end
   agent.combat:Update(agent.sensor.memory,dt,now,agent.state=="Engage" or agent.state=="Retreat" or agent.state=="Objective")
   if now>=agent.nextMove then agent.flags:TryInteract(bot) agent.nav:Update(now) agent.nextMove=now+.1 end
   if agent.bot.HumanoidRootPart.Position.Y<15 then agent.h.Health=0 end
   if now>=agent.nextDebug then diagnose(agent,now) agent.nextDebug=now+.5 end
   end,debug.traceback)
   if not ok then metrics.errors=(metrics.errors or 0)+1 warn("BotRuntime: "..tostring(err)) Runtime:Stop(bot) end
  end
 end
 local elapsed=os.clock()-at metrics.ticks+=1 metrics.cpu+=elapsed metrics.peakTick=math.max(metrics.peakTick,elapsed)
 if next(agents)==nil and connection then connection:Disconnect() connection=nil end
end
function Runtime:Start(bot,team,slot,flags,active)
 self:Stop(bot)
 local difficulty=workspace:GetAttribute("BotDifficulty") or bot:GetAttribute("BotDifficulty") or Profiles.Default
 local rng=Random.new((bot:GetAttribute("CTFSlot") or slot)*97+math.floor(os.clock()*1000)%100000)
 local personalityName=bot:GetAttribute("BotPersonality") or Profiles.PersonalityOrder[rng:NextInteger(1,#Profiles.PersonalityOrder)]
 local profile,personality=Profiles.Resolve(difficulty,personalityName) local combat=Combat.new(bot,profile,rng) if not combat then return end
 local now=os.clock() local adapter=Objectives.new(bot,team,slot,flags)
 local role=bot:GetAttribute("CTFRole") bot.Humanoid.WalkSpeed=role=="Runner" and 21 or role=="Guardian" and 14 or 18 bot.Humanoid.UseJumpPower=false bot.Humanoid.JumpHeight=7.5
 bot:SetAttribute("BotDifficulty",difficulty) bot:SetAttribute("BotPersonality",personalityName) bot:SetAttribute("BotReaction",combat.reaction)
 local agent={bot=bot,h=bot.Humanoid,active=active,flags=flags,profile=profile,personality=personality,combat=combat,rng=rng,adapter=adapter,nav=Navigation.new(bot),state="Patrol",since=now,
  nextSense=now+slot*.05,nextDecision=now+slot*.06,nextMove=now,nextDebug=now,phase=rng:NextNumber(0,math.pi*2)}
 agent.sensor=Perception.new(bot,profile,function(model) return Damage:ShotRelation(bot,model) end,function() return adapter:Candidates() end,spendVision)
 agents[bot]=agent
 agent.dead=agent.h.Died:Connect(function() self:Stop(bot) end)
 agent.ancestry=bot.AncestryChanged:Connect(function() if not bot:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then self:Stop(bot) end end)
 if not connection then accumulator=0 connection=Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) accumulator+=dt if accumulator>=Profiles.Budget.Tick then local step=accumulator accumulator=0 tick(step) end end) end
 return agent
end
function Runtime:Stop(bot)
 local agent=agents[bot] if not agent then return end agents[bot]=nil
 agent.combat.alive=false agent.nav:Destroy() if agent.dead then agent.dead:Disconnect() end if agent.ancestry then agent.ancestry:Disconnect() end
 agent.h.AutoRotate=true
end
function Runtime:Snapshot()
 local count,shots,hits,idle=0,0,0,0 for _,agent in agents do count+=1 shots+=agent.combat.shots hits+=agent.combat.hits idle+=agent.nav.idleSeconds end
 local nav=Navigation.Stats()
 local bands={} for name,values in Combat.Metrics.bands do bands[name]=table.clone(values) end
 return {active=count,connected=connection~=nil,vision=metrics.vision,decisions=metrics.decisions,meanTickMs=metrics.cpu/math.max(1,metrics.ticks)*1000,peakTickMs=metrics.peakTick*1000,
  errors=metrics.errors or 0,decisionDelayMs=metrics.decisionDelay/math.max(1,metrics.decisions)*1000,activeSeconds=metrics.activeSeconds,pathsPerMinute=nav.computations*60/math.max(1,metrics.activeSeconds),
  targetChanges=metrics.targetChanges or 0,targetChangesPerMinute=(metrics.targetChanges or 0)*60/math.max(1,metrics.activeSeconds),activeIdleSeconds=idle,
  meanFirstShotDelay=Combat.Metrics.firstShotTotal/math.max(1,Combat.Metrics.firstShotCount),
  elapsed=os.clock()-metrics.started,shots=Combat.Metrics.shots,hits=Combat.Metrics.hits,activeShots=shots,activeHits=hits,bands=bands,navigation=nav}
end
workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BotDiagnosticsEnabled"):Connect(function()
 if not workspace:GetAttribute("BotDiagnosticsEnabled") then for _,agent in agents do
  if agent.nav.debugFolder then agent.nav.debugFolder:Destroy() agent.nav.debugFolder=nil end
 end end
end)
return Runtime
ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.Progres:
local Service = {}
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Balance = require(script.Parent.ProgressionBalance)
local Policy = require(script.Parent.ProgressionPolicy)
local store = not RunService:IsStudio() and game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("CrossgroundsProgression_v1") or nil
local fields = {"XP","Coins","Kills","Deaths","Captures","PlaySeconds","BotKills","TrainingKills"}
local Schema=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ProgressionSchema)
for _,key in Schema.Fields do if not table.find(fields,key) then table.insert(fields,key) end end
for _,mode in Schema.Modes do if mode~="general" then for _,key in Schema.Fields do table.insert(fields,Schema.Key(mode,key)) end end end
local Ranking=require(script.Parent.ProgressionRanking)
local savedFriends={}
local friendResults={}
local state = {}
local friendRate = {}
local function blank()
 local result = {}
 for _, key in fields do result[key] = 0 end
 return result
end
local function clean(source)
 local result = blank()
 if type(source) == "table" then
  for _, key in fields do
   local value = source[key]
   if type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 then result[key] = math.floor(math.min(value, 2^50)) end
  end
 end
 return result
end
local function level(xp)
 return math.floor((xp / 250) ^ (1 / 1.45)) + 1
end
local function publish(player, record)
 if not player.Parent then return end
 for _, key in fields do player:SetAttribute("Progress"..key, record.base[key] + record.pending[key]) end
 player:SetAttribute("ProgressLevel", level(record.base.XP + record.pending.XP))
 player:SetAttribute("ProgressionReady", record.loaded)
end
local function award(player, amounts, mode)
 local record = state[player]
 if not record then return end
 for key, value in pairs(amounts) do

-- Coordinates client geometry/floor readiness before starting a round.
local Service={}

local pending={}local sequence=0
function Service:Start(context)
 if self.started then return end self.started=true self.context=context
 local remotes=game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.Remotes
 local function remote(name)local r=remotes:FindFirstChild(name)or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")r.Name=name r.Parent=remotes return r end
 self.prepare=remote("PrepareScene")
 self.finished=remote("SceneLoadFinished")
 remote("SceneReady").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,token)
  local state=pending[player]
  if state and typeof(token)=="string"and state.token==token and context:GetMode(player)==state.mode then state.ready=true end
 end)
 local retryRates={}
 remote("RetryLoading").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
  if os.clock()-(retryRates[player]or-10)<3 then return end retryRates[player]=os.clock()
  if not workspace:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsBootReady") or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") then return end
  if context:GetMode(player)=="hub" then context:ReloadHubCharacter(player)
  elseif context:GetMode(player)=="ctf" and player:GetAttribute("InMatch") and workspace:GetAttribute("RoundState")=="LoadFailed" then
   workspace:SetAttribute("CTFLoadRetry",(workspace:GetAttribute("CTFLoadRetry") or 0)+1)
  end
 end)
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)pending[player]=nil retryRates[player]=nil end)
end
function Service:Wait(players,roots,anchors,canContinue,minSeconds,terrain)
 assert(self.started,"SceneLoadService não iniciado.")
 sequence+=1 local token="scene_"..sequence local descriptors={}local parts=0
 for index,root in roots do
  if not root:GetAttribute("ClientSceneRevision")then root:SetAttribute("ClientSceneRevision",token)root:SetAttribute("ClientSceneIndex",index)end
  local count=root:IsA("BasePart")and 1 or 0
  for i,obj in root:GetDescendants()do if obj:IsA("BasePart")then count+=1 end if i%1000==0 then task.wait()end end
  parts+=count table.insert(descriptors,{name=root.Name,revision=root:GetAttribute("ClientSceneRevision"),index=root:GetAttribute("ClientSceneIndex"),parts=count})
 end
 local payload={token=token,roots=descriptors,anchors=anchors or{},terrain=terrain==true,parts=parts}
 local states={}local started=os.clock()local deadline=started+30 local nextSend=0
 local function finish(ok,message)
  for player,state in states do if pending[player]==state then pending[player]=nil
   if player.Parent then
    player:SetAttribute("SceneLoading",false)player:SetAttribute("SceneLoadingError",self.context:GetMode(player)==state.mode and message or nil)
    self.finished:FireClient(player,token,ok,message)
   end
  end end
  return ok,message
 end
 while true do
  if canContinue and not canContinue()then return finish(false)end
  local current=typeof(players)=="function"and players()or players local allReady=true
  local present={}for _,player in current do present[player]=true end
  for player,state in states do if not present[player]then
   if pending[player]==state then pending[player]=nil if player.Parent then player:SetAttribute("SceneLoading",false)player:SetAttribute("SceneLoadingError",nil)self.finished:FireClient(player,token,false)end end
   states[player]=nil
  end end
  for _,player in current do if player.Parent then
   local state=states[player]
   if not state then state={token=token,ready=false,mode=self.context:GetMode(player)}states[player]=state pending[player]=state
    player:SetAttribute("SceneLoadingError",nil)player:SetAttribute("SceneLoading",true)
    self.prepare:FireClient(player,payload)
   end
   if not state.ready then allReady=false end
  end end
  if allReady and os.clock()-started>=(minSeconds or 0)then return finish(true)end
  if os.clock()>=deadline then return finish(false,"O mapa não ficou pronto. Tente carregar novamente ou volte ao lobby pelo menu.")end
  if os.clock()>=nextSend then nextSend=os.clock()+1 for _,player in current do local state=states[player]if player.Parent and state and not state.ready then self.prepare:FireClient(player,payload)end end end
  task.wait(.1)
 end
end

-- Replicated weapon mount; clients solve hand poses after the Animator.
local Rig={}
local Hold=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponHold)
local records=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}) local pending=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local started=false
function Rig:Clear(tool)
 local r=records[tool] if not r then return end records[tool]=nil
 for _,connection in r.connections do connection:Disconnect() end
 for _,object in r.owned do if object.Parent then object:Destroy() end end
 for _,joint in r.disabled do if joint.Parent then joint.Enabled=true end end
 tool:SetAttribute("SupportGripActive",false)
end
local function own(record,value) table.insert(record.owned,value) return value end
function Rig:Attach(tool)
 if records[tool] then return end
 local character=tool.Parent local h=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") local handle=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
 if not h or h.Health<=0 or not handle or not tool:GetAttribute("TwoHanded") then return end
 local support=handle:FindFirstChild("SupportGrip")
 -- A muzzle is a firing origin, not a hand target. Do not mutate attachments on equip.
 if not support then return end
 local torso=character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") if not torso then return end
 local r={owned={},connections={},disabled={}} records[tool]=r
 if h.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
  if handle:FindFirstChild("RightHandGrip") then
   for _,joint in character:GetDescendants() do if joint:IsA("JointInstance") and joint.Name=="RightGrip" and joint.Part1==handle then joint.Enabled=false table.insert(r.disabled,joint) end end
   local mount=own(r,Instance.new("Motor6D")) mount.Name="CrossgroundsWeaponMount" mount.Part0=torso mount.Part1=handle
   local base=Hold.Mount(tool)
   local rest=tool:GetAttribute("RestGrip") or tool.Grip
   local function updateMount() mount.C0=base*rest:ToObjectSpace(tool.Grip) end
   updateMount() mount.Parent=torso
   table.insert(r.connections,tool:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Grip"):Connect(updateMount))
  end
  local supported=character:FindFirstChild("LeftHand")~=nil
  tool:SetAttribute("SupportGripActive",supported)
 else
  -- R6 has no elbow. Keep the native right-hand joint and approximate support
  -- with a fixed-length left arm; do not stretch or detach the shoulder.
  local arm=character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
  local shoulder=torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder")
  if arm and shoulder and shoulder:IsA("Motor6D") then
   shoulder.Enabled=false table.insert(r.disabled,shoulder)
   local start=shoulder.C0.Position local target=torso.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(support.WorldPosition)
   local direction=target-start
   if direction.Magnitude>.05 then
    local position=start+direction.Unit*arm.Size.Y*.5
    local cf=CFrame.lookAt(position,position+direction.Unit)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
    local weld=own(r,Instance.new("Weld")) weld.Name="CrossgroundsR6Support" weld.Part0=torso weld.Part1=arm weld.C0=cf weld.Parent=torso
    tool:SetAttribute("SupportGripActive",true)
   end
  end
 end
 table.insert(r.connections,tool.Unequipped:Connect(function() self:Clear(tool) end))
 table.insert(r.connections,tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function() if tool.Parent~=character then self:Clear(tool) end end))
 table.insert(r.connections,h.Died:Once(function() self:Clear(tool) end))
end
function Rig:Queue(tool)
 if pending[tool] or records[tool] then return end pending[tool]=true
 task.delay(.08,function() pending[tool]=nil
  if tool.Parent and tool.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
   local ok,err=pcall(function() self:Attach(tool) end) if not ok then self:Clear(tool) warn("WeaponRig: "..tostring(err)) end
  end
 end)
end
function Rig:Start()
 if started then return end started=true
 local function added(value)
  if value:IsA("Tool") and value:GetAttribute("TwoHanded") then self:Queue(value)
  elseif value:IsA("JointInstance") and value.Name=="RightGrip" and value.Part1 then
   local tool=value.Part1.Parent if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then
    local record=records[tool] if record and tool.Handle:FindFirstChild("RightHandGrip") then value.Enabled=false table.insert(record.disabled,value) else self:Queue(tool) end
   end
  end
 end
 workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(added)
 for _,value in workspace:GetDescendants() do added(value) end
end

   if arena.phase=="loading" and table.find({"vote","map","restart"},action) then return false,"Aguarde o carregamento atual." end
   if action=="pause" and arena.phase=="playing" then

   elseif action=="resume" and arena.phase=="playing" then
    if arena.paused then arena.endsAt=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+(arena.remaining or 0) arena.paused=false arena.remaining=nil end
   elseif action=="time" and arena.phase=="playing" then
    if typeof(payload)~="number" or payload~=payload or math.abs(payload)==math.huge then return false,"Tempo inválido." end
    payload=math.clamp(payload,1,3600)

   else return false,"Esta ação requer uma rodada ativa." end
   arena:Publish() return true,"Arena atualizada."
  elseif mode=="ctf" and coordinator.adapters.ctf then
   if workspace:GetAttribute("RoundState")~="Playing" then return false,"Aguarde a rodada CTF começar." end
   local time=require(ctfRoot.TimeManager)
   if action=="pause" then time:SetPaused(true)
   elseif action=="resume" then time:SetPaused(false)
   elseif action=="time" and typeof(payload)=="number" and payload==payload and math.abs(payload)<math.huge then time:SetRemaining(math.clamp(payload,1,3600))
   elseif action=="vote" or action=="restart" then workspace:SetAttribute("DevelopmentEndCTF",true)

     end

   else return false,"Comando CTF inválido." end
   return true,"CTF atualizado."
  end

-- Limited hitbox history; never moves live characters or accepts a client hit.

local SharedQuery=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ShotQuery)
local Shot=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ShotMath)
local Run=game:GetService("RunService")

History.Window=.35
History.AlignmentWindow=.08
History.AlignmentError=.75
function History.Time(now,requested,ping)
 local transit=math.clamp(ping*.5,0,.15)
 local shot=math.clamp(requested,now-transit-.05,math.min(now,now-transit+.05))
 -- Include one snapshot of interpolation even on low-ping connections.
 return math.clamp(shot-math.clamp(transit+1/60,1/60,.16),now-History.Window,now)

-- Slab intersection against a server-captured oriented hitbox.
function History.Box(origin,direction,range,cf,size,radius)
 if (radius or 0)>0 then return require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.SweptSphereBox)(origin,direction,range,cf,size,radius) end

 for _,axis in {Vector3.xAxis,Vector3.yAxis,Vector3.zAxis} do
  local position=o:Dot(axis) local velocity=d:Dot(axis) local half=size:Dot(axis)*.5
  if math.abs(velocity)<1e-8 then if math.abs(position)>half then return end
  else
   local a,b=(-half-position)/velocity,(half-position)/velocity local n=-axis
   if a>b then a,b=b,a n=axis end
   if a>near then near=a normal=n end far=math.min(far,b)
   if near>far then return end
  end
 end
 return near,cf:VectorToWorldSpace(normal)
end
local function track(humanoid)
 local model=humanoid.Parent
 if model and model:IsA("Model") and not records[model] then records[model]={humanoid=humanoid,samples={}} end
end
local function poses(model)
 local parts={}
 for _,child in model:GetChildren() do
  if child:IsA("BasePart") and SharedQuery.IsBodyPart(child,model) and child.CanQuery then parts[child]={cf=child.CFrame,size=child.Size} end
 end
 return parts
end
local function capture(now)
 for model,record in records do
  if not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then records[model]=nil
  elseif record.humanoid.Health<=0 then table.clear(record.samples)
  else
   local parts=poses(model)
   local root=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("Head") or next(parts)
   if root then
    table.insert(record.samples,{time=now,parts=parts,position=root.Position})
    while #record.samples>1 and record.samples[2].time<now-History.Window-.07 do table.remove(record.samples,1) end
   end
  end
 end
end
function History.Start()
 if started then return end started=true
 workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v) if v:IsA("Humanoid") then track(v) end end)
 for _,v in workspace:GetDescendants() do if v:IsA("Humanoid") then track(v) end end
 Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  accumulator+=dt if accumulator<1/60 then return end accumulator%=1/30 capture(workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
 end)
end
function History.ObservedAt(model)
 local record=records[model] local frames=record and record.samples
 return frames and frames[#frames] and frames[#frames].time
end
local function sample(record,time)
 local frames=record.samples if #frames==0 then return end
 -- Do not extrapolate a respawn or rewind across a large teleport.
 if time<frames[1].time-.04 then return end
 local before,after=frames[1],frames[#frames]
 for _,frame in frames do if frame.time<=time then before=frame else after=frame break end end
 if (before.position-frames[#frames].position).Magnitude>18 then return end
 local alpha=math.clamp((time-before.time)/math.max(.00001,after.time-before.time),0,1)
 local parts={}
 for part,a in before.parts do
  local b=after.parts[part]
  if b and part.Parent then parts[part]={cf=a.cf:Lerp(b.cf,alpha),size=a.size} end
 end
 return parts
end
-- A client observation can only select a nearby SERVER-recorded pose time.
-- It cannot enlarge a hitbox, move geometry or declare damage.
function History.ResolveTime(now,requested,ping,view,cameraOrigin,cameraDirection,classify)
 local fallback=History.Time(now,requested,ping)
 if typeof(view)~="table" or typeof(view.part)~="Instance" or not view.part:IsA("BasePart")
  or not Shot.Finite(view.position) or not Shot.Finite(cameraOrigin) or not Shot.Finite(cameraDirection) then return fallback,false end
 local part=view.part local model=part.Parent local record=records[model]
 if not record or not SharedQuery.IsBodyPart(part,model) or record.humanoid.Health<=0 or classify(model)~="target" then return fallback,false end
 local low=math.max(now-History.Window,fallback-History.AlignmentWindow)
 local high=math.min(now,fallback+History.AlignmentWindow)
 local bestTime,bestError=fallback,math.huge
 local frames=record.samples
 local function consider(time)
  if time<low or time>high then return end
  local parts=sample(record,time) local pose=parts and parts[part]
  if not pose then return end
  local error=(pose.cf.Position-view.position).Magnitude
  if error>History.AlignmentError then return end
  if not History.Box(cameraOrigin,cameraDirection,15000,pose.cf,pose.size) then return end
  if error<bestError-.001 or math.abs(error-bestError)<=.001 and math.abs(time-fallback)<math.abs(bestTime-fallback) then bestTime=time bestError=error end
 end
 consider(fallback) consider(low) consider(high)
 for i,frame in frames do
  consider(frame.time)
  local nextFrame=frames[i+1] local a=frame.parts[part] local b=nextFrame and nextFrame.parts[part]
  if a and b then
   local delta=b.cf.Position-a.cf.Position
   if delta.Magnitude>.001 then
    local alpha=math.clamp((view.position-a.cf.Position):Dot(delta)/delta:Dot(delta),0,1)
    consider(frame.time+(nextFrame.time-frame.time)*alpha)
   end
  end
 end
 return bestTime,bestError<math.huge
end
function History.Trace(options,time)
 local origin=options.origin local direction=options.direction.Unit local range=options.range
 local ignored=table.clone(options.ignore or {}) local candidates={}
 for model,record in records do
  if model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and model~=options.shooter and record.humanoid.Health>0 and options.classify(model)=="target" then
   local parts=sample(record,time) or poses(model)
   if parts then
    table.insert(ignored,model)
    local nearest
    for part,pose in parts do
     local distance,normal=History.Box(origin,direction,range,pose.cf,pose.size,options.radius)
     if distance and (not nearest or distance<nearest.distance) then
      nearest={model=model,distance=distance,hit={Instance=part,Position=origin+direction*distance,Normal=normal,Distance=distance,Material=part.Material}}
     end
    end
    if nearest then table.insert(candidates,nearest) end
   end
  end
 end
 -- Current world geometry always wins; history never rewinds walls/doors.
 local world=Query.Trace({origin=origin,direction=direction,range=range,shooter=options.shooter,ignore=ignored,radius=options.radius,
  classify=function(model) return options.classify(model)=="ignore" and "ignore" or "block" end})
 local obstruction=(world.endpoint-origin).Magnitude
 local currentModel=world.result and Query.ModelFromPart(world.result.Instance)
 if currentModel and options.classify(currentModel)=="target" then
  table.insert(candidates,{model=currentModel,distance=obstruction,hit=world.result})
 end
 table.sort(candidates,function(a,b) return a.distance<b.distance end)
 local hits=0
 for _,candidate in candidates do
  if candidate.distance>obstruction+.001 then break end
  local multiplier=(1-(options.penetrationLoss or 0))^hits
  if options.onHit and not options.onHit(candidate.hit,candidate.model,hits+1,multiplier,candidate.distance) then
   return {endpoint=candidate.hit.Position,hits=hits,reason="protected",result=candidate.hit}
  end
  hits+=1
  if hits>=math.clamp(options.maxTargets or 1,1,8) then return {endpoint=candidate.hit.Position,hits=hits,reason="targets",result=candidate.hit} end
 end
 return {endpoint=world.endpoint,hits=hits,reason=world.reason,result=world.result}
end
return History

local R={}
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local DSS=game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local studio=game:GetService("RunService"):IsStudio()
local S=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ProgressionSchema)
local indexed,cache,names,rate,busy={},{},{},{},{}
local snapshot,friends
local personalCache={}
local function store(mode,metric) return DSS:GetOrderedDataStore("CG_Rank_v2_"..mode.."_"..metric) end
local function name(id)
 local online=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(id) if online then return online.DisplayName end
 if names[id] then return names[id] end
 local ok,value=pcall(function() return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(id) end)
 if ok then names[id]=value end
 return ok and value or ("Jogador "..id)
end
local pendingIndexes={}
function R.Index(id,data)
 if studio or id<=0 or type(data)~="table" then return end
 -- Index only snapshots read from persistence, including discovered offline profiles.
 pendingIndexes[id]=table.clone(data)
 if busy[id] then return end
 busy[id]=true
 indexed[id]=indexed[id] or {}
 local scores=indexed[id]
 task.spawn(function()
  while pendingIndexes[id] do
   local current=pendingIndexes[id] pendingIndexes[id]=nil
   for _,mode in S.Modes do for _,metric in S.Metrics[mode] do
    local key=mode..metric local value=S.Value(current,mode,metric)
    if value>0 and scores[key]~=value then
     local ok,err=pcall(function() store(mode,metric):UpdateAsync(tostring(id),function(old) return math.max(old or 0,value) end) end)
     if ok then
      scores[key]=value
      -- An empty query made before indexing must not hide newly indexed scores.
      cache[key]=nil personalCache[key..":"..id]=nil
     else warn("Crossgrounds ranking index "..key.." / "..id..": "..tostring(err)) end
     task.wait(.1)
    end
   end end
  end
  busy[id]=nil
 end)
end
local function sort(rows)
 table.sort(rows,function(a,b) return a.value==b.value and a.userId<b.userId or a.value>b.value end)
 for i,row in rows do row.rank=i end
end
-- Fetch through the personal score (including ties), capped to protect budgets.
-- A bounded result never fabricates an exact personal position or prestige.
local function global(player,mode,metric)
 if studio then return {entries={},unavailable=true,complete=true,message="Ranking global exige servidor publicado. Dados de Studio não concedem prestígio."} end
 local key=mode..metric local cached=cache[key]
 if not cached or os.clock()-cached.at>120 then
  local pages=store(mode,metric):GetSortedAsync(false,100,1)
  local rows={} local complete=false
  repeat
   for _,entry in pages:GetCurrentPage() do
    local id=tonumber(entry.key) if id then table.insert(rows,{userId=id,value=entry.value}) end
   end
   if pages.IsFinished then complete=true break end
   if #rows>=1000 then break end
   pages:AdvanceToNextPageAsync()
  until false
  sort(rows)
  cached={at=os.clock(),rows=rows,complete=complete} cache[key]=cached
 end
 local entries={} local personal
 for i,row in cached.rows do
  if i<=100 then table.insert(entries,{rank=i,userId=row.userId,name=name(row.userId),value=row.value}) end
  if player and row.userId==player.UserId then personal={rank=i,value=row.value} end
 end
 -- At a truncated tied boundary no exact rank is claimed.
 if personal and not cached.complete and personal.value==cached.rows[#cached.rows].value then personal.rank=nil end
 if player and (not personal or not personal.rank) then
  local personalKey=key..":"..player.UserId local stored=personalCache[personalKey]
  if not stored or os.clock()-stored.at>120 then
   local score=store(mode,metric):GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId))
   if score and score>0 then
    local pages=store(mode,metric):GetSortedAsync(false,100,score) local position=1
    repeat
     for _,entry in pages:GetCurrentPage() do
      local id=tonumber(entry.key)
      if id and (entry.value>score or entry.value==score and id<player.UserId) then position+=1 end
     end
     if pages.IsFinished then break end
     task.wait(.1) pages:AdvanceToNextPageAsync()
    until false
    stored={at=os.clock(),rank=position,value=score} personalCache[personalKey]=stored
   end
  end
  if stored then personal={rank=stored.rank,value=stored.value} end
 end
 return {entries=entries,personal=personal,complete=cached.complete,at=cached.at,message=not cached.complete and "Top 100 · posição pessoal consultada separadamente · empates por ID." or "Top 100 · empates ordenados por ID.",verified=cached.complete or (#cached.rows>3 and cached.rows[3].value>cached.rows[#cached.rows].value)}
end
local function prestige()
 for mode,metric in S.Primary do
  local ok,data=pcall(global,nil,mode,metric)
  local ranks={}
  if ok and data.verified then for i=1,math.min(3,#data.entries) do ranks[data.entries[i].userId]=i end end
  for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do p:SetAttribute("Prestige_"..mode,ranks[p.UserId]) end
  task.wait(.2)
 end
end
function R.Start(getSnapshot,getFriends)
 if R.started then return end R.started=true snapshot=getSnapshot friends=getFriends
 local remote=Instance.new("RemoteFunction") remote.Name="GetProgressRanking" remote.Parent=game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.Remotes
 remote.OnServerInvoke=function(player,mode,metric,scope)
  if not S.Valid(mode,metric) or (scope~="global" and scope~="friends") then return nil,"Filtro inválido." end
  if busy[player] or os.clock()-(rate[player] or -100)<3 then return nil,"Aguarde antes de atualizar." end
  rate[player]=os.clock() busy[player]=true
  local ok,result=pcall(function()
   if scope=="global" then
    local data=global(player,mode,metric)
    if not data.personal then
     local own=snapshot(player)
     data.personal={value=own and S.Value(own,mode,metric) or 0,rank=nil,label=data.unavailable and "Indisponível no Studio" or "Ainda sem classificação"}
    end
    return data
   end
   local records,message=friends(player) local rows={}
   for _,data in records do table.insert(rows,{userId=data.userId,name=data.name,value=S.Value(data,mode,metric)}) end
   sort(rows) local personal
   for _,row in rows do if row.userId==player.UserId then personal={rank=row.rank,value=row.value} end end
   return {entries=rows,personal=personal,message=message or "Amigos com histórico · esta classificação não concede prestígio."}
  end)
  busy[player]=nil
  if not ok then return nil,"Ranking indisponível. Tente novamente em instantes." end
  return result
 end
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) rate[p]=nil busy[p]=nil indexed[p.UserId]=nil for key in personalCache do if key:match(":"..p.UserId.."$") then personalCache[key]=nil end end end)
 task.spawn(function() while true do prestige() task.wait(180) end end)
end
return R

ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.GetOutR:
--!strict
-- Server-owned Classic round state. Calls to these methods must come from validated world interactions.
local Rules = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.GetOutRules)
local Round = {}
Round.__index = Round

function Round.new(roundId, mapId, routeId, routeData, beast, survivors, startedAt)
    assert(typeof(roundId) == "number" and typeof(mapId) == "string")
    assert(Rules.RouteNames[routeId] and routeData and beast and #survivors > 0)
    local status = {}
    for _, player in survivors do
        assert(player ~= beast and not status[player], "Participantes inválidos")
        status[player] = "active"
    end
    return setmetatable({
        id = roundId, mapId = mapId, routeId = routeId, routeData = routeData,
        beast = beast, status = status, phase = "active", startedAt = startedAt,
        completedPCs = {}, computerOrder = {}, openedDoors = {}, solvedPanels = {},
        revealedDigits = {}, vaultCode = nil, vaultBlockedUntil = 0,
        collected = {}, delivered = {}, assembled = false, plantedAt = nil,
        exitReady = false, ending = nil,
    }, Round)
end

function Round:IsActive(player)
    return (self.phase == "active" or self.phase == "enraged") and self.status[player] == "active"
end

function Round:Finish(reason)
    if self.phase == "results" then return false end
    self.phase = "results"
    self.ending = reason
    return true
end

function Round:CheckResolved()
    for _, result in self.status do if result == "active" then return false end end
    return self:Finish("all_survivors_resolved")
end

function Round:Advance(now)
    if self.phase == "results" then return false end
    local elapsed = now - self.startedAt
    if elapsed >= Rules.TotalSeconds then
        for player, result in self.status do
            if result == "active" then self.status[player] = "eliminated_at_timeout" end
        end
        self:Finish("timeout")
        return true
    end
    local changed = false
    if elapsed >= Rules.BaseSeconds and self.phase == "active" then self.phase = "enraged" changed = true end
    if self.routeId == "demolition" and self.plantedAt and not self.exitReady
        and now - self.plantedAt >= Rules.DemolitionFuseSeconds then
        self.exitReady = true
        changed = true
    end
    return changed
end

function Round:CompleteComputer(player, id)
    if not self:IsActive(player) or (self.routeId ~= "locks" and self.routeId ~= "vault_code")
        or not self.routeData.computers[id] or self.completedPCs[id] then return false end
    self.completedPCs[id] = true
    table.insert(self.computerOrder, id)
    if self.routeId == "locks" then
        if self:CompletedComputerCount() == 4 then self.exitReady = true end
    else
        local marker = self.routeData.computers[id]
        local slot, digit = marker:GetAttribute("DigitSlot"), marker:GetAttribute("Digit")
        self.revealedDigits[slot] = digit
        if self:CompletedComputerCount() == 4 then
            local code = ""
            for i = 1, 4 do code ..= tostring(self.revealedDigits[i]) end
            self.vaultCode = code
        end
    end
    return true
end

function Round:RollbackLastComputer()
    -- Prototype Hacker behavior: one completed PC, never after an exit has opened.
    if self.phase == "results" or (self.routeId ~= "locks" and self.routeId ~= "vault_code")
        or next(self.openedDoors) or self.exitReady and self.routeId == "vault_code" then return false end
    local id = table.remove(self.computerOrder)
    if not id then return false end
    self.completedPCs[id] = nil
    self.exitReady = false
    if self.routeId == "vault_code" then
        local slot = self.routeData.computers[id]:GetAttribute("DigitSlot")
        self.revealedDigits[slot] = nil
        self.vaultCode = nil
    end
    return true, id
end

function Round:CompletedComputerCount()
    local n = 0
    for _ in self.completedPCs do n += 1 end
    return n
end

function Round:Crank(player, doorId)
    if not self:IsActive(player) or self.routeId ~= "locks" or not self.exitReady
        or not self.routeData.cranks[doorId] or self.openedDoors[doorId] then return false end
    self.openedDoors[doorId] = true
    return true
end

function Round:TryVault(player, code, now)
    if not self:IsActive(player) or self.routeId ~= "vault_code" or not self.vaultCode
        or typeof(code) ~= "string" or not code:match("^%d%d%d%d$")
        or now < self.vaultBlockedUntil or self.exitReady then return false end
    if code ~= self.vaultCode then
        self.vaultBlockedUntil = now + Rules.VaultLockoutSeconds
        return false, "wrong_code"
    end
    self.exitReady = true
    return true
end

function Round:CompletePanel(player, panelId)
    -- Puzzle proof must be checked by a separate server controller before calling this.
    if not self:IsActive(player) or self.routeId ~= "laser_shutdown"
        or not self.routeData.panels[panelId] or self.solvedPanels[panelId] then return false end
    self.solvedPanels[panelId] = true
    local n = 0
    for _ in self.solvedPanels do n += 1 end
    if n == 4 then self.exitReady = true end
    return true
end

function Round:Collect(player, itemId)
    if not self:IsActive(player) or (self.routeId ~= "thermal_tool" and self.routeId ~= "demolition")
        or not self.routeData.items[itemId] or self.collected[itemId] then return false end
    self.collected[itemId] = player
    return true
end

function Round:Deliver(player, itemId)
    if not self:IsActive(player) or self.collected[itemId] ~= player or self.delivered[itemId] then return false end
    self.delivered[itemId] = true
    return true
end

function Round:Assemble(player, carriersPresent)
    if not self:IsActive(player) or self.assembled or not carriersPresent
        or (self.routeId ~= "thermal_tool" and self.routeId ~= "demolition") then return false end
    for id in self.routeData.items do if not self.delivered[id] then return false end end
    self.assembled = true
    return true
end

function Round:OpenSealedDoor(player, now, hasAssembledItem)
    if not self:IsActive(player) or not self.assembled or not hasAssembledItem or self.exitReady then return false end
    if self.routeId == "thermal_tool" then self.exitReady = true return true end
    if self.routeId == "demolition" and not self.plantedAt then self.plantedAt = now return true end
    return false
end

function Round:CanCross(doorId)
    if not self.routeData.zones[doorId] then return false end
    if self.routeId == "locks" then return self.openedDoors[doorId] == true end
    return self.exitReady
end

function Round:Escape(player, doorId)
    if not self:IsActive(player) or not self:CanCross(doorId) then return false end
    self.status[player] = "escaped"
    self:CheckResolved()
    return true
end

function Round:Capture(player)
    if not self:IsActive(player) then return false end
    self.status[player] = "captured"
    self:CheckResolved()
    return true
end

function Round:Contain(beastInChamber)
    -- The room and trigger are pending design. Only a validated server controller may call this.
    if self.phase ~= "enraged" or beastInChamber ~= true then return false end
    for player, result in self.status do
        if result == "active" then self.status[player] = "beast_contained" end
    end
    self:Finish("beast_contained")
    return true
end

function Round:Disconnect(player)
    if player == self.beast then return self:Finish("technical_beast_departure") end
    if self.status[player] == "active" then self.status[player] = "disconnected" self:CheckResolved() return true end
    return false
end

function Round:Snapshot(player, now)
    local results = {}
    for member, value in self.status do
        local key = member:IsA("Player") and tostring(member.UserId) or tostring(member)
        results[key] = value
    end
    local snapshot = {
        roundId = self.id, mapId = self.mapId, routeId = self.routeId, phase = self.phase,
        remaining = math.max(0, Rules.TotalSeconds - (now - self.startedAt)),
        result = self.status[player], results = results,
        computers = self:CompletedComputerCount(), exitReady = self.exitReady,
        ending = self.ending,
    }
    if self.routeId == "vault_code" then
        snapshot.digits = table.clone(self.revealedDigits)
        snapshot.vaultBlockedFor = math.max(0, self.vaultBlockedUntil - now)
    end
    return snapshot
end

return Round
