-- Shared scene validation for authored and automatically prepared spawn markers.
local Spawns={}
local clearance=Vector3.new(4,5.5,4)
function Spawns.Validate(world,cf)
 local ray=RaycastParams.new() ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={world} ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 local floor=workspace:Raycast(cf.Position,Vector3.new(0,-6,0),ray)
 if not floor or floor.Normal.Y<.9 or cf.Position.Y-floor.Position.Y<2.8 then return false end
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new() overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={world} overlap.RespectCanCollide=true
 for _,part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf,clearance,overlap) do if part.CanCollide then return false end end
 return true
end
function Spawns.SafeExits(world,cf)
 local rp=RaycastParams.new() rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={world} rp.RespectCanCollide=true
 local open={}
 for i=0,7 do
  local direction=Vector3.new(math.cos(i*math.pi/4),0,math.sin(i*math.pi/4))
  local target=cf.Position+direction*9
  local blocked=workspace:Raycast(cf.Position,direction*9,rp)
  local floor=workspace:Raycast(target,Vector3.new(0,-7,0),rp)
  if not blocked and floor and floor.Normal.Y>.9 and cf.Y-floor.Position.Y>=2.8 then table.insert(open,i) end
 end
 for _,a in open do for _,b in open do local angle=math.abs(a-b) angle=math.min(angle,8-angle) if angle>=2 then return true,#open end end end
 return false,#open
end
function Spawns.Generate(world,center,size,preferred,limit)
 local ray=RaycastParams.new() ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include ray.FilterDescendantsInstances={world} ray.RespectCanCollide=true
 local candidates={}
 local function add(position,look)
  local hit=workspace:Raycast(position+Vector3.new(0,8,0),Vector3.new(0,-34,0),ray)
  if not hit or hit.Normal.Y<.9 or hit.Position.Y>center.Y+8 then return end
  local p=hit.Position+Vector3.new(0,3.6,0)
  local direction=look or Vector3.new(center.X-p.X,0,center.Z-p.Z)
  local cf=direction.Magnitude>.01 and CFrame.lookAt(p,p+direction.Unit) or CFrame.new(p)
  if Spawns.Validate(world,cf) then
   for _,old in candidates do if (old.Position-p).Magnitude<5 then return end end
   table.insert(candidates,cf)
  end
 end
 for _,cf in preferred or {} do add(Vector3.new(cf.X,center.Y,cf.Z),cf.LookVector*Vector3.new(1,0,1)) end
 local step=math.max(8,math.max(size.X,size.Z)/30)
 for x=-size.X*.46,size.X*.46,step do
  for z=-size.Z*.46,size.Z*.46,step do add(center+Vector3.new(x,0,z)) end
  task.wait()
 end
 local selected={}
 if #candidates>0 then table.insert(selected,table.remove(candidates,1)) end
 while #selected<(limit or 24) and #candidates>0 do
  local best,bestDistance=1,-1
  for i,cf in candidates do
   local nearest=math.huge
   for _,old in selected do nearest=math.min(nearest,(old.Position-cf.Position).Magnitude) end
   if nearest>bestDistance then best=i bestDistance=nearest end
  end
  if bestDistance<8 then break end
  table.insert(selected,table.remove(candidates,best))
 end
 return selected,#candidates+#selected
end
function Spawns.InRegions(cf,regions)
 if not regions or #regions:GetChildren()==0 then return true end
 for _,region in regions:GetChildren() do if region:IsA("BasePart") then
  local p=region.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(cf.Position)
  local half=region.Size*.5
  if math.abs(p.X)<=half.X-2 and math.abs(p.Y)<=half.Y and math.abs(p.Z)<=half.Z-2 then return true end
 end end
 return false
end
return Spawns
ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.GetOutS:
-- Structural checks for maps opting in to the v0.5 P0 traversal contract.
local Validator={}
function Validator.Read(map,manifest)
 if manifest.root:GetAttribute("TraversalVersion")~=1 then return false,{"Mapa ainda não preparado para o núcleo de perseguição v0.5."} end
 local traversal=manifest.root:FindFirstChild("Traversal")
 if not traversal then return false,{"Traversal descriptors missing"} end
 local errors={} local counts={RegularDoor=0,Vent=0,Window=0,HideSpot=0}
 for _,m in traversal:GetChildren() do
  local kind=m:GetAttribute("Kind")
  if not m:IsA("BasePart") or not counts[kind] then table.insert(errors,"Invalid traversal marker: "..m.Name)
  else
   counts[kind]+=1
   if kind=="RegularDoor" then
    local matches=0 for _,p in map.Geometry:GetDescendants() do if p:IsA("BasePart") and p:GetAttribute("RegularDoorId")==m:GetAttribute("DoorId") then matches+=1 end end
    if typeof(m:GetAttribute("Hinge"))~="CFrame" or matches~=1 then table.insert(errors,"Door pivot/leaf invalid: "..m.Name) end
   elseif kind=="Vent" then
    if typeof(m:GetAttribute("Entrance"))~="Vector3" or typeof(m:GetAttribute("Exit"))~="Vector3" or m:GetAttribute("HumanOnly")~=true or m:GetAttribute("RequiresCrawl")~=true or (m:GetAttribute("MinimumClearance") or 0)<2 then table.insert(errors,"Vent connection/clearance invalid") end
   end
  end
 end
 for kind,n in counts do if n<1 then table.insert(errors,"P0 requires "..kind) end end
 local data=manifest.routes.locks
 if data then
  for id,pc in data.computers do
   local positions={}
   for _,a in pc:GetChildren() do if a:IsA("Attachment") and a.Name:match("^HackSlot") then
    for _,position in positions do if (a.Position-position).Magnitude<2.5 then table.insert(errors,"Overlapping hack slots: "..id) end end
    table.insert(positions,a.Position)
   end end
   if #positions<1 or #positions>3 then table.insert(errors,"Invalid hack slots: "..id) end
  end
  for id,pod in data.pods do if not pod:FindFirstChild("RescueExit") then table.insert(errors,"Rescue clearance marker missing: "..id) end end
 end
 return #errors==0,errors
end
return Validator
ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.GetOutM:
--!strict
-- Only hand-authored markers may make an imported map eligible for Get Out.
local Rules = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.GetOutRules)
local Manifest = {}

local function part(parent, name)
    local item = parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name)
    return item and item:IsA("BasePart") and item or nil
end

local function parts(parent, name, count)
    local folder = parent and parent:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not folder or not folder:IsA("Folder") then return nil end
    local found = {}
    local ids = {}
    for _, item in folder:GetChildren() do
        if not item:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
        local id = item:GetAttribute("ObjectiveId")
        if typeof(id) ~= "string" or id == "" or ids[id] then return nil end
        ids[id] = true
        found[id] = item
    end
    if count and #folder:GetChildren() ~= count then return nil end
    if not next(found) then return nil end
    return found
end

local function doors(root, required)
    local exits = parts(root, "ExitDoors", required)
    local zones = parts(root, "ExitZones", required)
    if not exits or not zones then return nil end
    for id in exits do if not zones[id] then return nil end end
    return { doors = exits, zones = zones }
end

local validators = {}

function validators.locks(root)
    local pc = parts(root, "Computers", 4)
    local locks = parts(root, "Locks", 4)
    local exits = doors(root, 2)
    local cranks = parts(root, "Cranks", 2)
    local pods = parts(root, "FreezePods", nil)
    local panels = parts(root, "ContainmentPanels", 2)
    local chamber = part(root, "ContainmentChamber")
    local lever = part(root, "ContainmentLever")
    local containmentDoor = part(root, "ContainmentDoor")
    if not pc or not locks or not exits or not cranks or not pods or not panels
        or not chamber or not lever or not containmentDoor then return nil end
    for id in exits.doors do if not cranks[id] then return nil end end
    return { computers = pc, locks = locks, doors = exits.doors, zones = exits.zones,
        cranks = cranks, pods = pods, containmentPanels = panels,
        chamber = chamber, lever = lever, containmentDoor = containmentDoor }
end

function validators.vault_code(root)
    local pc = parts(root, "Computers", 4)
    local exits = doors(root, nil)
    local dial = part(root, "VaultDial")
    if not pc or not exits or not dial then return nil end
    local slots = {}
    for _, marker in pc do
        local slot, digit = marker:GetAttribute("DigitSlot"), marker:GetAttribute("Digit")
        if typeof(slot) ~= "number" or slot % 1 ~= 0 or slot < 1 or slot > 4 or slots[slot]
            or typeof(digit) ~= "number" or digit % 1 ~= 0 or digit < 0 or digit > 9 then return nil end
        slots[slot] = digit
    end
    return { computers = pc, doors = exits.doors, zones = exits.zones, dial = dial, slots = slots }
end

function validators.laser_shutdown(root)
    local panels = parts(root, "SecurityPanels", 4)
    local beams = parts(root, "LaserBeams", 4)
    local exits = doors(root, nil)
    if not panels or not beams or not exits then return nil end
    local linked = {}
    for _, panel in panels do
        local beamId = panel:GetAttribute("BeamId")
        if typeof(beamId) ~= "string" or not beams[beamId] or linked[beamId] then return nil end
        linked[beamId] = true
    end
    return { panels = panels, beams = beams, doors = exits.doors, zones = exits.zones }
end

local function resources(root, folderName)
    local items = parts(root, folderName, nil)
    local exits = doors(root, nil)
    local bench = part(root, "Workbench")
    local sealed = part(root, "SealedDoor")
    if not items or not exits or not bench or not sealed then return nil end
    return { items = items, doors = exits.doors, zones = exits.zones, bench = bench, sealedDoor = sealed }
end

function validators.thermal_tool(root) return resources(root, "ThermalParts") end
function validators.demolition(root) return resources(root, "DemolitionResources") end

function Manifest.Read(map)
    if not map or map:GetAttribute("Enabled") == false or map:GetAttribute("Sanitized") ~= true then
        return nil, "Mapa não preparado."
    end
    local root = map:FindFirstChild("GetOut")
    if not root or not root:IsA("Folder") or root:GetAttribute("Authored") ~= true then
        return nil, "Manifesto GetOut autorado ausente."
    end
    local beast = part(root, "BeastSpawn")
    local survivors = parts(root, "SurvivorSpawns", nil)
    if not beast or not survivors then return nil, "Spawns de papéis incompletos." end
    local declared = root:GetAttribute("SupportedRoutes")
    if typeof(declared) ~= "string" then return nil, "Rotas não declaradas." end
    local available, diagnostics = {}, {}
    for _, route in Rules.Routes do
        if string.find("," .. declared .. ",", "," .. route .. ",", 1, true) then
            local data = validators[route](root)
            if data then available[route] = data
            else table.insert(diagnostics, route .. ": marcadores incompletos ou IDs inválidos") end
        end
    end
    if not next(available) then return nil, "Nenhuma rota válida: " .. table.concat(diagnostics, "; ") end
    return { map = map, root = root, beastSpawn = beast, survivorSpawns = survivors, routes = available, diagnostics = diagnostics }
end

function Manifest.Choose(manifest, rng, implemented)
    local eligible = {}
    for _, route in Rules.Routes do
        if manifest.routes[route] and (not implemented or implemented[route]) then table.insert(eligible, route) end
    end
    if #eligible == 0 then return nil, "Nenhuma rota implementada e válida." end
    -- More than one route requires an explicitly supplied selection policy.
    -- The design has not approved uniform odds or map-specific weights yet.
    if #eligible > 1 and not rng then return nil, "Distribuição das rotas pendente." end
    local index = #eligible == 1 and 1 or rng:NextInteger(1, #eligible)
    return eligible[index], manifest.routes[eligible[index]]
end

return Manifest

-- Per-round bot participants, keyed by team/slot rather than disposable characters.
local Stats={}
local records={}
local function id(model)
 if not model or not model:GetAttribute("CTFBot") then return end
 local team=model:GetAttribute("CTFTeam") local slot=model:GetAttribute("CTFSlot")
 if (team~="Blue" and team~="Red") or typeof(slot)~="number" then return end
 return -(team=="Blue" and 100 or 200)-slot,team
end
local function sync(record)
 local model=record.model
 if model and model.Parent then
  record.name=model:GetAttribute("BotAlias") or record.name
  record.avatarUserId=model:GetAttribute("AvatarUserId") or record.avatarUserId
  for _,key in {"Kills","Deaths","Captures"} do model:SetAttribute("CTF"..key,record[key]) end
 end

function Stats.Attach(model)

 local record=records[key] or {id=key,team=team,Kills=0,Deaths=0,Captures=0,name=model:GetAttribute("BotAlias") or model.Name}
 records[key]=record record.model=model sync(record)
end
function Stats.Add(model,field)
 local key=id(model) local record=key and records[key]
 if not record or (field~="Kills" and field~="Deaths" and field~="Captures") then return end
 record[field]+=1 sync(record)
end
function Stats.Remove(model)
 local key=id(model) local record=key and records[key]
 if record and record.model==model then records[key]=nil end
end
function Stats.Reset() table.clear(records) end
function Stats.Snapshot()
 local rows={}
 for _,record in records do
  sync(record)
  table.insert(rows,{userId=record.id,avatarUserId=record.avatarUserId or 0,isBot=true,name=record.name.." · IA",team=record.team,kills=record.Kills,deaths=record.Deaths,score=record.Captures})
 end
 return rows
end
return Stats

 for _,option in options do assert(typeof(option.id)=="string" and not self.options[option.id],"Duplicate map ID") self.options[option.id]=true end

end

end

end

end

   local delta=r.Position-origin local distance=delta.Magnitude

  end

   if changed then memory.changes=(memory.changes or 0)+1 end

  end
 end
 if not memory.visible then

end

function Policy.HasPlayed(saved)
 if type(saved)~="table" then return false end
 if saved.HasPlayed==true then return true end
 -- A real legacy progress record may legitimately contain only zeros.
 for _,key in {"XP","Coins","Kills","Deaths","Captures","PlaySeconds"} do

  local forward=r.root.CFrame.LookVector*Vector3.new(1,0,1) orientation.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero,forward.Magnitude>.01 and forward.Unit or -Vector3.zAxis) orientation.Parent=r.root
  r.crawlObjects={velocity,orientation,attachment} r.velocity=velocity r.orientation=orientation r.lastMove=0
  r.root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero r.root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero

 if not r or r.state~="Crawling" or typeof(direction)~="Vector3" then return false end
 if direction.X~=direction.X or direction.Z~=direction.Z or math.abs(direction.X)>1.1 or math.abs(direction.Z)>1.1 or math.abs(direction.Y)>.01 then return false end

function Combat:Valid(player,tool)

 local c=player.Character local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not h or h.Health<=0 or typeof(tool)~="Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") or tool.Parent~=c or tool:GetAttribute("ArenaWeapon")~=true then return end
 local id=tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId")
 if id~=Kits.ArenaWeapons[1] and id~=Kits.ArenaGunId(player:GetAttribute("ArenaPistolVisual")) then return end
 return c,Kits.Weapons[id],id
end
function Combat:Strip(player)

function Combat:Equip(player)

  local t=self.factory:Create(id,player:GetAttribute("ArenaPistolVisual")) local data=Kits.Weapons[t:GetAttribute("WeaponId")] t:SetAttribute("ArenaWeapon",true)

function Combat:Damage(player,part,data,id,distance,multiplier)
 local model=part
 while model and model~=workspace and not (model:IsA("Model") and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) do model=model.Parent end
 local h=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if not h or h.Health<=0 or model==player.Character then return false end

  if not self.owner:IsPlaying(target) or (model:GetAttribute("ArenaProtectedUntil") or 0)>workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then return false end
 elseif not model:GetAttribute("ArenaTarget") or not self.owner.maps.world or not model:IsDescendantOf(self.owner.maps.world) then return false end
 local headshot=data.Kind=="Gun" and part.Name=="Head"
 local amount=data.Kind=="Gun" and Kits.ShotDamage(data,distance,headshot,multiplier) or data.Damage
 h:TakeDamage(amount)
 
 if h.Health<=0 then
  local reward=Rewards.Apply(player,target,headshot)
  local tool=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  local weaponName=id=="ArenaPistol" and tool and tool.Name or data.Name
  self.feedback:FireClient(player,{kind="Kill",victim=target and target.DisplayName or "Alvo de treino",weapon=weaponName,weaponId=id,headshot=headshot,xp=reward.xp,bonusXP=reward.bonusXP,sessionXP=reward.sessionXP,training=reward.training})
  if target then self.feedback:FireClient(target,{kind="Eliminated",character=model,killer=player.Character,killerName=player.DisplayName,weapon=weaponName}) end
  if target then self.feedback:FireAllClients({kind="ArenaKillFeed",killerUserId=player.UserId,victimUserId=target.UserId,attacker=player.DisplayName,victim=target.DisplayName,weapon=weaponName,headshot=headshot}) end
  self.owner:Publish()
 else self.feedback:FireClient(player,{kind="Hit",headshot=headshot}) end
 return true
end
local function rayParams(character)

end
function Combat:Reload(player,tool)
 local _,data=self:Valid(player,tool) if not data or data.Kind~="Gun" or tool:GetAttribute("Reloading") then return end
 if (tool:GetAttribute("Ammo") or 0)>=data.Magazine or (tool:GetAttribute("ReserveAmmo") or 0)<=0 then return end
 tool:SetAttribute("Reloading",true) tool:SetAttribute("ReloadStartedAt",workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) tool:SetAttribute("ReloadDuration",data.ReloadTime)
 local sound=tool.Handle:FindFirstChild("ReloadSound") if sound then sound:Play() end
 task.delay(data.ReloadTime,function()
  local c=player.Character local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not player.Parent or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")~="arena" or not h or h.Health<=0 or not tool:IsDescendantOf(player) and tool.Parent~=c then
   if tool.Parent then tool:SetAttribute("Reloading",false) end return
  end
  local amount=math.min(data.Magazine-(tool:GetAttribute("Ammo") or 0),tool:GetAttribute("ReserveAmmo") or 0)
  tool:SetAttribute("Ammo",(tool:GetAttribute("Ammo") or 0)+amount) tool:SetAttribute("ReserveAmmo",(tool:GetAttribute("ReserveAmmo") or 0)-amount) tool:SetAttribute("Reloading",false)
  tool:SetAttribute("ShotAmmoVersion",(tool:GetAttribute("ShotAmmoVersion") or 0)+1)
 end)
end
function Combat:Attack(player,tool,aim,requestedOrigin,shotId,request)
 local c,data,id=self:Valid(player,tool) if not c then return end
 if data.Kind=="Gun" then
  Authority.Fire({player=player,character=c,tool=tool,data=data,weapon=id,aim=aim,requestedOrigin=requestedOrigin,shotId=shotId,request=request,cooldown=data.SourcePack=="ProjectileTest" and data.Cooldown or math.max(1,data.Cooldown),
   valid=function() return self:Valid(player,tool)~=nil end,
   classify=function(model)
    local h=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if h and h.Health<=0 then return "ignore" end
    local target=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
    return (target and self.owner:IsPlaying(target) or model:GetAttribute("ArenaTarget")) and "target" or "block"
   end,
   onHit=function(hit,_,_,multiplier,distance) return self:Damage(player,hit.Instance,data,id,distance,multiplier) end,
   accept=function()
    local state=self.last[player] or {} state.any=os.clock() self.last[player]=state
    c:SetAttribute("ArenaProtectedUntil",0) local shield=c:FindFirstChild("ArenaShield") if shield then shield:Destroy() end
   end})
  if (tool:GetAttribute("Ammo") or 0)==0 then self:Reload(player,tool) end
  return
 end
 if shotId~=nil and (typeof(shotId)~="number" or shotId%1~=0 or shotId<1 or shotId>1000000000) then return end
 local state=self.last[player] or {} local now=os.clock()
 if now-(state[id] or -100)<math.max(1,data.Cooldown) or now-(state.any or -100)<.07 or tool:GetAttribute("Reloading") or tool:GetAttribute("Attacking") then return end
 state[id]=now state.any=now self.last[player]=state
 Authority.NoteMelee(player,now)
 c:SetAttribute("ArenaProtectedUntil",0) local shield=c:FindFirstChild("ArenaShield") if shield then shield:Destroy() end
 self.feedback:FireClient(player,{kind="Shot",weapon=id,shotId=shotId})
  Effects.PlaySound(tool)
  local blade=tool:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") if not blade then return end
  local root=c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if not root then return end
  local base=tool:GetAttribute("RestGrip") or tool.Grip local started=os.clock() local hitOnce=false
  tool:SetAttribute("Attacking",true)
  task.spawn(function()
   while tool.Parent==c and self.owner:IsPlaying(player) and os.clock()-started<data.Windup+data.ActiveTime+.12 do
    local time=os.clock()-started local swing=math.clamp((time-data.Windup)/data.ActiveTime,0,1)
    tool.Grip=base*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(20+115*swing),0,math.rad(45-90*swing))
    if not hitOnce and time>=data.Windup and time<=data.Windup+data.ActiveTime then
     local overlap=OverlapParams.new() overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={c}
     for _,part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(blade.CFrame,blade.Size+Vector3.new(.3,.3,.3),overlap) do
      if (part.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<data.Range+4 then
       local obstruction=workspace:Raycast(root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0),part.Position-root.Position-Vector3.new(0,1,0),rayParams(c))
       if not obstruction or obstruction.Instance==part or obstruction.Instance:IsDescendantOf(part.Parent) then if self:Damage(player,part,data,id,0) then hitOnce=true break end end
      end
     end
    end
    game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait()
   end
   if tool.Parent then tool.Grip=base tool:SetAttribute("Attacking",false) end
  end)
end
return Combat

local Maps={} Maps.__index=Maps
local Definitions=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ArenaDefinitions)
local Library=require(script.Parent.MapLibrary)
local Spawns=require(script.Parent.MapSpawns)
function Maps.new() return setmetatable({world=nil,spawns={},lastSpawn={}},Maps) end
function Maps:Catalog() return Library.Catalog("Arena") end
function Maps:Clear()
 if self.world then self.world:Destroy() end self.world=nil self.spawns={} self.lastSpawn={} self.killPlaneY=nil workspace:SetAttribute("ArenaMapId",nil) workspace:SetAttribute("ArenaLightingProfile",nil)
end
function Maps:Load(id,canContinue)
 local source=Library.Get("Arena",id)
 if not source then return false,"Mapa de Arena indisponível." end
 self:Clear()
 local world=Instance.new("Folder") world.Name="CrossgroundsArenaRound" world:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsOwned",true) world.Parent=workspace self.world=world
 for _,batch in source.Geometry:GetChildren() do
  if canContinue and not canContinue() then if self.world==world then self:Clear() end return false,"Carregamento cancelado." end
  batch:Clone().Parent=world task.wait()
 end
 for _,marker in source.Spawns:GetChildren() do
  if marker:IsA("BasePart") and Spawns.InRegions(marker.CFrame,source:FindFirstChild("SpawnRegions")) and Spawns.Validate(world,marker.CFrame) then table.insert(self.spawns,marker.CFrame) end
 end
 if #self.spawns<4 then self:Clear() return false,"Mapa sem pontos de reaparecimento livres suficientes." end
 self.killPlaneY=source:GetAttribute("KillPlaneY") or 30
 workspace:SetAttribute("ArenaLightingProfile",source:GetAttribute("LightingProfile") or id)
 workspace:SetAttribute("ArenaMapId",id) return true
end
function Maps:ChooseSpawn(player,members)
 local best,score=self.spawns[1],-math.huge
 for i,cf in self.spawns do
  if Spawns.Validate(self.world,cf) then
  local nearest=1000
  for other in members do
   local root=other.Character and other.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local h=other.Character and other.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   if other~=player and root and h and h.Health>0 then nearest=math.min(nearest,(root.Position-cf.Position).Magnitude) end
  end
  local exposed=0
  for other in members do
   local r=other.Character and other.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local h=other.Character and other.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   if other~=player and r and h and h.Health>0 and (r.Position-cf.Position).Magnitude<120 then
    local rp=RaycastParams.new() rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={self.world} rp.RespectCanCollide=true
    if not workspace:Raycast(r.Position,cf.Position-r.Position,rp) then exposed+=1 end
   end
  end
  local value=nearest-exposed*100-math.max(0,8-(os.clock()-(self.lastSpawn[i] or -100)))*30-(cf.Position-Definitions.Origin).Magnitude*.02
  if value>score then best=cf score=value end
  end
 end
 for i,cf in self.spawns do if cf==best then self.lastSpawn[i]=os.clock() break end end
 return best
end
return Maps

-- Classic/Locks prototype. All timings in GetOutRules.Prototype are temporary test values.
local Adapter = {} Adapter.__index = Adapter
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function count(dictionary)

end
local function rootOf(player)
 local c=player.Character
 local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local root=c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if c and c:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and h and h.Health>0 and root then return root,h end
end

function Adapter.new(context,config)
 local changed=Instance.new("BindableEvent")
 local self=setmetatable({id="get_out",version="0.5-p0",context=context,config=config,
  maps=Maps.new(),members={},roles={},pods={},connections={},objectConnections={},characters={},
  deathConnections={},phase="waiting",endsAt=0,serial=0,round=nil,world=nil,

 local remotes=game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds:FindFirstChild("GetOutRemotes") or Instance.new("Folder")
 remotes.Name="GetOutRemotes" remotes.Parent=game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds
 local function remote(name)
  local value=remotes:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
  assert(value:IsA("RemoteEvent"),"Remote inválido: "..name)
  value.Name=name value.Parent=remotes return value
 end
 self.stateRemote=remote("State")
 self.abilityRemote=remote("UseHacker")
 self.classAbilityRemote=remote("UseAbility")self.interactRemote=remote("Interact")
 self.actionRemote=remote("Action") self.feedbackRemote=remote("Feedback") self.loadRemote=remote("LoadReady")
 self.gameplay=Gameplay.new(self) self.loadAcks={} self.spawned={} self.actionRates={}
 return self
end

function Adapter:IsAvailable()
 if not self.config.EnableLocalGetOutPrototype or typeof(self.config.GetOutPrototypeMapId)~="string" then return false end
 for _,entry in self.maps:Catalog({locks=true}) do if entry.id==self.config.GetOutPrototypeMapId then return true end end

function Adapter:Snapshot(player)
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 local round=self.round
 local data=round and round:Snapshot(player,now) or nil
 return {id=self.id,version=self.version,state=self.phase,role=self.roles[player] or "waiting",
  map=round and round.mapId or self.config.GetOutPrototypeMapId,
  routeId=round and round.routeId or nil,roundId=round and round.id or nil,
  remaining=(self.phase=="results" or self.phase=="intermission" or self.phase=="loading") and math.max(0,self.endsAt-now) or round and data.remaining or 0,
  computers=round and data.computers or 0,result=round and round.status[player] or nil,
  results=data and data.results or nil,ending=round and round.ending or nil,
  podRemaining=self.pods[player] and math.max(0,T.PodSeconds*(1-(player:GetAttribute("GetOutFreeze") or 0))) or nil,
  gameplay=self.gameplay:Snapshot(player),

function Adapter:Publish()

end

function Adapter:EnsureStaging()
 if self.staging and self.staging.Parent then return end
 local floor=Instance.new("Part") floor.Name="GetOutStaging" floor.Size=Vector3.new(64,2,64)
 floor.CFrame=CFrame.new(1800,180,340) floor.Anchored=true floor.Color=Color3.fromRGB(31,43,54)
 floor:SetAttribute("CrossgroundsOwned",true) floor.Parent=workspace self.staging=floor
 for _,edge in {{Vector3.new(-32,5,0),Vector3.new(1,8,64)},{Vector3.new(32,5,0),Vector3.new(1,8,64)},{Vector3.new(0,5,-32),Vector3.new(64,8,1)},{Vector3.new(0,5,32),Vector3.new(64,8,1)}} do
  local wall=Instance.new("Part") wall.Name="StagingGuard" wall.Anchored=true wall.Size=edge[2] wall.CFrame=floor.CFrame*CFrame.new(edge[1]) wall.Color=floor.Color wall.Transparency=.35 wall.Parent=floor
 end

function Adapter:ClearObjectConnections()

 table.clear(self.panelDone)
 table.clear(self.interactions)table.clear(self.promptRecords)
end

function Adapter:ClearCharacterPrompt(player)
 local root=rootOf(player)
 local prompt=root and root:FindFirstChild("GetOutCapture")

end

function Adapter:StripTools(player)
 for _,container in {player.Character,player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")} do
  if container then for _,item in container:GetChildren() do if item:IsA("Tool") then item:Destroy() end end end
 end
end

function Adapter:CharacterPosition(player)
 if self.round and (self.phase=="playing" or self.phase=="enraged" or self.phase=="deploying") then
  if player==self.beast then return self.maps.manifest.beastSpawn.CFrame end
  if self.roles[player]=="survivor" and self.round.status[player]=="active" then
   local points={}
   for _,point in self.maps.manifest.survivorSpawns do table.insert(points,point) end
   table.sort(points,function(a,b)return a.Name<b.Name end)
   local index=self.members[player].spawnIndex or 1
   return points[(index-1)%#points+1].CFrame
  end
 end
 self:EnsureStaging()
 return self:StagingPosition(player)
end

function Adapter:StagingPosition(player)
 local players={} for p in self.members do table.insert(players,p) end
 table.sort(players,function(a,b)return a.UserId<b.UserId end)
 local index=table.find(players,player) or 1
 return self.staging.CFrame*CFrame.new((index-1)*7-14,5,0)
end

function Adapter:Configure(player,character)
 if not self.members[player] or self.context:GetMode(player)~="get_out" or player.Character~=character then return end
 local root,h=rootOf(player) if not root then return end
 self:StripTools(player)
 player.Neutral=true player.Team=nil
 player:SetAttribute("InMatch",false) player:SetAttribute("InArena",false)
 player:SetAttribute("ArenaPlaying",false) player:SetAttribute("SprintActive",false)
 player:SetAttribute("GetOutRole",self.roles[player] or "waiting")
 player:SetAttribute("GetOutBeastClass",player==self.beast and T.DefaultBeastClass or nil)
 player:SetAttribute("GetOutRoundId",self.round and self.round.id or 0)
 player:SetAttribute("GetOutPodState",false)
 player:SetAttribute("GetOutUnstable",player==self.beast and self.phase=="enraged")
 character:SetAttribute("AtLobby",false)
 for _,shield in character:GetChildren() do if shield:IsA("ForceField") then shield:Destroy() end end
 h.MaxHealth=100 h.Health=100 h.WalkSpeed=player==self.beast and (self.phase=="enraged" and P.EnragedWalkSpeed or P.BeastWalkSpeed) or P.SurvivorWalkSpeed
 h.UseJumpPower=false h.JumpHeight=T.JumpHeight h.AutoRotate=true root.Anchored=false
 character:PivotTo(self:CharacterPosition(player)*CFrame.new(0,3,0))
 root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
 self.gameplay:Bind(player,h.WalkSpeed)
 h:MoveTo(root.Position)
 root.Anchored=self.phase=="deploying"
 self.spawned[player]=character
 if self.deathConnections[player] then self.deathConnections[player]:Disconnect() end
 self.deathConnections[player]=h.Died:Once(function()
  player:SetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady",false)
  if self.round and (self.phase=="playing" or self.phase=="enraged") then
   if player==self.beast then self.round:Finish("technical_beast_death") self:BeginResults()
   else self.gameplay:CleanPlayer(player) if self.round:Capture(player) then self:ReleasePod(player) self:CheckRoundFinished() end end
  end
  task.delay(2,function()
   if player.Parent and self.members[player] and self.context:GetMode(player)=="get_out" and player.Character==character then self:Spawn(player) end
  end)
 end)
 if self.roles[player]=="survivor" and self.round and self.round.status[player]=="active" then self:AttachCapture(player) end
 self.context:MarkReady(player)
end

function Adapter:Spawn(player)
 if not player.Parent or not self.members[player] then return end
 local root=rootOf(player)
 if root then self:Configure(player,player.Character) return end
 if self.loading and self.loading[player] then return end
 self.loading=self.loading or {} self.loading[player]=true
 player:SetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady",false)
 local ok,err=pcall(function() player:LoadCharacterAsync() end)
 self.loading[player]=nil
 if not ok then warn("Get Out character: "..tostring(err)) end
end

function Adapter:ValidInteraction(player,part,role)
 if not self.round or (self.phase~="playing" and self.phase~="enraged")
  or not self.members[player] or self.roles[player]~=role or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") then return false end
 if not self.gameplay:CanAct(player) then return false end
 if role=="survivor" and (not self.round:IsActive(player) or self.pods[player]) then return false end
 local root=rootOf(player)
 local pos=part:IsA("Attachment")and part.WorldPosition or part:IsA("BasePart")and part.Position
 return root~=nil and pos~=nil and part:IsDescendantOf(workspace)and(root.Position-pos).Magnitude<=12
end

function Adapter:PromptEligible(player,prompt,record)
 if not record or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled or record.serial~=self.serial then return false end
 local target=prompt.Parent
 if not self:ValidInteraction(player,target,record.role)then return false end
 local root=rootOf(player)local position=target:IsA("Attachment")and target.WorldPosition or target.Position
 return(root.Position-position).Magnitude<=prompt.MaxActivationDistance+.35
end

function Adapter:Interact(player,roundId,command,prompt)
 if not self.round or roundId~=self.round.id then return end
 local active=self.interactions[player]
 if command=="cancel"then if active and active.prompt==prompt then self.interactions[player]=nil end return end
 if typeof(prompt)~="Instance"or not prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt")then return end
 local record=self.promptRecords[prompt]
 if command=="begin"then
  if not self:PromptEligible(player,prompt,record)then return end
  if active and active.prompt==prompt then return end
  self.interactions[player]={prompt=prompt,record=record,started=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()}
 elseif command=="complete"and active and active.prompt==prompt then
  local remaining=record and record.hold-(workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-active.started)or math.huge
  if remaining>.15 or not self:PromptEligible(player,prompt,record)then return end
  -- Honor server time, including short holds and a small amount of packet jitter.
  task.delay(math.max(0,remaining),function()
   if self.interactions[player]~=active or not self:PromptEligible(player,prompt,record)then return end
   self.interactions[player]=nil record.callback(player,prompt,workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
   self:Publish()
  end)
 end
end

function Adapter:Prompt(part,text,hold,role,callback)
 local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt") prompt.Name="GetOutPrompt" prompt.ActionText=text
 prompt.ObjectText="Get Out" prompt.HoldDuration=hold prompt.MaxActivationDistance=9
 prompt:SetAttribute("GetOutRole",role)
 prompt:SetAttribute("GetOutManagedInteraction",true)
 prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false prompt.Parent=part
 local holds={}
 self.promptRecords[prompt]={role=role,hold=hold,callback=callback,serial=self.serial}
 table.insert(self.objectConnections,prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan:Connect(function(player) holds[player]=workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end))
 table.insert(self.objectConnections,prompt.PromptButtonHoldEnded:Connect(function(player)
  local stamp=holds[player]task.delay(.25,function()if holds[player]==stamp then holds[player]=nil end end)
 end))
 table.insert(self.objectConnections,prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
  local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
  local began=holds[player] holds[player]=nil
  if not began or now-began<hold-.15 or not self:ValidInteraction(player,part,role) then return end
  callback(player,prompt,now)
 end))
 return prompt
end

function Adapter:AttachCapture(target)
 self:ClearCharacterPrompt(target)

end

function Adapter:ReleasePod(player)
 local state=self.pods[player] if not state then return end

end

function Adapter:OpenDoor(id)

function Adapter:StartRound()

 self.phase="loading" self.endsAt=0 self:Publish()
 self.serial+=1 local serial=self.serial
 local players={} for p in self.members do if p.Parent then table.insert(players,p) end end

  if self.serial~=serial then return false end
  for _,p in players do if not self.members[p] or not p.Parent then return false end end
  return #players>=P.MinPlayers
 end
 local function abort(message)
  if self.serial~=serial then return end
  self.gameplay:Reset() self.round=nil self.beast=nil table.clear(self.roles)
  self.phase="failed" self.endsAt=0 self.message=message
  for p in self.members do self:Spawn(p) end
  self:Publish()
 end
 local ok,manifest,routeId=self.maps:Load(self.config.GetOutPrototypeMapId,nil,{locks=true},valid)
 if self.serial~=serial then return end
 if not valid() then self:BeginIntermission() return end
 if not ok then abort(tostring(manifest)) return end
 local parts=0 for _,v in self.maps.world:GetDescendants() do if v:IsA("BasePart") then parts+=1 end end
 self.maps.world:SetAttribute("LoadToken",serial)
 self.message="Carregando cenário..." self.endsAt=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+MapLoadGate.Seconds self:Publish()
 local deadline=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+T.SpawnTimeout
 local sent=0
 repeat
  if not valid() then if self.serial==serial then self:BeginIntermission() end return end
  local time=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
  if time-sent>=1 then
   sent=time
   for _,p in players do if self.loadAcks[p]~=serial then self.loadRemote:FireClient(p,serial,self.maps.world.Name,parts) end end
  end
  local ready=time>=self.endsAt
  for _,p in players do if self.loadAcks[p]~=serial then ready=false end end
  if ready then break end
  if time>=deadline then abort("O mapa não terminou de carregar para todos. Volte ao hub e tente novamente.") return end
  task.wait(.1)
 until false
 table.sort(players,function(a,b)return a.UserId<b.UserId end)
 self.beast=players[math.random(#players)] local survivors={}
 for _,p in players do if p==self.beast then self.roles[p]="beast" else self.roles[p]="survivor" table.insert(survivors,p) end end
 for i,p in survivors do self.members[p].spawnIndex=i end
 self.round=Round.new(serial,self.maps.mapId,routeId,manifest.routes[routeId],self.beast,survivors,workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
 self.phase="deploying" self.message="Posicionando jogadores..." self.endsAt=0 self:Publish()
 for _,p in players do self.spawned[p]=nil p:SetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady",false) task.spawn(function() self:Spawn(p) end) end
 deadline=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+T.SpawnTimeout
 repeat
  if not valid() then if self.serial==serial then self:BeginIntermission() end return end
  local ready=true
  for _,p in players do if not rootOf(p) or self.spawned[p]~=p.Character then ready=false end end
  if ready then break end
  if workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>=deadline then abort("Não foi possível preparar os personagens. Volte ao hub e tente novamente.") return end
  task.wait(.1)
 until false
 self.round.startedAt=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 self.phase="playing" self.message=nil self.endsAt=self.round.startedAt+Rules.TotalSeconds self.hackerReadyAt=0 self.abilityReadyAt=0
 for _,p in players do local root=rootOf(p) if root then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero root.Anchored=false end end
 self:BuildObjectives()
 for _,p in survivors do self:AttachCapture(p) end
 self:Publish()
end

function Adapter:Forget(player)

 self.gameplay:CleanPlayer(player) self.loadAcks[player]=nil self.spawned[player]=nil self.actionRates[player]=nil
 self.interactions[player]=nil
 self:ReleasePod(player) self:ClearCharacterPrompt(player)

 self.members[player]=nil self.roles[player]=nil
 if self.deathConnections[player] then self.deathConnections[player]:Disconnect() self.deathConnections[player]=nil end
 player:SetAttribute("GetOutRole",nil) player:SetAttribute("GetOutRoundId",nil)
 player:SetAttribute("GetOutBeastClass",nil)

 if count(self.members)==0 then
  self.serial+=1 self:ClearObjectConnections() self.maps:Clear() self.round=nil self.beast=nil
  self.phase="waiting" self.endsAt=0

  self.serial+=1 self:BeginIntermission()

 local deadline=os.clock()+12
 repeat
  if not player.Parent then return false,"Saída interrompida." end
  if player:GetAttribute("ModeCharacterReady") then return true end
  task.wait(.05)

function Adapter:Start(playerManager)

 self:EnsureStaging()

  self.characters[player]=player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
   if self.context:GetMode(player)~="get_out" then return end
   character:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10) character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",10)
   task.defer(function()
    while self.loading and self.loading[player] and player.Parent do task.wait() end

  end)

  self:Forget(player)

  if typeof(command)~="string"or(command~="begin"and command~="complete"and command~="cancel")then return end

 end))
 table.insert(self.connections,self.classAbilityRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,roundId)
  if not self.round or roundId~=self.round.id or player~=self.beast or not self.gameplay:CanAct(player)then return end
  local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()if now<self.abilityReadyAt then return end
  if T.DefaultBeastClass=="Runner"and self.gameplay.traversal:Runner(player)then self.abilityReadyAt=now+T.RunnerCooldownSeconds self:Publish()end
 end))
 table.insert(self.connections,self.loadRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,token)
  if self.phase=="loading" and token==self.serial and self.members[player] then self.loadAcks[player]=token end

 table.insert(self.connections,self.actionRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,roundId,action,value)
  if not self.round or roundId~=self.round.id or typeof(action)~="string" then return end
  local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow() local key=action=="CrawlMove" and "movement" or "action"
  local rates=self.actionRates[player] or {} self.actionRates[player]=rates

  self.gameplay:Action(player,action,value)
 end))
 table.insert(self.connections,self.abilityRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,roundId)
  if T.DefaultBeastClass~="Hacker"then return end
  if typeof(roundId)~="number" or not self.round or roundId~=self.round.id
   or player~=self.beast or self.context:GetMode(player)~="get_out"
   or self.phase~="playing" and self.phase~="enraged" then return end
  local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
  if now<self.hackerReadyAt then return end
  local done=self.round:RollbackLastComputer()
  if not done then return end
  self.gameplay:Rollback()
  self.hackerReadyAt=now+P.HackerRollbackCooldownSeconds
  for id,marker in self.maps.manifest.routes.locks.computers do
   if not self.round.completedPCs[id] then
    marker.Color=Color3.fromRGB(73,130,177)
    local prompt=marker:FindFirstChild("GetOutPrompt") if prompt then prompt.Enabled=true end
   end
  end
  for _,lock in self.maps.manifest.routes.locks.locks do lock.Color=Color3.fromRGB(183,72,65) end
  for _,prompt in self.crankPrompts or {} do prompt.Enabled=false end
  self:Publish()
 end))
 local elapsed=0
 table.insert(self.connections,Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  self.gameplay.traversal:Tick(self.gameplay.windows)
  for player,hold in self.interactions do if not self:PromptEligible(player,hold.prompt,hold.record)then self.interactions[player]=nil end end
  elapsed+=dt if elapsed<.25 then return end local step=elapsed elapsed=0
  local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
  if self.phase=="intermission" and now>=self.endsAt then task.spawn(function() if self.phase=="intermission" then self:StartRound() end end)
  elseif self.phase=="results" and now>=self.endsAt then self:BeginIntermission()
  elseif self.round and (self.phase=="playing" or self.phase=="enraged") then
   local prior=self.round.phase
   if self.round:Advance(now) then
    if self.round.phase=="results" then self:BeginResults()
    elseif prior~="enraged" and self.round.phase=="enraged" then
     self.phase="enraged"
     local _,h=rootOf(self.beast)
     local movement=self.gameplay.traversal.records[self.beast] if movement then movement.speed=P.EnragedWalkSpeed end

     if self.beast then self.beast:SetAttribute("GetOutUnstable",true) end
     for _,prompt in self.containmentPrompts or {} do prompt.Enabled=true end

     local light=self.maps.manifest.routes.locks.chamber:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
     if light then light.Enabled=true end
    end
   end
   self.gameplay:Tick(step)
  end
  self.publishElapsed=(self.publishElapsed or 0)+step
  if self.publishElapsed>=(next(self.gameplay.jobs) and .25 or 1) then self.publishElapsed=0 if count(self.members)>0 then self:Publish() end end
 end))
end

function Adapter.Cross(position,target,lane)
 local arena=workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFInfrastructure")
 local routes=arena and arena:FindFirstChild("BotRoutes")
 if routes then
  if math.abs(position.X-target.X)>80 then
  local route=routes:FindFirstChild(lane<0 and "North" or lane>0 and "South" or "Center")

   for _,point in points do

   end
  end
  end
  return target
 end
 if position.X<-36 and target.X>36 then return Vector3.new(-32,41,lane) end
 if position.X>36 and target.X<-36 then return Vector3.new(32,41,lane) end
 if position.X<36 and position.X>=-36 and target.X>36 then return Vector3.new(42,41,lane) end

 local root=self.bot.HumanoidRootPart local sign=self.team.Name=="Blue" and -1 or 1

 elseif own.state=="dropped" then position=own.hitbox.Position label="Recovering" critical=true

local shared=script.Parent.Working.Shared
local P=require(shared.ControlPolicy) local D=require(shared.ControlDefinitions)
local count=0
local function check(value,message) count+=1 assert(value,message) end
local function state(changes)
 local s={mode="ctf",alive=true,inMatch=true,arenaPlaying=true,authorized=true,victim="Active"}
 for key,value in changes or {} do s[key]=value end return s
end
local function allowed(action,changes) return P.Available(action,state(changes)) end
for _,device in {"Keyboard","Gamepad"} do
 local bindings={}
 for action,data in D.Actions do
  bindings[action]=data[device]
  check(D:IsAllowed(device,data[device],action),"Invalid default "..action)
 end
 for a in D.Actions do for b in D.Actions do
  if a<b then check(bindings[a]~=bindings[b] or not P.Conflicts(a,b),device..": default conflict "..a.."/"..b) end
 end end
 local normalized=P.Normalize(D,bindings,device)
 for action,key in bindings do check(normalized[action]==key,"Normalization changed a valid default") end
end
check(not P.Conflicts("Fire","GetOutAttack"),"Exclusive combat actions must share")
check(not P.Conflicts("Shoulder","MenuNext"),"Menu should share shoulder")
check(not P.Conflicts("ShiftLock","AdminSpeedDown"),"Admin should share shift lock")
check(P.Conflicts("Menu","AdminSpeedUp"),"Menu and admin speed overlap")
check(P.Conflicts("AdminMode","Fire"),"Admin activation overlaps gameplay")
for action in D.Actions do
 check(not allowed(action,{suspended=true}),"Suspension leaked "..action)
 check(not allowed(action,{modal=true,settingsMenu=false}) or action=="MenuNext" or action=="MenuPrevious","Modal leaked "..action)
end
for _,attr in {"modal","suspended","admin","spectating"} do
 check(not allowed("Fire",{[attr]=true}),"Fire blocked by "..attr)
end
check(allowed("Menu",{admin=true}),"Settings must open in admin")
check(not allowed("AdminSpeedUp",{admin=true,modal=true}),"Admin controls must yield to menus")
check(allowed("AdminSpeedUp",{admin=true}),"Admin speed unavailable")
check(not allowed("AdminMode",{authorized=false,inMatch=false}),"Permission check")
check(not allowed("AdminMode"),"Admin must leave match before activating")
check(allowed("AdminMode",{inMatch=false}),"Admin should start outside match")
check(allowed("AdminMode",{admin=true}),"Admin must be able to exit")
check(allowed("GetOutCrawl",{mode="get_out",role="survivor"}),"Survivor crawl")
check(not allowed("GetOutCrawl",{mode="get_out",role="beast"}),"Beast cannot crawl")
check(not allowed("GetOutAttack",{mode="get_out",role="survivor"}),"Survivor cannot attack")
check(allowed("GetOutAttack",{mode="get_out",role="beast"}),"Beast attack")
check(not allowed("GetOutCheck",{mode="get_out",role="survivor"}),"Check outside hack")
check(allowed("GetOutCheck",{mode="get_out",role="survivor",hacking=true}),"Check during hack")
check(not allowed("ReloadInteract",{mode="get_out",role="survivor",hacking=true}),"Interaction during hack")
check(not allowed("GetOutDrop",{mode="get_out",role="beast"}),"Drop without victim")
check(allowed("GetOutDrop",{mode="get_out",role="beast",dragging=true}),"Drop with victim")
check(not allowed("Fire",{mode="arena",arenaPlaying=false}),"Arena waiting cannot fire")
check(not allowed("Fire",{alive=false}),"Dead player cannot fire")
check(not allowed("Fire",{inMatch=false}),"Lobby cannot fire")
check(not allowed("GetOutAttack",{mode="get_out",role="beast",result="captured"}),"Ended round cannot attack")
for _,device in {"Keyboard","Gamepad"} do
 local bindings={} for action,data in D.Actions do bindings[action]=data[device] end
 local old=bindings.ReloadInteract
 local plan=P.Plan(D,bindings,"ReloadInteract",device,bindings.Fire)
 check(plan~=nil,"Multi-conflict swap failed")
 check(plan.Fire==old and plan.GetOutAttack==old,"Both world contexts must be reassigned")
 check(bindings.Fire==D.Actions.Fire[device],"Plan mutated original")
 local legacy=table.clone(bindings)
 legacy.AdminSpeedUp=bindings.Menu legacy.AdminSpeedDown=bindings.Perspective
 local repaired=P.Normalize(D,legacy,device)
 check(repaired~=nil,"Legacy migration")
 for a in D.Actions do for b in D.Actions do
  if a<b then check(repaired[a]~=repaired[b] or not P.Conflicts(a,b),"Migrated conflict "..a.."/"..b) end
 end end
end
check(not D:IsAllowed("Keyboard","W","AdminSpeedUp"),"W must stay movement")
check(not D:IsAllowed("Keyboard","Space","Fire"),"Space must stay jump/check")
check(P.Plan(D,{},"Unknown","Gamepad","ButtonA")==nil,"Unknown action")
return {passed=count}

-- Keeps one displayed weapon for a weapon ID; only changed slots are cloned.
local Preview={}
Preview.__index=Preview
local Iron=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.IronSightVisibility)
local function safe(model)
	for _,v in model:GetDescendants() do
		if v:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') or v:IsA('Sound') or v:IsA('ParticleEmitter')
			or v:IsA('Trail') or v:IsA('Beam') or v:IsA('Light') then v:Destroy()
		elseif v:IsA('BasePart') then
			v.Anchored=true v.CanCollide=false v.CanQuery=false v.CanTouch=false v.Massless=true
		end
	end
end
function Preview.new(world)
	return setmetatable({world=world,bases={},order={},native=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'})},Preview)
end
function Preview:HasBase(id) return self.bases[id]~=nil end
function Preview:Capture(asset,id)
	-- Clone the base only on a weapon change/cache miss, not for every combination.
	if not self.bases[id] then
		local base=Instance.new('Model') base.Name=id
		for _,v in asset:GetChildren() do if not v:GetAttribute('VisualAttachmentId') then v:Clone().Parent=base end end
		base.PrimaryPart=base:FindFirstChild('Handle') safe(base) self.bases[id]=base table.insert(self.order,id)
		if #self.order>4 then local old=table.remove(self.order,1) self.bases[old]:Destroy() self.bases[old]=nil end
	end
	local snapshot=Instance.new('Model') snapshot.Name='AttachmentSnapshot'
	local native={}
	for _,v in asset:GetChildren() do
		if v:GetAttribute('VisualAttachmentId') or v.Name=='Handle' then v:Clone().Parent=snapshot
		elseif v:IsA('BasePart') then native[v:GetAttribute('VisualPartKey') or v.Name]=v.Transparency end
	end
	self.native[snapshot]=native safe(snapshot)
	return snapshot
end
function Preview:Show(asset,id,configuration)
	local clean=table.clone(configuration or {})
	local previous=self.configuration or {}
	if not self.model or self.id~=id then
		if self.model then self.model:Destroy() end
		self.model=assert(self.bases[id],'Preview base missing'):Clone() safe(self.model) self.model.Parent=self.world
		previous={}
	end
	do
		local changed={}
		for slot,value in previous do if clean[slot]~=value then changed[slot]=true end end

 local velocity=character.HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity*Vector3.new(1,0,1)

 end

 if not self.muzzle then return end
 local p=self.camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(self.muzzle.WorldPosition) local depth=-p.Z
 if depth<=.1 then return end
 local v=camera.ViewportSize local tan=math.tan(math.rad(self.camera.FieldOfView*.5))
 local x=.5+p.X/(depth*2*tan*v.X/math.max(1,v.Y)) local y=.5-p.Y/(depth*2*tan)
 local ray=camera:ViewportPointToRay(x*v.X,y*v.Y)
 return camera.CFrame.Position+ray.Direction*math.min(depth,3)
end

 if character:GetAttribute("AtLobby") then

 local headshot=data.Kind=="Gun" and part.Name=="Head"

ServerStorage.MACRO_PLUGIN.README:
--[[

Defaultio 2018

	This is a macro container plugin that makes it easy to make yourself tools to help you on your project.
	
	This is a nice substitute for that big fat "commands" script we all tend to make that contains all our
	frequently used command bar scripts. Instead, you can give each of these commmands a macro for quick
	and easy execution.
	
	~ ~ The plugin just created a folder called MACRO_PLUGIN in ServerStorage. This is where you will put 
	the macro modules you make. Folders referenced below can be found in that folder.
	
	
	--------------------------------------
	------------ EXAMPLES ----------------

	In the Macros folder there are some example macros to get you started. These demonstrate all of the
	available API, which are also listed below.


	--------------------------------------
	------------ INSTRUCTIONS ------------

	1.	When you add a new macro module to the Macros folder, add it to the MacroOrder module table. You 
		can disable a macro without destroying the module by removing it from this list.
	
	2.	If you change a macro, check the CheckMeToRefreshMacros bool value to refresh your macros.

	3.	You can add utility modules you want to share between macros in the Util folder. The path to these
		modules from a macro module is:
	
			script.Parent.Parent.Util[moduleName]
			
	4.	The button module automatically sets ChangeHistoryService waypoints before and after button
		activation so you can undo/redo through your macro functions. However, this functionality is not
		implemented for the Boolean/Numver/String Changed function. If you implement macros that modify
		the datamodel in a macro item changed function, it would be wise to set ChangeHistoryService
		waypoints.
			

	--------------------------------------
	------------ API ---------------------

	Each macro is a module in the macros folder. The module creates and returns a macro object, which has
	a list of its contained macro items.
	
	Usage should be pretty self explanatory from the examples. I suggest you look at those first, but
	here's a comprehensive API list if needed.
	
	
	-------------------
	---- MACRO API ----
	
	Macros have the following API:
	
		1. macro.Items - a list of the macro's macro items in order of appearance
		2. macro:SetVisible(visible) - show or hide the entire macro container


	----------------------------
	---- MACRO ITEM CLASSES ----

	Macro items are GUI line items in each macro container in the plugin widget. The default available
	macro item classes are:
	
		1. Button - a button that can be connected to execute a function
		2. Title - a noninteractive text display
		3. Boolean - a boolean setting
		4. Number - a numeric setting
		5. String - a string setting
		6. Vector3 - a vector3 setting
		
	If needed, you can add custom macro item classes to the MacroItemClasses folder, but these five should
	suit most needs.
		
	
	---------------------------------
	---- SETTING UP A MACRO ITEM ----
		
	See the examples for how to set up macro items. Each is a table with keys:
	
		1. Type - string macro item type (from above list)
		2. Text - label for the macro item
		3. SettingId - only for Boolean/Number/String macro items, this is a unique string identifier used
						to save the state of the macro item input
		4. Value - only for Boolean/Number/String macro items, this is the default value for the macro 
						item input
		
	
	------------------------
	---- MACRO ITEM API ----
	
	Macro items have the following API:
	
		applicable for: Button / Title / Boolean / Number / String / Vector3
		
			1. macroItem:UpdateText(newText) - update the text label for the macro item
			2. macroItem:SetVisible(visible) - show or hide the macro item
			
		applicable for: Button
		
			3. macroItem:Activated() - called when button is clicked
			
		applicable for: Boolean / Number / String / Vector3
		
			4. macroItem:Changed(newValue, oldValue) - called when value is changed
			

--]]

 if mode=="ctf" then require(script.Parent.ArsenalLoadouts).ApplyPending(player) end
 local key=Def.PendingAttribute(mode) local id=player:GetAttribute(key)
 if Def.Valid(mode,id) then player:SetAttribute(Def.ActiveAttribute(mode),id) end
 player:SetAttribute(key,nil)
end
function Service:Start()
 if self.started then return end self.started=true
 require(script.Parent.LoadoutPreviewService).Start()
 require(script.Parent.ArsenalLoadouts).Start()
 local root=game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.Remotes
 local select=root:FindFirstChild("SelectLoadout") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent") select.Name="SelectLoadout" select.Parent=root
 select.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,mode,id)
  if player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")~=mode or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") or not Def.Valid(mode,id) then return end
  if os.clock()-(last[player] or -10)<.2 then return end last[player]=os.clock()
  player:SetAttribute(Def.PendingAttribute(mode),id)
 end)
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) last[p]=nil end)
end
return Service

ServerStorage.ControlSubsystemWork.Runti:
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local report=Instance.new("StringValue") report.Name="ControlSubsystemRuntimeReport" report.Parent=game.ReplicatedStorage
local results={} local count=0
local function check(value,name) count+=1 assert(value,name) table.insert(results,name) end
local function run()
 local deadline=os.clock()+30
 repeat task.wait(.1) until p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")=="hub" or os.clock()>deadline
 task.wait(2)
 local r=require(script.Parent.ControlRouter)
 local nav=require(script.Parent.MenuNavigation)
 local readyDeadline=os.clock()+30
 repeat task.wait(.1) until (not r:Snapshot().suspended and r:Snapshot().alive) or os.clock()>readyDeadline
 local function press(action)
  local result=r:Dispatch(action,Enum.UserInputState.Begin)
  r:Dispatch(action,Enum.UserInputState.End)
  return result
 end
 nav:OpenMenu("Resume") task.wait(.5)
 check(not r:Snapshot().modal,"Hub menu closes")
 check(r:CanMove(),"Native movement enabled outside menu")
 local oldInventory=p:GetAttribute("InventoryOpen")
 p:SetAttribute("InventoryOpen",true) task.wait(.1)
 check(r:IsBlocked() and not r:CanMove(),"Inventory blocks movement and world actions")
 check(press("ReloadInteract")==Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass,"Inventory denies interaction")
 p:SetAttribute("InventoryOpen",oldInventory)
 nav:OpenMenu("Settings") task.wait(.3)
 check(p:GetAttribute("ExperienceMenuOpen")==true,"Settings open through navigation")
 check(r.Context=="menu" and not r:CanMove(),"Settings own context and movement")
 local g=p.PlayerGui.ExperienceMenu
 local function title()
  local texts={}
  for _,v in g:GetDescendants() do
   if v:IsA("TextLabel") and (v.Name=="Title" or v.Name=="Heading") then table.insert(texts,v.Text) end
  end
  return table.concat(texts,"|")
 end
 local before=title()
 check(press("MenuNext")==Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink,"RB category action is consumed")
 task.wait(.1)
 check(title()~=before,"RB changes rendered category")
 press("MenuPrevious") task.wait(.1)
 check(press("AdminMode")==Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass,"Menu prevents admin activation")
 nav:OpenMenu("Resume") task.wait(.3)
 check(press("AdminMode")==Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink,"Admin mode can activate outside menus")
 task.wait(1)
 check(p:GetAttribute("AdminFreecam")==true,"Server accepts authorized admin spectator")
 check(r:CanMove(),"Spectator reuses normal movement")
 local controls=require(p.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule):GetControls()
 check(controls.controlsEnabled==true,"Native controls remain enabled for spectator")
 local help=p.PlayerGui.AdminCameraHelp:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
 local speedText=help.Text
 press("AdminSpeedUp") task.wait(.1)
 check(help.Text~=speedText,"Shared admin bumper adjusts speed")
 nav:OpenMenu("Settings") task.wait(.3)
 local menuSpeed=help.Text
 check(not r:CanMove(),"Menu blocks spectator movement")
 check(press("AdminSpeedUp")==Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass,"Menu blocks admin speed action")
 press("MenuNext") task.wait(.1)
 check(help.Text==menuSpeed,"Category navigation does not alter admin speed")
 nav:OpenMenu("Resume") task.wait(.3)
 press("AdminMode") task.wait(1)
 check(p:GetAttribute("AdminFreecam")==false,"Admin mode exits and restores character")
 local oldKey=r:Key("ReloadInteract","Keyboard")
 check(r:Commit("ReloadInteract","Keyboard",r:Key("Fire","Keyboard")),"Rebinding submitted")
 task.wait(.5)
 check(r:Key("Fire","Keyboard")==oldKey and r:Key("GetOutAttack","Keyboard")==oldKey,"Server preserves every conflict swap")
 check(r:Commit("ReloadInteract","Keyboard",oldKey),"Session bindings restored")
 task.wait(.3)
 local cursorCount=0
 for _,v in p.PlayerGui:GetChildren() do if v.Name=="AccessibleMenuCursor" then cursorCount+=1 end end
 check(cursorCount==1,"Only one navigation instance")
 return {passed=count,checks=results}
end
local ok,result=xpcall(run,debug.traceback)
report.Value=game.HttpService:JSONEncode({ok=ok,result=result,checks=results})

-- Only geometry and appearance are copied. Imported code is never required or cloned.
local Root=game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds
local Registry=require(Root.WeaponAssetRegistry) local Catalog=require(Root.WeaponCatalog)
local Attachments=require(Root.AttachmentCatalog) local Config=require(Root.WeaponVisualConfiguration)
local Visuals={}
local function resolve(id)
 local path=Registry[id] local v=game
 if not path then return end
 for _,name in path do v=v:FindFirstChild(name) if not v then return end end return v
end
local function geometry(source,origin,rotation)
 local model=Instance.new("Model") model.Name=source.Name
 local items=source:GetDescendants() if source:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(items,source) end
 for _,p in items do if p:IsA("BasePart") then
  local copy=p:Clone()
  for _,v in copy:GetChildren() do if not v:IsA("DataModelMesh") and not v:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") and not v:IsA("Decal") and not v:IsA("Texture") then v:Destroy() end end
  copy.CFrame=rotation*(CFrame.new(origin):Inverse()*p.CFrame)
  copy.Anchored=true copy.CanCollide=false copy.CanTouch=false copy.CanQuery=false copy.Massless=true
  local path=p:GetFullName():lower()
  if path:find("magazine") then copy:SetAttribute("ReloadGroup","Magazine") elseif path:find("bolt") or path:find("slide") or path:find("charging handle") then copy:SetAttribute("ReloadGroup","Slide") end
  copy.Parent=model
 end end return model
end
local function attach(parent,name,cf) local a=Instance.new("Attachment") a.Name=name a.CFrame=cf a.Parent=parent return a end
function Visuals.Build(id,configuration)
 local weapon=Catalog.Get(id) local source=resolve(id)
 if not weapon then source=resolve(id) end
 if not source then
  local templates=Root:FindFirstChild("LoadoutPreviews") local old=templates and templates:FindFirstChild(weapon and weapon.assetId or id)
  return old and old:Clone() or nil,"Asset indisponível."
 end
 local cf,size if source:IsA("Model") then cf,size=source:GetBoundingBox() elseif source:IsA("BasePart") then cf,size=source.CFrame,source.Size else return nil,"Modelo sem geometria." end
 local grip=source:FindFirstChild(id=="m1911" and "Grips" or "Grip",true)
 local origin=grip and grip:IsA("BasePart") and grip.Position or cf.Position
 local model=geometry(source,origin,CFrame.Angles(0,-math.pi/2,0)) model.Name=id
 if #model:GetChildren()==0 then model:Destroy() return nil,"Modelo vazio." end
 local handle=Instance.new("Part") handle.Name="Handle" handle.Size=Vector3.new(.2,.5,.25) handle.Transparency=1 handle.Anchored=true handle.CanCollide=false handle.CanTouch=false handle.CanQuery=false handle.Parent=model model.PrimaryPart=handle
 attach(handle,"RightHandGrip",CFrame.Angles(-math.pi/2,0,0))
 attach(handle,"SupportGrip",CFrame.new(-.15,.45,id=="m1911" and -.2 or -2.2)*CFrame.Angles(-math.pi/2,0,math.pi/2))
 attach(handle,"Muzzle",CFrame.new(0,id=="m1911" and .46 or .8,id=="m1911" and -1.4 or -4.12))
 if id=="m4a1" then
  attach(handle,"optic",CFrame.new(0,1.12,-.9)) attach(handle,"muzzle",CFrame.new(0,.8,-4.12)) attach(handle,"underbarrel",CFrame.new(0,.62,-2.4))
 end
 if weapon then
  local clean,err=Config.Validate(id,configuration or {},false) if not clean then model:Destroy() return nil,err end
  for slot,attachmentId in clean do
   local src=resolve(attachmentId) local mount=handle:FindFirstChild(slot)
   if not src or not mount then model:Destroy() return nil,"Ponto de montagem ausente." end
   local bound=src:IsA("Model") and select(1,src:GetBoundingBox()) or src.CFrame
   local accessory=geometry(src,bound.Position,CFrame.Angles(0,-math.pi/2,0))
   local ac,sz=accessory:GetBoundingBox()
   local anchor=slot=="optic" and ac.Position-Vector3.new(0,sz.Y*.5,0) or slot=="underbarrel" and ac.Position+Vector3.new(0,sz.Y*.5,0) or ac.Position+Vector3.new(0,0,sz.Z*.5)
   for _,p in accessory:GetChildren() do if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CFrame=mount.WorldCFrame*CFrame.new(-anchor)*p.CFrame p.Name="Accessory_"..attachmentId.."_"..p.Name p:SetAttribute("VisualAttachmentId",attachmentId) p.Parent=model end end accessory:Destroy()
   if slot=="optic" then for _,p in model:GetChildren() do if p.Name=="Rear Sight" or p.Name=="Front Sight" then p.Transparency=1 end end end
  end
 end
 model:SetAttribute("VisualWeaponId",id) return model
end
function Visuals.Apply(tool,id,configuration)
 local weapon=Catalog.Get(id) if not weapon or weapon.sourcePack=="Crossgrounds" then return tool end
 local model,err=Visuals.Build(id,configuration) if not model then return nil,err end
 local handle=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") if not handle then model:Destroy() return nil,"Handle ausente." end
 local original=handle.CFrame
 for _,v in tool:GetChildren() do if v:IsA("BasePart") and v~=handle then v:Destroy() end end
 for _,v in model.Handle:GetChildren() do if v:IsA("Attachment") then local old=handle:FindFirstChild(v.Name) if old then old:Destroy() end v:Clone().Parent=handle end end
 for _,p in model:GetChildren() do if p:IsA("BasePart") and p~=model.Handle then
  p.CFrame=original*p.CFrame p.Anchored=false p.Parent=tool
  local joint=Instance.new("Motor6D") joint.Name=p:GetAttribute("ReloadGroup") or "VisualPart" joint.Part0=handle joint.Part1=p joint.C0=original:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame) joint.Parent=p
 end end
 tool.Name=weapon.name tool.ToolTip=weapon.name.." · adaptação visual; regras atuais preservadas"
 tool:SetAttribute("VisualWeaponId",id) tool:SetAttribute("VisualConfiguration",game.HttpService:JSONEncode(configuration or {})) tool:SetAttribute("TwoHanded",true)
 model:Destroy() return tool
end
return Visuals

local View={}
local cyan=Color3.fromRGB(63,226,232) local death=Color3.fromRGB(255,151,102)

local function short(s) s=tostring(s or "") local at=utf8.offset(s,17) return at and s:sub(1,at-1).."…" or s end
local function team(name) return name=="Blue" and "#83bcff" or name=="Red" and "#ff9c92" or "#eaf3fc" end
local function skull(parent)
 local icon=Instance.new("Frame") icon.Name="Headshot" icon.BackgroundTransparency=1 icon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(22,24) icon.Position=UDim2.new(1,-27,0,9) icon.Parent=parent
 local function shape(name,x,y,w,h,color,round)
  local f=Instance.new("Frame") f.Name=name f.BackgroundColor3=color f.BorderSizePixel=0 f.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y) f.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h) f.Parent=icon
  if round then local c=Instance.new("UICorner") c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,round) c.Parent=f end
 end
 local orange=Color3.fromRGB(255,153,51) local hole=Color3.fromRGB(25,30,37)
 shape("Cranium",2,0,18,17,orange,7) shape("Jaw",5,13,12,8,orange,2)
 shape("LeftEye",5,7,4,5,hole,2) shape("RightEye",13,7,4,5,hole,2) shape("Nose",10,12,2,3,hole,1)
 shape("Tooth1",8,18,1,3,hole) shape("Tooth2",13,18,1,3,hole)
end
function View.new(parent,player,limit,lifetime)
 local self={Rows={}}
 local layout=Instance.new("UIListLayout") layout.Padding=UDim.new(0,5) layout.HorizontalAlignment=Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder layout.Parent=parent
 local sequence=0
 function self:Add(data)
  local kill=data.killerUserId==player.UserId local died=data.victimUserId==player.UserId local personal=kill or died
  sequence+=1
  local row=Instance.new("Frame") row.Name=personal and "PersonalElimination" or "Elimination" row:SetAttribute("CascadeDecoration",true) row:SetAttribute("LocalKill",kill) row:SetAttribute("LocalDeath",died) row.LayoutOrder=sequence row.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0) row.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y row.BorderSizePixel=0 row.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(11,23,31) row.BackgroundTransparency=personal and .22 or .65 row.Parent=parent
  local corner=Instance.new("UICorner") corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6) corner.Parent=row

-- Approximate world illumination for the isolated weapon viewport.
local Probe={}
local Lighting=game:GetService("Lighting")
local lights={}
local function added(v) if v:IsA("Light") then lights[v]=true end end
for _,v in workspace:GetDescendants() do added(v) end
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(added) workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(v) lights[v]=nil end)
local function clamp(c) return Color3.new(math.clamp(c.R,.015,1),math.clamp(c.G,.015,1),math.clamp(c.B,.015,1)) end
function Probe.Sample(camera,character)
 local p=camera.CFrame.Position local ray=RaycastParams.new() ray.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude ray.FilterDescendantsInstances=character and {character} or {}
 local roof=workspace:Raycast(p,Vector3.new(0,100,0),ray)
 local ambient=Lighting.Ambient:Lerp(Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,roof and 0 or .65)
 local sun=Lighting:GetSunDirection()
 local exposed=sun.Y>0 and not workspace:Raycast(p,sun*300,ray)
 local direct=exposed and math.clamp(Lighting.Brightness*.18,.1,.55) or .03
 local tint=Color3.new(direct,direct,direct)
 local sampled=0
 for light in lights do
  if light.Parent and light.Enabled then
   local parent=light.Parent
   local position=parent:IsA("Attachment") and parent.WorldPosition or parent:IsA("BasePart") and parent.Position
   local distance=position and (position-p).Magnitude
   if distance and distance<math.min(light.Range,50) then
    local hit=workspace:Raycast(p,position-p,ray)
    if not hit or hit.Instance==parent or parent:IsA("Attachment") and hit.Instance==parent.Parent then
     local strength=math.min(.65,light.Brightness*.12*(1-distance/light.Range)^2)
     ambient=Color3.new(ambient.R+light.Color.R*strength,ambient.G+light.Color.G*strength,ambient.B+light.Color.B*strength)
     sampled+=1 if sampled>=12 then break end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return clamp(ambient),clamp(tint),camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(-sun)
end
return Probe

function Presentation:GetAimViewport()
 local v=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
 if v.X<2 or v.Y<2 then return v*.5 end
 local point
 if locked then point=v*.5
 elseif InputMode:Get()==Enum.PreferredInput.Touch then point=freePoint or v*.5
 elseif InputMode:Get()==Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad then
  point=freePoint or v*.5

 if not point or point.X<0 or point.Y<0 then point=freePoint or v*.5 end
 return Vector2.new(math.clamp(point.X,1,v.X-1),math.clamp(point.Y,1,v.Y-1))

function Presentation:ConfirmShot(message)
 local entry=predicted[message.shotId]
 if not entry then return end
 if not message.accepted then
  for _,effect in entry.effects do Effects.CancelTrace(effect) end
  predicted[message.shotId]=nil
 elseif Shot.Finite(message.endpoint) then
  player:SetAttribute("AuthoritativeShotEndpoint",message.endpoint)
 end
end
function Presentation:RenderShot(message)
 if not Scope:IsCombat() or typeof(message)~="table" or not Shot.Finite(message.endpoint) or not Shot.Finite(message.origin) then return end
 if message.visual and message.visual.SourcePack=="ProjectileTest" and message.phase~="launch" and message.reason~="range" then require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.BlasterEffects).Impact(message.endpoint,message.normal,message.reason=="targets") end
 local own=message.actor==player.Character
 local entry=own and predicted[message.shotId]
 if entry then
  if message.phase~="launch" then
   local index=(entry.confirmed or 0)+1 entry.confirmed=index
   local effect=entry.effects[index]
   Effects.CorrectTrace(effect,message.endpoint)
   player:SetAttribute("AuthoritativeShotEndpoint",message.endpoint)
   if index>=entry.pellets then predicted[message.shotId]=nil end
  end
  return
 end
 local tool=message.tool
 -- A late packet after switching/death must never kick or flash the new weapon.
 if own then return end
 if message.phase=="impact" and message.shotType=="projectile" then
  Effects.FinishProjectile(message.actor,message.shotId,message.endpoint) return
 end
 local already=message.actor and message.shotId and remoteShots[message.actor]==message.shotId
 if tool and tool.Parent and not already then tool:SetAttribute("PresentationShotAt",workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) Effects.Play(tool) Effects.PlaySound(tool) end
 if message.actor and message.shotId then remoteShots[message.actor]=message.shotId end
 if message.phase=="launch" then
  Effects.Projectile(message.actor,message.shotId,message.origin,message.direction,message)
 else Effects.Trace(message.origin,message.endpoint,message.color,message.visual) end
end
function Presentation:PredictShot(shotId,tool,target,request)
 if not tool or not tool.Parent then return end
 for id,entry in predicted do if os.clock()>entry.expires then for _,effect in entry.effects do Effects.CancelTrace(effect) end predicted[id]=nil end end
 local data = Stats.ResolveTool(tool)
 local config = Shot.Config(data)
 local classify=clientRelation
 local origin,blocked=Query.ResolveOrigin(player.Character,tool,target,self:GetShotOrigin(),classify)
 if not origin or (target-origin).Magnitude<.05 then return end
 local entry={at=os.clock(),expires=os.clock()+(config.kind=="projectile" and config.lifetime+1 or 3),effects={},pellets=config.pellets} predicted[shotId]=entry
 self:Kick(tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId"))
 Effects.PlaySound(tool) if not firstPerson then Effects.Play(tool) end
 for pellet=1,config.pellets do
  local direction=Shot.Direction(target-origin,AttachmentEffects.Spread(data,tool),tool:GetAttribute("ShotSeed"),shotId,pellet,config.pellets)
  local endpoint
  if blocked then endpoint=blocked.Position
  elseif config.kind=="projectile" then
   local effect=Effects.Projectile(player.Character,shotId,origin,direction,{speed=config.speed,acceleration=config.acceleration,lifetime=config.lifetime,range=config.range,visual=config.visual,
    shooter=player.Character,classify=classify,radius=config.radius,maxTargets=data.MaxTargets,penetrationLoss=data.PenetrationLoss})
   table.insert(entry.effects,effect) endpoint=origin+direction*config.range
  else
   endpoint=Query.Trace({origin=origin,direction=direction,range=config.range,shooter=player.Character,ignore=viewmodel and {viewmodel} or {},classify=classify,radius=config.radius,maxTargets=data.MaxTargets,penetrationLoss=data.PenetrationLoss}).endpoint
  end
  if blocked or config.kind~="projectile" then table.insert(entry.effects,Effects.Trace(origin,endpoint,nil,config.visual)) end
  player:SetAttribute("LastTraceOrigin",origin) player:SetAttribute("LastTraceEndpoint",endpoint)
 end
 player:SetAttribute("LastPredictedShotId",shotId) player:SetAttribute("LastPredictedShotAt",os.clock())
end

function Presentation:Kick(id)

 if data.Kind=="Gun" then
  firedAt=os.clock()
  tool:SetAttribute("PresentationShotAt",workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
  if firstPerson and renderer then renderer:Flash() end
  local profile=id=="ax_50" and AX50.Recoil or AttachmentEffects.Recoil(data,tool)
  if id=="ax_50" then axCamera:Kick(math.random()<.5 and -1 or 1,aiming) end
  local low = data.CameraRecoilMin
  local high = data.CameraRecoilMax
	if id~="ax_50" and typeof(low) == "Vector2" and typeof(high) == "Vector2" then
		local horizontal = low.X + math.random() * (high.X - low.X)
		local vertical = low.Y + math.random() * (high.Y - low.Y)

		sourceRecoil += Vector2.new(
			math.rad(-horizontal),
			math.rad(vertical)
		)

	end
  spring:Kick(profile,math.random()<.5 and -1 or 1)
 else swingAt=os.clock() end
end

local function turn(dx,dy)
 local ads=aiming and setting("AimSensitivity") or 1
 local delta=Vector2.new(dx,dy)
 if InputMode:Get()==Enum.PreferredInput.Touch then
  delta=Analog.TouchRadians(delta,workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X,setting("LookSensitivity"),ads)
  local now=os.clock() local sampleDt=math.clamp(now-touchSampleAt,.008,.05) touchSampleAt=now
  touchIntent=Vector2.new(-delta.X,-delta.Y)/(sampleDt*2.4)
  if touchIntent.Magnitude>1 then touchIntent=touchIntent.Unit end
  delta*=assistFriction
 else delta*=.0026*setting("LookSensitivity")*ads end
 yaw-=delta.X pitch=math.clamp(pitch-delta.Y,math.rad(-72),math.rad(72))
end
