-- Weapon rendering has its own camera/depth buffer. World walls cannot twist or clip it.
local Renderer={} Renderer.__index=Renderer
local Probe=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("LocalLightingProbe"))
local Reload=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponReloadMotion)
local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Motion=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.MotionPreferences)
local Hold=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponHold)
local ADS=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ADSTransition)
local AX50=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.AX50Motion)
local AXOptics=require(script.Parent.AX50Optics)
local function safePart(p)
 p.Anchored=true p.CanCollide=false p.CanTouch=false p.CanQuery=false p.CastShadow=false p.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
end
function Renderer.new(tool)
 if tool:GetAttribute("SourcePack")=="ProjectileTest" then return require(script.Parent.BlasterRenderer).new(tool) end
 local self=setmetatable({parts={},arms={},wall=0,flashUntil=0,tool=tool},Renderer)
 local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui") gui.Name="FirstPersonDisplay" gui.DisplayOrder=-10 gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true gui.ResetOnSpawn=false gui.Parent=player.PlayerGui self.gui=gui
 local viewport=Instance.new("ViewportFrame") viewport.Name="WeaponViewport" viewport.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) viewport.BackgroundTransparency=1 viewport.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(170,180,190) viewport.LightColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,244,223) viewport.LightDirection=Vector3.new(-1,-2,-3) viewport.Parent=gui self.viewport=viewport
 local camera=Instance.new("Camera") camera.CFrame=CFrame.new() camera.FieldOfView=70 camera.Parent=viewport viewport.CurrentCamera=camera self.camera=camera
 local world=Instance.new("WorldModel") world.Parent=viewport
 local model=Instance.new("Model") model.Name="FirstPersonWeapon" model.Parent=world self.Model=model
 local original=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") if not original then self:Destroy() return end
 for _,v in tool:GetChildren() do if v:IsA("BasePart") then
  local p=v:Clone()
  for _,child in p:GetDescendants() do
   if child:IsA("BaseScript") or child:IsA("Sound") or child:IsA("WeldConstraint") or child:IsA("JointInstance") or child:IsA("Trail") or child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or child:IsA("Beam") or child:IsA("Light") then child:Destroy() end
  end
  safePart(p) p.CFrame=original.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(v.CFrame) p.Parent=model
 end end
 local handle=model:FindFirstChild("Handle") model.PrimaryPart=handle
 model:ScaleTo(Hold.IsPistol(tool) and .9 or tool:GetAttribute("WeaponKind")=="Gun" and .72 or .65)
 for _,p in model:GetChildren() do if p:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(self.parts,{part=p,rest=p.CFrame,group=p:GetAttribute("ReloadGroup"),reloadOnly=p:GetAttribute("ReloadOnly")}) end end
 self.handle=handle self.scale=model:GetScale() self.reloadMotion=Reload.new()
 self.ax50=tool:GetAttribute("WeaponId")=="ax_50"
 if self.ax50 and not tool:GetAttribute("OpticalAttachmentId") then self.optic=AXOptics.Build(model,self.parts) end
 local skin=Instance.new("Model") skin.Name="BlockyAvatarArms" skin.Parent=world self.skin=skin
 local humanoid=Instance.new("Humanoid") humanoid.RequiresNeck=false humanoid.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None humanoid.Parent=skin
 local character=player.Character
 for _,class in {"Shirt","BodyColors"} do local v=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass(class) if v then v:Clone().Parent=skin end end
 local function part(name,size,color)
  local p=Instance.new("Part") p.Name=name p.Size=size p.Color=color p.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic safePart(p) p.Parent=skin return p
 end
 for _,name in {"Torso","Head","Left Leg","Right Leg","HumanoidRootPart"} do local p=part(name,Vector3.one,Color3.new()) p.Transparency=1 end
 for _,side in {"Right","Left"} do
  local source=character and (character:FindFirstChild(side.." Arm") or character:FindFirstChild(side.."UpperArm") or character:FindFirstChild(side.."LowerArm"))
  local color=source and source.Color or Color3.fromRGB(234,184,146)
  local arm=part(side.." Arm",Vector3.new(.43,1.5,.46),color)
  -- Classic shirt is applied by the R6-named parts; source meshes are intentionally absent.
  local grip=handle:FindFirstChild(side=="Right" and "RightHandGrip" or "SupportGrip")

  if grip then table.insert(self.arms,{part=arm,side=side,hand=grip.Position}) else arm.Transparency=1 end
 end
 local flash=Instance.new("Part") flash.Name="MuzzleFlash" flash.Size=Vector3.new(.18,.18,.55) flash.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,222,123) flash.Material=Enum.Material.Neon flash.Transparency=1 safePart(flash) flash.Parent=model self.flash=flash
 return self
end
function Renderer:SetVisible(on) if self.gui then self.gui.Enabled=on end end
function Renderer:Flash() self.flashUntil=os.clock()+.045 end
function Renderer:Render(dt,camera,character,params)
 self:SetVisible(true)
 local transition=ADS.Sample(params.sight and params.ads or 0,params.sight)
 transition.reticle=params.sightActive and 1 or 0
 transition.lens=params.sightActive and 1 or 0
 if self.ocular then for _,v in self.ocular do v.part.Transparency=1-transition.lens end end
 local weight=Motion.WeaponWeight(player)
 local projection,depth=Motion.WeaponProjection(camera.FieldOfView,Motion.Get(player,"WeaponFOVScale",1))
 self.camera.FieldOfView=projection
 local function softened(cf) return Motion.Transform(cf,weight) end
 self.lightElapsed=(self.lightElapsed or 0)+dt
 if self.lightElapsed>.15 then
  self.lightElapsed=0 self.ambient,self.sunTint,self.sunDirection=Probe.Sample(camera,character)
 end
 if self.ambient then
  self.viewport.Ambient=self.optic and Color3.new(math.max(.30,self.ambient.R),math.max(.30,self.ambient.G),math.max(.30,self.ambient.B)) or self.ambient
  self.viewport.LightColor=self.optic and Color3.fromRGB(210,214,219) or self.sunTint
 end
 self.viewport.LightDirection=camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(-game.Lighting:GetSunDirection())
 local rp=RaycastParams.new() rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude rp.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
 local hit=workspace:Raycast(camera.CFrame.Position,camera.CFrame.LookVector*3,rp)
 local proximity=hit and math.clamp((2.4-hit.Distance)/1.6,0,1) or 0
 self.wall+=(proximity-self.wall)*(1-math.exp(-dt*13))
 local reloading=self.tool:GetAttribute("Reloading")
 local duration=self.tool:GetAttribute("ReloadDuration") or .9
 local t=reloading and math.clamp((workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-(self.tool:GetAttribute("ReloadStartedAt") or workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))/duration,0,1) or 0
 local reload=self.reloadMotion:Update(self.tool,dt,workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
 for key,value in reload do if typeof(value)=="CFrame" then reload[key]=softened(value) elseif typeof(value)=="Vector3" then reload[key]=value*weight end end
 local pistol=Hold.IsPistol(self.tool) local gun=self.tool:GetAttribute("WeaponKind")=="Gun"
 local lower=pistol and -.98 or gun and -1.18 or -1.30
 -- Counter the shared ADS lift only in the FP display, keeping the sightline open.
 local base=CFrame.new(pistol and .55 or .65,lower-.24*(params.ads or 0),(pistol and -1.7 or -2.1)*depth)
 local arc=(params.arc or 0)*weight
 local action=params.action or {weapon=CFrame.new(),slide=CFrame.new(),support=Vector3.zero}
 local cf=base*softened(action.weapon)*softened(params.runPose or CFrame.new())*reload.weapon*CFrame.new(-arc*.7,self.wall*.12-arc*.35,self.wall*.45+(params.recoil or 0)*weight)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad((params.pitch or 0)*weight+self.wall*55-arc*65),0,math.rad((params.roll or 0)*weight-arc*55))
 local bolt=self.ax50 and AX50.Bolt(params.firedAgo or 100,params.cooldown,reloading) or nil
 if params.sight and params.sight.reticle=="RedDot" then
  for _,entry in self.parts do
   if entry.part:GetAttribute("VisualAttachmentSlot")=="optic" and entry.part.Name:find("Lens",1,true) then
    local eye=entry.rest.Position
    cf=cf:Lerp(CFrame.new(-eye.X,-eye.Y,-eye.Z-.65),transition.alignment)
    break
   end
  end
 end
 if bolt then cf*=softened(bolt.weapon) end
 if self.optic then
  local aligned=AXOptics.Alignment(self.optic,projection)
  local settle=transition.alignment*(1-reload.active)
  local kick=CFrame.new(0,0,(params.recoil or 0)*.12*weight)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad((params.pitch or 0)*.13*weight),0,math.rad((params.roll or 0)*.2*weight))
  local breath=math.sin(os.clock()*1.4)*.0015*weight
  local tilt=math.rad(-4)*transition.alignment
  aligned=aligned*CFrame.new(self.optic.center)*CFrame.Angles(tilt,0,0)*CFrame.new(-self.optic.center)
  aligned=aligned*CFrame.new(breath,breath*.55,0)*softened(bolt.weapon)*kick
  cf=cf:Lerp(aligned,settle)
 end
 self.opticalAperture=self.optic and params.sight and AXOptics.Project(self.optic,cf,projection,camera.ViewportSize) or nil
 if self.opticalAperture then self.opticalAperture.visible=transition.reticle*(1-reload.active)*(1-bolt.active*.9) end
 if self.optic then for _,p in self.optic.parts do p.part.CFrame=cf*p.rest p.part.Transparency=1-transition.lens end end
 for _,entry in self.parts do
  local pivot=self.handle:FindFirstChild('ReloadPivot_'..tostring(entry.group))
  local transform=Reload.PartTransform(reload,entry.group,pivot and pivot.Position)
  if entry.group=='Slide' then transform*=softened(action.slide) end
  local cap=entry.part.Name=="Lens" or entry.part.Name=="Scope Base" or entry.part.Name=="Scope Base Pt 2"
  if self.ax50 and entry.part.Name=='Bolt' and not reloading then
   local pivot=Vector3.new(0,entry.rest.Y,entry.rest.Z)
   transform=CFrame.new(pivot)*softened(bolt.bolt)*CFrame.new(-pivot)
  end
  local bore=self.optic and (entry.part.Name=='Bolt' or entry.part.Name=='Base' or entry.part.Name=='Barrel' or entry.part.Name=='Muzzle' or entry.part.Name=='Rails' or entry.part.Name=='Handguard' or entry.part.Name=='Bullet')
  local reloadTransparency=reload.visibility and reload.visibility[entry.group] or 0
  local reflexLens=params.sight and params.sight.reticle=="RedDot" and entry.part:GetAttribute("VisualAttachmentSlot")=="optic" and entry.part.Name:find("Lens",1,true)
  entry.part.LocalTransparencyModifier=math.max(reloadTransparency*weight,reflexLens and transition.lens or entry.closedOptic and transition.lens or self.optic and 0 or params.sight and params.sight.hideWeapon and transition.lens or cap and transition.lens or 0)
  entry.part.CFrame=cf*transform*entry.rest
  if entry.reloadOnly then entry.part.Transparency=reload.active>.02 and 0 or 1 end
 end
 for _,arm in self.arms do
  arm.part.LocalTransparencyModifier=self.optic and 0 or transition.arms
  local side=arm.side=="Right" and 1 or -1
  local hand=arm.hand+(side<0 and reload.hand+(action.support or Vector3.zero)*weight or bolt and bolt.hand*weight or Vector3.zero)
  local elbow=Vector3.new(side*(.9+(.18+.36*math.sin(params.runPhase or 0))*(params.runWeight or 0)*weight),-.65,1.25)

  local a=cf:PointToWorldSpace(hand) local b=cf:PointToWorldSpace(elbow*self.scale)
  arm.part.Size=Vector3.new(.43,(a-b).Magnitude,.46)
  arm.part.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt((a+b)*.5,a)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
 end
 local muzzle=self.handle:FindFirstChild("Muzzle")
 if muzzle then
  self.flash.CFrame=muzzle.WorldCFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,-.2)
  self.flash.Transparency=os.clock()<self.flashUntil and .1 or 1
 end
 player:SetAttribute("WeaponWallRaise",self.wall) player:SetAttribute("WeaponRenderer","ViewportFrame")
end
function Renderer:ShotOrigin(worldCamera)
 local muzzle=self.handle and self.handle:FindFirstChild("Muzzle") if not muzzle then return end
 local p=self.camera.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(muzzle.WorldPosition) local depth=-p.Z
 if depth<=.1 then return end
 local v=worldCamera.ViewportSize local tan=math.tan(math.rad(self.camera.FieldOfView*.5))
 local x=.5+p.X/(depth*2*tan*v.X/math.max(1,v.Y)) local y=.5-p.Y/(depth*2*tan)
 local ray=worldCamera:ViewportPointToRay(x*v.X,y*v.Y)
 return worldCamera.CFrame.Position+ray.Direction*math.min(depth,3)
end
function Renderer:Destroy() if self.gui then self.gui:Destroy() end self.gui=nil end
return Renderer

local Playlist={}
local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Scope=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ModeScope"))
local Settings=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ExperienceSettings)
local Catalog=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.LobbyMusicCatalog)
local changed=Instance.new("BindableEvent") Playlist.Changed=changed.Event
Playlist.Tracks={} Playlist.Paused=false Playlist.Shuffle=false Playlist.Index=1 Playlist.State="Preparando"
for _,track in Catalog do local copy=table.clone(track) copy.enabled=track.enabled~=false table.insert(Playlist.Tracks,copy) end
local sound local retired={} local failed={} local loadingSince local lastAllowed
local function allowed() return Scope:IsHub() and not player:GetAttribute("InArena") and not player:GetAttribute("ArenaPlaying") end
local function emit()
 script:SetAttribute("CurrentTrack",Playlist.Tracks[Playlist.Index] and Playlist.Tracks[Playlist.Index].id)
 script:SetAttribute("PlaybackState",Playlist.State) changed:Fire()
end
function Playlist:Snapshot()
 return {tracks=self.Tracks,index=self.Index,paused=self.Paused,shuffle=self.Shuffle,state=self.State,active=allowed()}
end
function Playlist:Select(id,automatic)
 local index for i,t in self.Tracks do if t.id==id then index=i break end end
 if not index then return false end
 -- Listening to a disabled candidate is a preview; inclusion stays explicit.
 self.Index=index
 if not automatic then self.Paused=false failed[id]=nil end
 if sound then table.insert(retired,{sound=sound,started=os.clock()}) end
 sound=Instance.new("Sound") sound.Name="CrossgroundsLobbyTrack" sound.SoundId=self.Tracks[index].soundId sound.Volume=0 sound.Looped=false sound.Parent=game.SoundService self.Sound=sound loadingSince=nil
 local voice=sound
 sound.Ended:Connect(function() if self.Sound==voice then self:Next(1,true) end end)
 self.State=allowed() and "Carregando" or "Pausada durante a partida" emit()
 return true
end
function Playlist:Next(step,automatic)
 local options={}
 for offset=1,#self.Tracks do

  local choices={} for _,i in options do if i~=self.Index then table.insert(choices,i) end end
  index=choices[math.random(1,#choices)]

local Animation={}
local Players=game:GetService("Players")local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local Preferences=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.MotionPreferences)
local T=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.GetOutPrototype)
local function angles(x,y,z)return CFrame.Angles(math.rad(x or 0),math.rad(y or 0),math.rad(z or 0))end
local frames={
 {rightshoulder=angles(-170,14,12),leftshoulder=angles(-110,-18,-26),rightelbow=angles(-15),leftelbow=angles(-95),righthip=angles(8,8,7),lefthip=angles(35,-10,-14),rightknee=angles(-15),leftknee=angles(-75)},
 {rightshoulder=angles(-145,8,22),leftshoulder=angles(-145,-8,-22),rightelbow=angles(-65),leftelbow=angles(-45),righthip=angles(22,8,9),lefthip=angles(18,-8,-9),rightknee=angles(-50),leftknee=angles(-25)},
 {rightshoulder=angles(-110,18,26),leftshoulder=angles(-170,-14,-12),rightelbow=angles(-95),leftelbow=angles(-15),righthip=angles(35,10,14),lefthip=angles(8,-8,-7),rightknee=angles(-75),leftknee=angles(-15)},
 {rightshoulder=angles(-145,8,22),leftshoulder=angles(-145,-8,-22),rightelbow=angles(-45),leftelbow=angles(-65),righthip=angles(18,8,9),lefthip=angles(22,-8,-9),rightknee=angles(-25),leftknee=angles(-50)},
}
local rest={rightshoulder=angles(-150,10,16),leftshoulder=angles(-150,-10,-16),rightelbow=angles(-45),leftelbow=angles(-45),righthip=angles(5,4,4),lefthip=angles(5,-4,-4),rightknee=angles(-12),leftknee=angles(-12),neck=angles(70)}
local limp={rightshoulder=angles(-30,0,34),leftshoulder=angles(-40,0,-40),rightelbow=angles(-25),leftelbow=angles(-35),righthip=angles(-8,0,8),lefthip=angles(-15,0,-10),rightknee=angles(20),leftknee=angles(30),neck=angles(8)}
local function sample(name,phase,movement)
 local index=phase*4 local first=math.floor(index)%4+1 local nextIndex=first%4+1
 local a=frames[first][name]or rest[name]or CFrame.identity local b=frames[nextIndex][name]or rest[name]or CFrame.identity
 local t=index%1 t=t*t*(3-2*t)

function Animation:Start()
 if self.started then return end self.started=true
 local rigs={}local applied={}
 Run.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
  local seen={}local live={}
  for _,player in Players:GetPlayers()do
   local character=player.Character
   if character and player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")=="get_out"then
    live[player]=true local rig=rigs[player]
    if not rig or rig.character~=character then
     if rig and rig.connection then rig.connection:Disconnect()end

    local clipCrawl=crawling or not low and rig.lastClip=="crawl"

local Lighting=game:GetService("Lighting")

local originalShadows=Lighting.GlobalShadows
local originals=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local connections={} local own={} local running=true local applying=false
local function effect(class,name)
 local v=Instance.new(class) v.Name=name own[v]=true v.Parent=Lighting return v
end
local bloom=effect("BloomEffect","CrossgroundsQualityBloom")
bloom.Size=20 bloom.Threshold=1.5
bloom.Enabled=false
local rays=effect("SunRaysEffect","CrossgroundsQualitySunRays")
rays.Spread=.8
rays.Enabled=false
local color=effect("ColorCorrectionEffect","CrossgroundsQualityColor")
local dof=effect("DepthOfFieldEffect","CrossgroundsPhotoDepth")
dof.Enabled=false dof.FocusDistance=25 dof.InFocusRadius=20 dof.NearIntensity=0 dof.FarIntensity=.12
local quality=Profiles.Default
local function capture(v,prop)
 local record=originals[v]
 if not record then record={} originals[v]=record end
 if record[prop]==nil then record[prop]=v[prop] end
 return record[prop]
end
local function tune(v)
 if own[v] then return end
 if v:IsA("Light") and v:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
  v.Shadows=capture(v,"Shadows") and Profiles.Get(quality).LightShadows
 elseif v:IsA("PostEffect") and (v.Parent==Lighting or v.Parent==workspace.CurrentCamera) and not v:IsA("BlurEffect") then
  capture(v,"Enabled") v.Enabled=false
 elseif Collection:HasTag(v,"CrossgroundsQualityCosmetic") and (v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") or v:IsA("Beam")) then
  local minimum=tonumber(v:GetAttribute("MinGraphicsQuality")) or 3
  v.Enabled=capture(v,"Enabled") and quality>=minimum
 end
end
local function apply()
 if applying or not running then return end applying=true
 local value=player:GetAttribute("SettingGraphicsQuality")
 quality=typeof(value)=="number" and math.clamp(math.floor(value),1,4) or Profiles.Default
 local p=Profiles.Get(quality)
 Lighting.GlobalShadows=originalShadows and p.Shadows
 bloom.Intensity=p.Bloom bloom.Enabled=p.Bloom>0
 rays.Intensity=p.Rays rays.Enabled=p.Rays>0
 color.Saturation=p.Saturation color.Contrast=p.Contrast
 dof.Enabled=quality==4 and player:GetAttribute("AdminFreecam")==true
 player:SetAttribute("GraphicsProfileActive",p.Name)
 for v in originals do if v.Parent then tune(v) end end
 applying=false
end
-- Scan once; streamed lights and tagged cosmetic effects are handled incrementally.
for i,v in workspace:GetDescendants() do tune(v) if i%1000==0 then task.wait() end end
for _,v in Lighting:GetChildren() do tune(v) end
for _,v in Collection:GetTagged("CrossgroundsQualityCosmetic") do tune(v) end

hook(workspace.DescendantAdded,tune)
hook(Lighting.ChildAdded,tune)
hook(Collection:GetInstanceAddedSignal("CrossgroundsQualityCosmetic"),tune)

hook(player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("AdminFreecam"),apply)

cameraChanged()

 if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end

  local fallback=Instance.new("Sound") fallback.Name=primary.Name.."Fallback" fallback.SoundId=data.fallback fallback.Volume=0 fallback.Parent=SoundService

local Players=game:GetService("Players") local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local Preferences=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.MotionPreferences)
local Motion=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.LocomotionMotion)
local records=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function reset(r)
 for _,entry in r.joints do
  if entry.joint.Parent and entry.applied and entry.joint.Transform==entry.applied then entry.joint.Transform=entry.base end
  entry.applied=nil
 end
end
Run.PreAnimation:Connect(function() for _,r in records do reset(r) end end)
Run.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
 for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do
  local c=p.Character local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") local root=c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local active=c and (p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")=="ctf" and p:GetAttribute("InMatch") or p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")=="arena" and p:GetAttribute("ArenaPlaying"))
  local simple=Preferences.CharacterWeight(Players.LocalPlayer)
 local getOut=p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")=="get_out"
 if getOut and simple<1 and (p:GetAttribute("GetOutPosture")==nil or p:GetAttribute("GetOutPosture")=="Standing") then active=true end
 local r=c and records[c]
  if not active or not h or not root or h.Health<=0 or h.Sit then
   if r then reset(r) records[c]=nil end
  else
   if not r then r={motion=Motion.new(),joints={},refresh=0} records[c]=r end
   if os.clock()>=r.refresh then
    reset(r) r.joints={} r.refresh=os.clock()+1
    for _,name in {"LeftHip","RightHip","LeftKnee","RightKnee","LeftAnkle","RightAnkle","Waist","LeftShoulder","RightShoulder","LeftElbow","RightElbow","Neck","Left Hip","Right Hip","Left Shoulder","Right Shoulder"} do
     local j=c:FindFirstChild(name,true)
     if j and (j:IsA("Motor6D") or j:IsA("AnimationConstraint")) then r.joints[name]={joint=j} end
    end
   end
   local v=root.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity)
   local m=r.motion:Update(dt,v,h.FloorMaterial~=Enum.Material.Air,c:GetAttribute("SlideActive")==true)
   local function apply(name,offset,replace)
    local e=r.joints[name] if not e or not e.joint.Parent then return end
    e.base=e.applied and e.base or e.joint.Transform
    local base=Preferences.Transform(e.base,simple) local delta=Preferences.Transform(offset,simple)
    e.applied=replace and delta or base*delta e.joint.Transform=e.applied e.applied=e.joint.Transform
   end
   if simple<1 then for name in r.joints do apply(name,CFrame.identity) end end
   if getOut then continue end
   if m.slide>.01 then
    local w=m.slide
    apply("Waist",CFrame.new(0,-.28*w,0)*CFrame.Angles(-.32*w,0,-.12*w))
    apply("LeftHip",CFrame.Angles(-1.1*w,0,-.12*w),true)
    apply("RightHip",CFrame.Angles(-.38*w,0,.22*w),true)
    apply("LeftKnee",CFrame.Angles(.3*w,0,0),true) apply("RightKnee",CFrame.Angles(1.25*w,0,0),true)
   elseif h.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air then
    local fall=v.Y<0
    apply("LeftHip",CFrame.Angles(fall and -.15 or -.55,0,-.04))
    apply("RightHip",CFrame.Angles(fall and .12 or .28,0,.04))
    apply("LeftKnee",CFrame.Angles(fall and .22 or .5,0,0))
   else
    local stride=math.sin(m.phase)*m.weight
    local side=m.side local backward=math.max(0,-m.forward)
    -- Cardinal direction changes hips/feet, not just the facing of a forward run.
    apply("LeftHip",CFrame.Angles(-stride*.18*backward,side*.28*m.weight,-stride*side*.30))
    apply("RightHip",CFrame.Angles(stride*.18*backward,side*.28*m.weight,stride*side*.30))
    apply("Waist",CFrame.new(0,-m.land*.18,0)*CFrame.Angles(m.land*.12,side*.10*m.weight,-side*.07*m.weight))
    apply("LeftKnee",CFrame.Angles(m.land*.3,0,0)) apply("RightKnee",CFrame.Angles(m.land*.3,0,0))
   end
  end
 end
end)

function Cascade:Resize(animate)
 local v=self.Backdrop.AbsoluteSize if v.X<200 or v.Y<150 then v=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize end
 v=Theme.MenuBounds(v)
 local w=math.min(1120,v.X-32) local h=math.min(660,v.Y-40) self.Panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h)

 local narrow=w<720
 local n=#self.Stack self.Panel:SetAttribute("CascadeDepth",n) local step=218
 if step*(n-1)+330>w then step=math.max(28,(w-math.min(330,w-(n-1)*28))/math.max(1,n-1)) end
 for _,p in self.Panes do p.Frame.Visible=false end
 for i,id in self.Stack do
  local p=self.Panes[id] local x=(i-1)*step local target=UDim2.fromOffset(x,38+(i-1)*6)

  if id=="RootPane" then

   local buttons={} for _,v in p.List:GetChildren() do if v:IsA("TextButton") then table.insert(buttons,v) end end
   for _,b in buttons do b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,math.clamp((p.Frame.Size.Y.Offset-20-math.max(0,#buttons-1)*7)/math.max(1,#buttons),46,58)) end
  end
  if animate and not Theme.ReducedMotion() then p.Frame.Position=target+UDim2.fromOffset(14,0) Tween:Create(p.Frame,TweenInfo.new(.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=target}):Play() else p.Frame.Position=target end

 local registered=listeners[action]
 if not registered then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
 local token=input or ("touch:"..action)

  if record and record.action==action then

  return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
 end
 if not self:IsAvailable(action) then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
 if state~=Enum.UserInputState.Begin and not record then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
 if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin and record~=nil then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
 local result=registered.callback(state,input) or Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink

 local record=owners[input]
 if state==Enum.UserInputState.End or state==Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
  if record then owners[input]=nil return record.callback(state,input) or Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  if record==false then owners[input]=nil return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
 end
 if record~=nil then
  if not record then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  if not Router:IsAvailable(record.action) then cancelOwner(input,record) return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  return record.callback(state,input) or Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
 end
 if state~=Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
 local s=Router:Snapshot() local candidates={}
 for action in listeners do
  if (Router:Key(action,"Keyboard")==name or Router:Key(action,"Gamepad")==name) and Router:IsAvailable(action,s) then table.insert(candidates,action) end

 table.sort(candidates,function(a,b) local x,y=Policy.Priority(a)+((listeners[a].overrides or listeners[a].overridePriority) and 1000 or 0),Policy.Priority(b)+((listeners[b].overrides or listeners[b].overridePriority) and 1000 or 0) return x==y and a<b or x>y end)

  local result=Router:Dispatch(action,state,input)
  if result~=Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass then return result end
 end

 -- below it so Tool.Activated/native jump cannot leak through a modal.
 if s.modal or s.suspended then owners[input]=false return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
 return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end
local function bind()
 Router:CancelAll()
 for name in bindings do CAS:UnbindAction("CrossgroundsInput:"..name) end
 table.clear(bindings)
 for action in listeners do
  for _,device in {"Keyboard","Gamepad"} do
   local name=Router:Key(action,device)
   if not bindings[name] then
    bindings[name]=true

     return route(name,state,input)
    end,false,5000,Definition:Input(name))
   end
  end

end

 assert(Definition.Actions[action],"Unknown control: "..tostring(action))

 if previous then
  for token,record in owners do if record and record.action==action then cancelOwner(token,record) end end

 listeners[action]=registered bind()
end

 local s=Router:Snapshot()
 for token,record in owners do
  if record and not Router:IsAvailable(record.action,s) then cancelOwner(token,record) end
 end
 local context=s.suspended and "suspended" or Policy.Context(s)
 if Router.Context~=context then Router.Context=context contextChanged:Fire(context) end
end

local function refreshHealth()

local function bindHealth(character)
 for _,c in healthConnections do c:Disconnect() end table.clear(healthConnections) boundHumanoid=nil
 local function attach(h)
  if not h:IsA("Humanoid") or player.Character~=character then return end
  boundHumanoid=h
  table.insert(healthConnections,h.HealthChanged:Connect(refreshHealth))
  table.insert(healthConnections,h:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MaxHealth"):Connect(refreshHealth))
  refreshHealth()
 end
 if character then
  local h=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if h then attach(h) end
  table.insert(healthConnections,character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child) if not boundHumanoid then attach(child) end end))
 end
 refreshHealth()
end

local InputMode={}
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local changed=Instance.new("BindableEvent") InputMode.Changed=changed.Event
local mode=UIS.PreferredInput
local lastGamepad=-100
InputMode.ActiveGamepad=Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1
local function set(value)
 if value~=mode then mode=value player:SetAttribute("ActiveInput",value.Name) changed:Fire(value) end
end
local function observe(input)
 local key=input.KeyCode local kind=input.UserInputType
 if kind.Name:match("^Gamepad") then
  if key==Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 or key==Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2 then
   local dz=player:GetAttribute(key==Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 and "SettingLeftStickDeadzone" or "SettingRightStickDeadzone") or .1
   if Vector2.new(input.Position.X,input.Position.Y).Magnitude<=math.max(.12,dz+.02) then return end
  elseif input.UserInputState~=Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
  lastGamepad=os.clock() InputMode.ActiveGamepad=kind set(Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad)
 elseif kind==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
  if input.UserInputState==Enum.UserInputState.Begin then set(Enum.PreferredInput.Touch) end
 elseif kind==Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
  -- Thumbstick2Left/Right are synthesized digital directions, not keyboard input.
  if not key.Name:match("^Thumbstick") and input.UserInputState==Enum.UserInputState.Begin then set(Enum.PreferredInput.KeyboardAndMouse) end
 elseif kind==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or kind==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
  if input.UserInputState==Enum.UserInputState.Begin then set(Enum.PreferredInput.KeyboardAndMouse) end
 elseif kind==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
  local p=UIS:GetMouseLocation()
  if input.Delta.Magnitude>1 and p.X>=0 and p.Y>=0 then set(Enum.PreferredInput.KeyboardAndMouse) end
 end
end

  local point=UIS:GetMouseLocation()
  if point.X<0 or point.Y<0 or os.clock()-lastGamepad<.4 then return end
 end
 if value~=Enum.PreferredInput.Touch then set(value) end
end)

      local pivot=Vector3.new(0,joint.C0.Y,joint.C0.Z)
      local delta=CFrame.new(pivot)*Preferences.Transform(bolt.bolt,visualWeight)*CFrame.new(-pivot)
      joint.Transform=joint.C0:Inverse()*delta*joint.C0
     end end
     action.weapon*=bolt.weapon
    end
    local kick=math.exp(-math.max(0,now-shot)*22)
    local pitch=r.character:GetAttribute("CombatAimPitch") or 0
    pose=CFrame.Angles(math.clamp(pitch,-1.15,1.15)*.8,0,0)*pose*action.weapon*reload.weapon*CFrame.new(0,0,kick*.10)*CFrame.Angles(kick*.04,0,0)
    pose=CFrame.Angles(math.clamp(pitch,-1.15,1.15)*.8,0,0)*Preferences.Transform(CFrame.Angles(-math.clamp(pitch,-1.15,1.15)*.8,0,0)*pose,visualWeight)
    mount.Transform=pose desired=torso.CFrame*mount.C0*pose*mount.C1:Inverse()
   end
   if r.right and r.grip and r.grip.Parent then Pose.Solve(r.right,r.grip,desired and desired*CFrame.new(bolt and bolt.hand*Preferences.WeaponWeight(viewer) or Vector3.zero)*r.grip.CFrame) end
   local leftAttachment = r.support
if not leftAttachment or not leftAttachment.Parent then
    -- fallback to muzzle if no support grip
    leftAttachment = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Muzzle")
end
if r.left and leftAttachment and leftAttachment.Parent then
    Pose.Solve(r.left, leftAttachment, desired and desired*CFrame.new(reload and reload.hand*Preferences.WeaponWeight(viewer) or Vector3.zero)*leftAttachment.CFrame*Preferences.Transform(reload and reload.handRotation or CFrame.identity,Preferences.WeaponWeight(viewer)))
end
  end
 end
end)

-- EXEMPLO DE COMPONENTE DE APRESENTAÇÃO (não é um patch pronto do HubController).
-- O pai deve ser o ScrollingFrame largo da tela Jogar, sem UIListLayout antigo.
-- Integração e permissões de entrada permanecem no HubController/HubBridge.
local Presentation = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ModePresentation"))
local Grid = {}
Grid.__index = Grid

local Palette=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MenuTheme")).Settings
local ACCENT=Palette.Accent local WHITE=Palette.Text local MUTED=Palette.Muted local SURFACE=Palette.Surface

local function make(class, parent, name)
    local v = Instance.new(class)
    v.Name = name
    if v:IsA("GuiObject") then v:SetAttribute("CascadeDecoration",true) v.Active=false v.Selectable=false end
    v.Parent = parent
    return v
end

local function rounded(object, radius)
    local corner = make("UICorner", object, "Corner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    return corner
end

local function label(parent, name, value, size, bold)
    local v = make("TextLabel", parent, name)
    v.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    v.ZIndex=4
    v.Text = value
    v.TextColor3 = WHITE
    v.Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    v.TextSize = size
    v.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    v.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    v.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    return v
end

function Grid.new(container, nav, callbacks)
    assert(container:IsA("ScrollingFrame"), "Grade: espera um ScrollingFrame")
    assert(not container:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout"), "Remova UIListLayout antes de criar a grade")

    local self = setmetatable({
        Parent = container,
        Nav = nav,
        Callbacks = callbacks,
        Cards = {},
        Catalog = {},
        Connections = {},
    }, Grid)

    local layout = make("UIGridLayout", container, "ModeGridLayout")
    layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    layout.FillDirectionMaxCells = 2
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
    self.Layout = layout

    for index, modeId in ipairs(Presentation.Order) do
        local config = Presentation.Cards[modeId]
        local card = make("TextButton", container, modeId)
        card.Text = "" card.Active=true
        card.AutoButtonColor = false
        card.BackgroundColor3 = SURFACE
        card.BorderSizePixel = 0
        card.ClipsDescendants = true
        card.LayoutOrder = index
        card:SetAttribute("AccessibleLabel", modeId)
        rounded(card, 12)

        local background = make("ImageLabel", card, "ModeImage")
        background.ZIndex=2
        background.Image = config.Image
        background.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
        background.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        background.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        background.Active = false
        background.Selectable = false

        local scrim = make("Frame", card, "TextScrim")
        scrim.ZIndex=3
        scrim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        scrim.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        scrim.BorderSizePixel = 0
        scrim.Active = false
        scrim.Selectable = false
        local gradient = make("UIGradient", scrim, "BottomFade")
        gradient.Rotation = 90
        gradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.95),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.42, 0.74),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.12),
        })

        local name = label(card, "Name", modeId, 20, true)
        name.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -113)
        name.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 34)
        local subtitle = label(card, "Description", config.Subtitle, 14, false)
        subtitle.TextColor3 = MUTED
        subtitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -78)
        subtitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 36) subtitle.TextWrapped=true subtitle.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.None
        local badge = label(card, "Availability", "Carregando...", 12, true)
        badge.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -40)
        badge.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 25)

        local stroke = make("UIStroke", card, "FocusOutline")
        stroke.Color = ACCENT
        stroke.Thickness = 2
        stroke.Transparency = 1
        stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

        local details=make("TextButton",card,"Details") details.ZIndex=5 details.Text="X · Detalhes" details.TextSize=12 details.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium details.TextColor3=WHITE details.BackgroundTransparency=.3 details.BackgroundColor3=SURFACE details.Position=UDim2.new(1,-125,0,12) details.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(112,32) details.Active=true rounded(details,8) details.Activated:Connect(function() callbacks.Details(modeId) end)
        self.Cards[modeId] = {
            Button = card,
            Background = background,
            Name = name,
            Badge = badge,
            Stroke = stroke,
        }

        nav:Connect(card, function()
            local entry = self.Catalog[modeId]
            if entry and entry.canEnter == true then
                callbacks.Play(modeId)
            else
                -- Indisponíveis recebem foco, mas nunca ingressam na partida.
                -- Use X para ler os detalhes.
            end
        end)
        nav:SetActions(card, {
            custom = function()
                callbacks.Details(modeId)
            end,
        })
    end

    -- Ligação determinística de D-pad na grade 2×2.
    local a = self.Cards
    local order = Presentation.Order
    for i, id in ipairs(order) do
        local button = a[id].Button
        local row = math.floor((i - 1) / 2)
        local col = (i - 1) % 2
        button.NextSelectionLeft = a[order[row * 2 + 1]].Button
        button.NextSelectionRight = a[order[row * 2 + 2]].Button
        button.NextSelectionUp = a[order[col + 1]].Button
        button.NextSelectionDown = a[order[2 + col + 1]].Button
    end

    table.insert(self.Connections, nav.FocusChanged:Connect(function(target)
        for _, card in pairs(self.Cards) do
            card.Stroke.Transparency = card.Button == target and 0 or 1
        end
    end))
    table.insert(self.Connections, container:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
        self:Resize()
    end))
    self:Resize()
    return self
end

function Grid:Update(catalog)
    table.clear(self.Catalog)
    for _, item in ipairs(catalog or {}) do
        self.Catalog[item.id] = item
    end
    for id, card in pairs(self.Cards) do
        local item = self.Catalog[id]
        local enabled = item and item.canEnter == true
        local cfg = Presentation.Cards[id]
        card.Name.Text = item and item.name or ({arena="Arena",ctf="Capture a Bandeira",duels="Duels",get_out="Get Out"})[id]
        card.Badge.Text = enabled and "DISPONÍVEL" or cfg.UnavailableLabel and (cfg.UnavailableLabel.." · INDISPONÍVEL") or
            (item and item.status == "planned" and "EM BREVE" or "INDISPONÍVEL")
        card.Badge.TextColor3 = enabled and Color3.fromRGB(130, 235, 175) or MUTED
        card.Background.ImageTransparency = enabled and 0 or 0.4
        card.Button:SetAttribute("Playable", enabled == true)
    end
end

function Grid:Resize()
    local scale=1 local at=self.Parent while at do local modifier=at:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") if modifier then scale*=modifier.Scale end at=at.Parent end
    local width = self.Parent.AbsoluteSize.X/math.max(.1,scale)
    if width < 1 then return end
    local columns = width >= 460 and 2 or 1
    local gap = 12
    local cardHeight = columns == 2 and math.clamp(width * 0.25, 190, 270) or 190
    self.Layout.FillDirectionMaxCells = columns
    self.Layout.CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / columns, -gap * (columns - 1) / columns, 0, cardHeight)
    local rows = math.ceil(#Presentation.Order / columns)
    for i,id in Presentation.Order do
        local b=self.Cards[id].Button
        if columns==1 then b.NextSelectionUp=self.Cards[Presentation.Order[math.max(1,i-1)]].Button b.NextSelectionDown=self.Cards[Presentation.Order[math.min(4,i+1)]].Button b.NextSelectionLeft=b b.NextSelectionRight=b
        else local row=math.floor((i-1)/2) local col=(i-1)%2 b.NextSelectionLeft=self.Cards[Presentation.Order[row*2+1]].Button b.NextSelectionRight=self.Cards[Presentation.Order[row*2+2]].Button b.NextSelectionUp=self.Cards[Presentation.Order[col+1]].Button b.NextSelectionDown=self.Cards[Presentation.Order[col+3]].Button end
    end
    self.Parent.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, rows * cardHeight + math.max(0, rows - 1) * gap)
    -- Em modo 1 coluna, revisar também os links de D-pad na integração definitiva.
end

function Grid:DefaultFocus()
    return self.Cards.arena.Button
end

function Grid:Destroy()
    for _, connection in ipairs(self.Connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    for _, card in pairs(self.Cards) do
        card.Button:Destroy()
    end
    self.Layout:Destroy()
end

return Grid

ServerScriptService.MainGameScript.GameM:
local FlagService = {}
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")
local Config = require(game.ServerStorage.Configurations)
local Events = game.ReplicatedStorage.Events
local MatchStats=require(game.ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.CTFMatchStats)
local arena = workspace:WaitForChild("CTFInfrastructure")
local flags = {}
local connections = {}
local active = false
local alert=Events:FindFirstChild("CTFFlagAlert") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent") alert.Name="CTFFlagAlert" alert.Parent=Events
local function notify(flag,kind,character)
 local actor=character and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
 local name=actor and actor.DisplayName or character and (character:GetAttribute("BotAlias") or character:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or character.Name) or ""
 for _,viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
  if viewer:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")=="ctf" and viewer:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
   alert:FireClient(viewer,{kind=kind,team=flag.team.Name,carrier=name,self=actor==viewer})
  end
 end
end
local function publish(flag)
 if not flag.base then return end
 flag.base:SetAttribute("FlagState",flag.state)
 local ref=flag.base:FindFirstChild("FlagCarrier") or Instance.new("ObjectValue") ref.Name="FlagCarrier" ref.Value=flag.carrier ref.Parent=flag.base
 local actor=flag.carrier and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(flag.carrier)
 flag.base:SetAttribute("FlagCarrierName",actor and actor.DisplayName or flag.carrier and (flag.carrier:GetAttribute("BotAlias") or flag.carrier:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or flag.carrier.Name) or nil)
 flag.base:SetAttribute("FlagReturnAt",flag.state=="dropped" and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+Config.FLAG_RESPAWN_TIME or 0)
end

local function actorInfo(character)
 if not character or not character:IsA("Model") then return nil end
 local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end
 local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
 if player and player:GetAttribute("InArena") then return player.Team, player, humanoid end
 if character:GetAttribute("CTFBot") then
  return Teams:FindFirstChild(character:GetAttribute("CTFTeam")), nil, humanoid
 end
 return nil
end

local function showFlag(flag, position)
 flag.pole.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0))
 flag.banner.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 1.7))
 flag.pole.Transparency = 0
 flag.banner.Transparency = 0
 flag.hitbox.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
 flag.hitbox.CanTouch = true
end

local function hideFlag(flag)
 flag.pole.Transparency = 1
 flag.banner.Transparency = 1
 flag.hitbox.CanTouch = false
end

local function clearCarry(flag)
 for _,c in flag.carryConnections or {} do c:Disconnect() end flag.carryConnections=nil
 if flag.carryVisual then flag.carryVisual:Destroy() flag.carryVisual = nil end
 if flag.carrier then flag.carrier:SetAttribute("CarryingFlag",nil) end
 flag.carrier = nil
end

function FlagService:Return(flag, silent)
 local wasAway = flag.state ~= "home"
 flag.returnToken += 1
 clearCarry(flag)
 flag.state = "home"
 showFlag(flag, flag.home)
 publish(flag)
 if active and wasAway and not silent then Events.ReturnFlag:Fire(flag.team.TeamColor) notify(flag,"return") end
end

function FlagService:DropCarrier(character)
 for _, flag in pairs(flags) do
  if flag.carrier == character then
   local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local dropAt = root and root.Position or flag.home
   flag.returnToken += 1
   clearCarry(flag)
   flag.state = "dropped"
   notify(flag,"drop",character)
   publish(flag)
   showFlag(flag, Vector3.new(dropAt.X, math.max(dropAt.Y - 3, 13), dropAt.Z))
   local token = flag.returnToken
   task.delay(Config.FLAG_RESPAWN_TIME, function()
    if active and flag.state == "dropped" and token == flag.returnToken then
     self:Return(flag)
    end
   end)
  end
 end
end

local function carryFlag(flag, character, humanoid)
 flag.returnToken += 1
 flag.state = "carried"
 flag.carrier = character
 character:SetAttribute("CarryingFlag",flag.team.Name)
 publish(flag)
 hideFlag(flag)
 notify(flag,"pickup",character)
 local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if root then
  local pole = Instance.new("Part")
  pole.Name = "CarriedFlag"
  pole.Size = Vector3.new(.3, 4.5, .3)
  pole.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
  pole.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 205)
  pole.CanCollide = false
  pole.CanTouch = false
  pole.Massless = true
  pole.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(1.3, 1.8, .7)
  pole.Parent = character
  local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
  weld.Part0 = root weld.Part1 = pole weld.Parent = pole
  local banner = Instance.new("Part")
  banner.Name = "CarriedBanner"
  banner.Size = Vector3.new(.2, 1.7, 1.5)
  banner.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
  banner.Color = flag.banner.Color
  banner.CanCollide = false banner.CanTouch = false banner.Massless = true
  banner.CFrame = pole.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1, .8)
  banner.Parent = pole
  local bannerWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
  bannerWeld.Part0 = pole bannerWeld.Part1 = banner bannerWeld.Parent = banner
  flag.carryVisual = pole
 end
 flag.carryConnections={humanoid.Died:Once(function() FlagService:DropCarrier(character) end),character.Destroying:Once(function() FlagService:DropCarrier(character) end)}
end

function FlagService:TryInteract(character)
 if not active then return end
 local team, player, humanoid = actorInfo(character)
 if not team then return end
 local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root then return end
 local own = flags[team.Name]
 if not own then return end
 local enemy
 for _, flag in pairs(flags) do if flag.team ~= team then enemy = flag break end end
 if not enemy then return end
 local function near(a, b, radius)
  return (Vector3.new(a.X, 0, a.Z) - Vector3.new(b.X, 0, b.Z)).Magnitude <= radius and math.abs(a.Y-b.Y) < 12
 end
 if enemy.carrier == character and near(root.Position, own.home, 7) then
  if not Config.REQUIRE_RETURN_BEFORE_CAP or own.state == "home" then
   if not player then MatchStats.Add(character,"Captures") end
   notify(enemy,"capture",character)
   self:Return(enemy, true)
   Events.CaptureFlag:Fire(player, team.TeamColor)
  end
  return
 end
 if own.state == "dropped" and near(root.Position, own.hitbox.Position, 6) then
  self:Return(own)
 end
 if enemy.state ~= "carried" and near(root.Position, enemy.hitbox.Position, 6) then
  carryFlag(enemy, character, humanoid)
 end
end

function FlagService:GetFlag(teamName)
 return flags[teamName]
end

function FlagService:Initialize()
 for _,c in connections do c:Disconnect() end connections={}
 for _,f in pairs(flags) do f.returnToken+=1 clearCarry(f) end flags={}
 arena=workspace:WaitForChild("CTFInfrastructure")
 for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
  local base = arena:WaitForChild(team.Name .. "Base")
  local stand = base:WaitForChild("FlagStand")
  local hitbox = base:FindFirstChild("FlagHitbox") or Instance.new("Part")
  hitbox.Name = "FlagHitbox"
  hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(7, 6, 7)
  hitbox.Transparency = 1
  hitbox.Anchored = true
  hitbox.CanCollide = false
  hitbox.CanQuery = false
  hitbox.Parent = base
  local flag = {
   base=base, team = team, stand = stand, pole = base.FlagPole, banner = base.FlagBanner,
   hitbox = hitbox, home = Vector3.new(stand.Position.X, stand.Position.Y - .5, stand.Position.Z),
   state = "home", returnToken = 0
  }
  flags[team.Name] = flag
  showFlag(flag, flag.home)
 publish(flag)
  local function touched(part)
   self:TryInteract(part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"))
  end
  table.insert(connections,hitbox.Touched:Connect(touched))
  table.insert(connections,stand.Touched:Connect(touched))
 end
end

function FlagService:StartRound()
 active = true
 for _, flag in pairs(flags) do self:Return(flag) end
end

function FlagService:StopRound()
 active = false
 for _, flag in pairs(flags) do self:Return(flag) end
end

return FlagService

-- Versioned preferences, using the existing store and update remote.
local Service={}
local Players=game:GetService("Players") local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local Definition=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ExperienceSettings) local Controls=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ControlDefinitions)
local Profile=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.PreferenceProfile)
local events=game.ReplicatedStorage.Events local update=events:FindFirstChild("UpdateExperienceSetting") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent",events) update.Name="UpdateExperienceSetting"
local store= not Run:IsStudio() and game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("CTF_ExperienceSettings_v1") or nil
local profiles,dirty,revisions,rate,states,connections={},{},{},{},{},{}
local acknowledgements={}
local Policy=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ControlPolicy)
local Themes=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ThemeCatalog)
local ThemeAccess=require(game.ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.ThemeEntitlements)
local normalize
local scopes={"Global","Mode:ctf","Mode:arena","Device:Keyboard","Device:Gamepad","Device:Touch"}
local function sync(p)
 local profile=profiles[p] if not profile then return end
 if normalize then normalize(p) end
 local state=states[p]
 for key,rule in Definition.Rules do
  local value=Profile.Resolve(profile,key,p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") or "hub")
  p:SetAttribute("Setting"..key,value)
  if state then for _,scope in scopes do if Definition:Allows(key,scope) then state:SetAttribute(Definition:PreferenceAttribute(key,scope),Profile.Container(profile,scope)[key]) end end end
 end
 if state then
  state:SetAttribute("Revision",revisions[p] or 0)
  -- Profile and acknowledgements arrive atomically; separate attribute echoes
  -- cannot roll a newer client draft back to an earlier request.
  state:SetAttribute("Snapshot",game.HttpService:JSONEncode({version=1,revision=revisions[p] or 0,profile=profile,acks=acknowledgements[p] or {}}))
  state:SetAttribute("Ready",true)
 end
end
local function mark(p,scope,key)
 revisions[p]=(revisions[p] or 0)+1 dirty[p]=dirty[p] or {} dirty[p][scope.."|"..key]=revisions[p]
end
local function set(p,scope,key,value,inherit)
 local profile=profiles[p] if not profile then return false end
 if not inherit and value~=Definition.Rules[key].Default and not Themes.CanEdit(key,value,ThemeAccess.Owns(p)) then return false end
 if not Profile.Set(profile,scope,key,value,inherit) then return false end
 mark(p,scope,key) return true
end
local function rebind(p,action,device,name)
 local current={} for id in Controls.Actions do current[id]=Profile.Resolve(profiles[p],Controls:Attribute(id,device),"hub") end
 local plan=Policy.Plan(Controls,current,action,device,name)
 if not plan then return false end
 for id,key in plan do if current[id]~=key then set(p,"Device:"..device,Controls:Attribute(id,device),key) end end
 return true
end

StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts.Weapo:
local Scope=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ModeScope"))
local fireAccumulator = 0
local lastFireTime = 0
local function getFireDelay(data, cfg)
    if cfg then
        return cfg.interval
    end
    return data.Cooldown
end
if not Scope:HasCombatRuntime() then return end
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CAS=game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local events=game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events")
local action=events:WaitForChild("WeaponAction") 
local reload=events:WaitForChild("WeaponReload")
local Stats=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponStats)
local Kits=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("KitDefinitions"))
local Presentation=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CombatPresentation"))
local Router=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ControlRouter"))
local Interaction=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("InteractionController"))
local prediction=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ShotPrediction).new()
local Burst=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.BurstFire)
local burstGeneration=0 local bursting=false
local held=false local nextUse=0 local equipped local shotSequence=0
local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui") gui.Name="WeaponHUD" gui.ResetOnSpawn=false gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true gui.DisplayOrder=19 gui.Parent=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local reticle=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.Reticle).new(gui,"Crosshair")
local cross=reticle.Root
local rangeText=Instance.new("TextLabel") rangeText.Name="RangeBand" rangeText.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0)
rangeText.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(220,22) rangeText.BackgroundTransparency=1 rangeText.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
rangeText.TextSize=12 rangeText.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(223,232,241) rangeText.TextStrokeTransparency=.4 rangeText.Visible=false rangeText.Parent=gui
local function scan()
 local c=player.Character local tool=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
 if tool~=equipped then burstGeneration+=1 bursting=false held=false Presentation:SetFiring(false) Presentation:ClearShots() equipped=tool nextUse=0 end
end
local function canUse()
 local h=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 return equipped and h and h.Health>0 and not Presentation:IsBlocked()
end
local function use()
 if not canUse() or os.clock()<nextUse then return end
 local data=Stats.ResolveTool(equipped) if not data then return end
 if equipped:GetAttribute("Reloading") then return end

local MovementService = {}
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local events = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events")
local toggle = events:FindFirstChild("ToggleSprint") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
toggle.Name = "ToggleSprint"
toggle.Parent = events
local requested=events:FindFirstChild("SetSprint") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent") requested.Name="SetSprint" requested.Parent=events
local states = {}
local MAX_STAMINA = 100
local DRAIN_PER_SECOND = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.SprintDefinitions).DrainPerSecond
local WeaponStats = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.WeaponStats)
local REGEN_PER_SECOND = 15
local REGEN_DELAY = 1

local function stateFor(player)
 local state = states[player]
 if not state then
  state = {stamina=MAX_STAMINA, sprinting=false, lastDrain=0}
  states[player] = state
 end
 return state
end

local function applySpeed(player, state)
 local character = player.Character
 local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
  local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  local data = tool and WeaponStats.ResolveTool(tool)
  local multiplier = data and data.MovementSpeedMultiplier or 1
  humanoid.WalkSpeed = (state.sprinting and (player:GetAttribute("KitSprintSpeed") or 25)
   or (player:GetAttribute("KitWalkSpeed") or 18)) * multiplier
 end
 player:SetAttribute("SprintActive", state.sprinting)
end

function MovementService:ApplyToCharacter(player)
 local state = stateFor(player)
 state.stamina = MAX_STAMINA
 state.sprinting = false
 state.lastDrain = 0
 player:SetAttribute("Stamina", MAX_STAMINA)
 applySpeed(player, state)
end

function MovementService:Reset(player)
 states[player] = nil
 player:SetAttribute("Stamina", MAX_STAMINA)
 player:SetAttribute("SprintActive", false)
end

function MovementService:SetRequested(player,on)
 if (player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") and player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")~="ctf") or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") then return end
 if not player.Character or not (player:GetAttribute("InMatch") or player.Character:GetAttribute("AtLobby")) then return end
 local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
 local state = stateFor(player)
 if on==nil then on=not state.sprinting end
 state.sprinting=on==true and state.stamina>=20
 applySpeed(player, state)
end
toggle.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p) MovementService:SetRequested(p) end)
requested.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(p,on) if typeof(on)=="boolean" then MovementService:SetRequested(p,on) end end)

local elapsed = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 elapsed += dt
 if elapsed < .1 then return end
 local step = elapsed
 elapsed = 0
 for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  local state = states[player]
  if state and player.Character then
   local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
    if state.sprinting and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > .05 then
     state.stamina = math.max(0, state.stamina - DRAIN_PER_SECOND * step)
     state.lastDrain = os.clock()
     if state.stamina <= 0 then state.sprinting = false applySpeed(player, state) end
    elseif os.clock() - state.lastDrain >= REGEN_DELAY then
     state.stamina = math.min(MAX_STAMINA, state.stamina + REGEN_PER_SECOND * step)
    end
    if player:GetAttribute("SlideActive") ~= true then applySpeed(player, state) end
    player:SetAttribute("Stamina", math.floor(state.stamina + .5))
   end
  end
 end
end)

local TeamManager = {}

-- ROBLOX services
local Teams = game.Teams
local Players = game.Players

-- Game services
local Configurations = require(game.ServerStorage.Configurations)
local DisplayManager = require(script.Parent.DisplayManager)

-- Local variables

local TeamPlayers = {}
local TeamScores = {}

-- Initialization

for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
	TeamPlayers[team] = {}
	TeamScores[team] = 0
end

-- Local Functions

local function GetTeamFromColor(teamColor)
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		if team.TeamColor == teamColor then
			return team
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Public Functions

function TeamManager:ClearTeamScores()
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		TeamScores[team] = 0
		DisplayManager:UpdateScore(team, 0)
	end
end

function TeamManager:HasTeamWon()
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		if TeamScores[team] >= Configurations.CAPS_TO_WIN then
			return team
		end
	end
	return false
end

function TeamManager:GetWinningTeam()
	local highestScore = 0
	local winningTeam = nil
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		if TeamScores[team] > highestScore then
			highestScore = TeamScores[team]
			winningTeam = team
		end
	end
	return winningTeam
end

function TeamManager:AreTeamsTied()
	local teams = Teams:GetTeams()
	local highestScore = 0
	local tied = false
	for _, team in ipairs(teams) do
		if TeamScores[team] == highestScore then
			tied = true
		elseif TeamScores[team] > highestScore then
			tied = false
			highestScore = TeamScores[team]
		end
	end
	return tied
end

function TeamManager:AssignPlayerToTeam(player)
	local smallestTeam
	local lowestCount = math.huge
	for team, playerList in pairs(TeamPlayers) do
		if #playerList < 6 and #playerList < lowestCount then
			smallestTeam = team
			lowestCount = #playerList
		end
	end
	if not smallestTeam then return nil end
	table.insert(TeamPlayers[smallestTeam], player)
	player.Neutral = false
	player.TeamColor = smallestTeam.TeamColor
	return smallestTeam
end

function TeamManager:RemovePlayer(player)
	for _, teamTable in pairs(TeamPlayers) do
		for i = #teamTable, 1, -1 do
			if teamTable[i] == player then
				table.remove(teamTable, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function TeamManager:ShuffleTeams()
	for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
		TeamPlayers[team] = {}
	end
	local players = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player:GetAttribute('InMatch') then
			table.insert(players, player)
		end
	end
	while #players > 0 do
		local rIndex = math.random(1, #players)
		local player = table.remove(players, rIndex)
		TeamManager:AssignPlayerToTeam(player)
	end
end

function TeamManager:AddTeamScore(teamColor, score)
	local team = GetTeamFromColor(teamColor)
	TeamScores[team] = TeamScores[team] + score
	DisplayManager:UpdateScore(team, TeamScores[team])
end

return TeamManager

local function actors()

 local bots=workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFBots")
 if bots then for _,b in bots:GetChildren() do table.insert(result,{model=b,team=b:GetAttribute("CTFTeam")}) end end
 return result
end
function Spawn:Choose(team)
 local arena=workspace:WaitForChild("CTFInfrastructure")
 local pads=arena[team.Name.."Base"].Spawns:GetChildren()
 local all=actors()
 local scored={}
 for _,pad in pads do
  local score=math.random()*12
  for _,actor in all do
   local h=actor.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   local r=actor.model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   if h and h.Health>0 and r then
    local d=(r.Position-pad.Position).Magnitude
    if actor.team~=team.Name then
     score+=math.min(d,160)*.1
     if d<65 then score-=(65-d)*5 end
     local params=RaycastParams.new() params.FilterDescendantsInstances={actor.model,pad} params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
     if d<150 and not workspace:Raycast(r.Position,pad.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,0)-r.Position,params) then score-=100 end
    elseif d<9 then score-=90 end
   end
  end
  if os.clock()-(recent[pad] or -100)<4 then score-=75 end
  table.insert(scored,{pad=pad,score=score})
 end
 table.sort(scored,function(a,b) return a.score>b.score end)
 local best=scored[1] and scored[1].pad
 if best then recent[best]=os.clock() end
 return best
end

local ADS=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ADSTransition)
function Sight.new(player)
 local self=setmetatable({rows={}},Sight)
 local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui") gui.Name="OpticalSightHUD" gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true gui.ResetOnSpawn=false gui.DisplayOrder=-20 gui.Enabled=false gui.Parent=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") self.gui=gui
 local reticle=gui:Clone() reticle.Name="OpticalReticle" reticle.DisplayOrder=-9 reticle.Parent=gui.Parent self.reticle=reticle
 local ring=Instance.new('Frame') ring.Name='OcularRing' ring.BackgroundTransparency=1 ring.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5) ring.Parent=reticle self.ring=ring
 Instance.new('UICorner',ring).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
 local edge=Instance.new('UIStroke',ring) edge.Color=Color3.fromRGB(48,54,58) edge.Thickness=5 self.edge=edge
 local function rectangle(parent,name)
  local f=Instance.new("Frame") f.Name=name f.BorderSizePixel=0 f.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new() f.Parent=parent return f
 end
 -- Horizontal slices meet exactly; there are no rotated wedges or radial gaps.
 for i=1,256 do self.rows[i]={rectangle(gui,"PeripheralLeft"),rectangle(gui,"PeripheralRight")} end
 for _,axis in {0,90} do
  local line=rectangle(reticle,"Reticle") line.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5) line.Rotation=axis
  self[axis==0 and "horizontal" or "vertical"]=line
  line.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(205,215,208)
  local outline=Instance.new('UIStroke',line) outline.Thickness=1 outline.Transparency=.45 outline.Color=Color3.new()
 end
 self.dots={}
 local red=rectangle(reticle,"ReflexDot") red.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(4,4) red.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5) red.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,45,35) red.Visible=false Instance.new("UICorner",red).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0) self.red=red
 for i=-4,4 do if i~=0 then for _,axis in {0,1} do
  local dot=rectangle(reticle,"MilDot") dot.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5) dot.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(3,3)
  Instance.new("UICorner",dot).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
  table.insert(self.dots,{part=dot,x=axis==0 and i or 0,y=axis==1 and i or 0})
 end end end
 return self
end
function Sight:Update(profile,viewport,point,progress,aperture,active)
 self.gui.Enabled=profile~=nil self.reticle.Enabled=profile~=nil
 if not profile then return end
 local reflex=profile.reticle=="RedDot"
 self.red.Visible=reflex and active~=false
 for _,p in {self.horizontal,self.vertical} do p.Visible=not reflex end
 for _,dot in self.dots do dot.part.Visible=not reflex end
 if reflex then
  self.gui.Enabled=false self.ring.Visible=false
  self.red.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(point.X,point.Y)
  return
 end
 local transition=ADS.Sample(progress==nil and 1 or progress,profile)
 transition.reticle=active==false and 0 or 1 transition.peripheral=transition.reticle
 self.ring.Visible=not aperture
 self.gui.Enabled=profile~=nil and not aperture
 self.edge.Transparency=1-transition.reticle
 if not aperture then for _,row in self.rows do for _,part in row do part.BackgroundTransparency=1-transition.peripheral end end end
 local opacity=active==false and 0 or (aperture and aperture.visible or transition.reticle)
 for _,part in {self.horizontal,self.vertical} do part.BackgroundTransparency=1-opacity part.BackgroundColor3=aperture and Color3.fromRGB(20,24,23) or Color3.fromRGB(205,215,208) end
 for _,dot in self.dots do dot.part.BackgroundTransparency=1-opacity end
 local radius=aperture and aperture.radius or math.min(viewport.X,viewport.Y)*.36
 if aperture then point=aperture.point end
 self.ring.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(point.X,point.Y) self.ring.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(radius*2,radius*2)
 local key=tostring(viewport)..tostring(point)..tostring(radius)
 if key==self.layoutKey then return end self.layoutKey=key
 if not aperture then for i,row in self.rows do
  local top=math.floor((i-1)*viewport.Y/256) local bottom=math.ceil(i*viewport.Y/256)
  local dy=math.max(math.abs(top-point.Y),math.abs(bottom-point.Y))
  local half=dy<radius and math.sqrt(radius*radius-dy*dy) or 0
  row[1].Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,top) row[1].Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.ceil(point.X-half),bottom-top)
  row[2].Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(point.X+half),top) row[2].Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.ceil(viewport.X-point.X-half),bottom-top)
 end end
 for _,line in {self.horizontal,self.vertical} do line.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(point.X,point.Y) line.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(radius*1.4,1) end
 for _,dot in self.dots do dot.part.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(point.X+dot.x*radius*.11,point.Y+dot.y*radius*.11) end
end
return Sight

local function sendEdits()
 if flushScheduled then return end flushScheduled=true
 task.delay(.08,function()
  flushScheduled=false local sent=0
  for path,request in pending do
   pending[path]=nil remote:FireServer("PreferenceEdit",request) sent+=1
   if flights[path] then flights[path].sent=os.clock() end
   if sent>=3 then break end
  end
  if next(pending) then sendEdits() end
 end)
end
local function retryEdits()
 if retryScheduled then return end retryScheduled=true
 task.delay(1,function()
  retryScheduled=false if not state.Parent then return end
  for path,flight in flights do
   local draft=ledger.drafts[path]
   if not draft or draft.sequence~=flight.request.sequence then flights[path]=nil
   elseif os.clock()-flight.sent>=.9 then pending[path]=flight.request end
  end
  if next(pending) then sendEdits() end
  if next(flights) then retryEdits() end
 end)
end
function Client:Context(key,scope)
 local rule=Definition.Rules[key] return rule.PreferenceDevice and "Device:"..rule.PreferenceDevice or scope or "Global"
end
function Client:Value(key,scope) return ledger:Value(key,self:Context(key,scope)) end
function Client:Refresh()
 local mode=player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") or "hub" local changes=notified notified={}
 local _,explicit=ledger:Stored("ReducedMenuMotion","Global")
 for key,rule in Definition.Rules do
  local scope=rule.PreferenceDevice and "Device:"..rule.PreferenceDevice or rule.ModeOverride and (mode=="ctf" or mode=="arena") and "Mode:"..mode or "Global"
  local value=self:Value(key,scope)
  if key=="ReducedMenuMotion" and not explicit then local ok,native=pcall(function() return Gui.ReducedMotionEnabled end) if ok and native then value=true end end
  if effective[key]~=value then changes[key]=true effective[key]=value end
  if player:GetAttribute("Setting"..key)~=value then player:SetAttribute("Setting"..key,value) end

 if next(changes) then changed:Fire(changes) end
end
local function schedule(key)

 if queued then return end queued=true task.defer(function() queued=false if state.Parent then Client:Refresh() end end)
end
local function snapshot()

 local ok,data=pcall(function() return game.HttpService:JSONDecode(encoded) end) if not ok then return end
 local accepted,changes=ledger:Apply(data) if accepted then
  for key in changes do notified[key]=true end
  for path,flight in flights do local draft=ledger.drafts[path] if not draft or draft.sequence~=flight.request.sequence then flights[path]=nil end end
  schedule()
 end
end
function Client:Edit(key,scope,value,op)
 if not Definition.Rules[key] then return false end
 if (op==nil or op=='set') and not require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.ThemeCatalog).CanEdit(key,value,player:GetAttribute('ThemeCustomAllowed')) then return false end
 if op~=nil and op~="set" and op~="default" and op~="inherit" then return false end
 scope=self:Context(key,scope) if not Definition:Allows(key,scope) then return false end
 if op=="default" then value=Definition.Rules[key].Default end
 local sequence,clean=ledger:Stage(key,scope,value,op=="inherit") if not sequence then return false end
 local path=Drafts.Path(scope,key)
 local request={scope=scope,key=key,op=op or "set",value=clean,sequence=sequence}
 pending[path]=request flights[path]={request=request,sent=os.clock()}

 for key,rule in Definition.Rules do if (category=="All" or rule.Category==category) and Definition:Allows(key,scope) then
  local path=Drafts.Path(scope,key) pending[path]=nil
  local _,clean=ledger:Stage(key,scope,rule.Default,inherit==true,sequence) notified[key]=true
  flights[path]={request={scope=scope,key=key,op=inherit and "inherit" or "default",value=clean,sequence=sequence},sent=os.clock()}

   if not p then MatchStats.Add(killer,"Kills") end
   local xp=p and Progress.CTFKill(p,model:GetAttribute("CTFBot")==true) or 0
   if p and p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Kills") then p.leaderstats.Kills.Value+=1 end
   local data=Kits.Weapons[c.weapon]
   feed:FireAllClients({killerUserId=p and p.UserId,victimUserId=victimPlayer and victimPlayer.UserId,killer=name(killer),victim=name(model),weapon=data and data.Name or c.weapon,killerTeam=killerTeam.Name,victimTeam=team.Name,headshot=c.headshot})
   if victimPlayer then feedback:FireClient(victimPlayer,{kind="Eliminated",character=model,killer=killer,killerName=name(killer),weapon=data and data.Name or c.weapon}) end
   if p then feedback:FireClient(p,{kind="Kill",victim=name(model),weapon=data and data.Name or c.weapon,xp=xp,headshot=c.headshot}) end
  else
   feed:FireAllClients({victimUserId=victimPlayer and victimPlayer.UserId,victim=name(model),victimTeam=team.Name,weapon="Eliminado"})
  end
  credits[h]=nil
end
function Damage:Practice(player,model,amount,weapon,headshot)
 if not model:GetAttribute("PracticeDummy") or not (amount>0 and amount<10000) then return false end
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 local record=practice[model] or {health=200,ready=0} practice[model]=record
 if now<record.ready then return false end
 record.health-=amount
 model:SetAttribute("PracticeMaxHealth",200) model:SetAttribute("PracticeHealth",math.max(0,record.health))
 local data=Kits.Weapons[weapon]
 if record.health<=0 then
  record.ready=now+3 record.health=200 model:SetAttribute("PracticeReadyAt",record.ready)
  local xp=Progress.Kill(player,"training",false)
  feedback:FireClient(player,{kind="Kill",victim="Alvo de treino",weapon=data and data.Name or weapon,xp=xp,training=true,headshot=headshot})
  task.delay(3,function() if model.Parent and practice[model]==record then model:SetAttribute("PracticeHealth",200) model:SetAttribute("PracticeReadyAt",0) end end)
 else feedback:FireClient(player,{kind="Hit",damage=math.floor(amount+.5),headshot=headshot}) end
 return true
end
function Damage:Unwatch(model)
 local h=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") local watch=h and watched[h]
 if watch and h.Health<=0 then self:ResolveDeath(model,h) end
 if watch then watch.stopped=true for _,c in watch.connections do c:Disconnect() end watched[h]=nil end
 if h then credits[h]=nil end
end
function Damage:BreakProtection(model)
 if not model then return end
 model:SetAttribute("SpawnProtectedUntil",0)
 local shield=model:FindFirstChild("SpawnShield")
 if shield then shield:Destroy() end
end
function Damage:Deal(attacker,victim,amount,weapon,headshot)
 if not attacker or not attacker.Parent or not victim or victim.Health<=0 or not (amount>0 and amount<10000) then return false end
 local a=attacker:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local target=victim.Parent
 if not a or a.Health<=0 or not target or self:Team(attacker)==nil or self:Team(target)==nil or self:Team(attacker)==self:Team(target) then return false end
 if (target:GetAttribute("SpawnProtectedUntil") or 0)>workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then return false end
 self:Watch(target)
 credits[victim]={model=attacker,time=os.clock(),weapon=weapon,headshot=headshot}
 local actual=math.min(amount,victim.Health)
 victim:TakeDamage(amount)
 if victim.Health<=0 then self:ResolveDeath(target,victim) end
 local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(attacker)
 if player then
  local root=target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  feedback:FireClient(player,{kind="Hit",damage=math.floor(actual+.5),headshot=headshot,position=root and root.Position})
 end
 return true
end
return Damage

local Bots={}

local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFBots") or Instance.new("Folder",workspace) folder.Name="CTFBots"
local bots={Blue={},Red={}} local respawn={Blue={},Red={}} local active=false local serial=0
local function alive(m) local h=m and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") return m and m.Parent and h and h.Health>0 end
local function create(team,slot)
 serial+=1 local m=template:Clone() m.Name=team.Name.."_AI_"..serial
 m:SetAttribute("CTFBot",true) m:SetAttribute("CTFTeam",team.Name) m:SetAttribute("CTFSlot",slot)
 local role=slot<=2 and "Runner" or slot<=4 and "Soldier" or "Guardian"
 m:SetAttribute("CTFRole",role)
 m.Parent=folder
 local h=m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") h.MaxHealth=300 h.Health=300 h.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.Viewer
 h.NameDisplayDistance=0 h.HealthDisplayDistance=45 h.HealthDisplayType=Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOn
 Avatar:Apply(m,slot+(team.Name=="Red" and 6 or 0),team)
 MatchStats.Attach(m)
 Spawn:Place(m,team)
 local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if root then pcall(function() root:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end) end
 local tool=Factory:Create(role=="Runner" and "SMG" or role=="Soldier" and "Rifle" or "Sniper")
 tool.Parent=m h:EquipTool(tool)
 Damage:Watch(m)
 h.Died:Connect(function()
  Brain:Stop(m) Damage:Unwatch(m)
  Flags:DropCarrier(m) respawn[team.Name][slot]=os.clock()+7+math.random()*2
  task.delay(2.5,function() if m.Parent then m:Destroy() end end)
 end)
 task.spawn(function() Brain:Start(m,team,slot,Flags,function() return active end) end)
 return m
end
function Bots:Reconcile()
 if not active then return end
 for _,team in Teams:GetTeams() do
  local list=bots[team.Name] local humans=0
  for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do if p:GetAttribute("InMatch") and p.Team==team then humans+=1 end end
  local needed=math.max(0,6-humans)
  for slot=6,needed+1,-1 do if list[slot] then MatchStats.Remove(list[slot]) Flags:DropCarrier(list[slot]) Brain:Stop(list[slot]) Damage:Unwatch(list[slot]) list[slot]:Destroy() list[slot]=nil respawn[team.Name][slot]=0 end end
  for slot=1,needed do
   if not alive(list[slot]) and os.clock()>=(respawn[team.Name][slot] or 0) then
    if list[slot] then Brain:Stop(list[slot]) Damage:Unwatch(list[slot]) list[slot]:Destroy() end
    list[slot]=create(team,slot)
   end
  end
 end

 active=false
 for _,list in pairs(bots) do for slot=1,6 do if list[slot] then Flags:DropCarrier(list[slot]) Brain:Stop(list[slot]) Damage:Unwatch(list[slot]) list[slot]:Destroy() list[slot]=nil end end end
end

 if (player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") and player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")~="ctf") or player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsTransition") then return end
 local c=player.Character local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not h or h.Health<=0 or not (player:GetAttribute("InArena") or c:GetAttribute("AtLobby")) then return end

 local weapons=require(game.ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.ArsenalLoadouts).Backends(player) or profile and profile.Weapons
 if not weapons or not table.find(weapons,id) then return end
 return c,Stats.ResolveTool(tool) or definitions.Weapons[id],id
end
local function rayParams(character)
 local p=RaycastParams.new() p.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude p.FilterDescendantsInstances={character} return p
end
local function deal(player,character,part,data,id,distance,multiplier)
 local model=Damage:ModelFromPart(part)
 local h=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not h then return false end
 if character:GetAttribute("AtLobby") then
  if model:GetAttribute("PracticeDummy") then
   local headshot=data.Kind=="Gun" and part.Name=="Head"
   local amount=data.Kind=="Gun" and definitions.ShotDamage(data,distance,headshot,multiplier) or data.Damage
   return Damage:Practice(player,model,amount,id,headshot)
  end

 end
 local headshot=data.Kind=="Gun" and part.Name=="Head"
