 return Damage:Deal(character,h,damage,id,headshot)
end
local function melee(player,character,tool,data,id)
 local root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") local blade=tool:FindFirstChild("Hitbox")
 if not root or not blade then return end
 local base=tool:GetAttribute("RestGrip") or tool.Grip local hit={} local count=0
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new() overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
 local duration=math.min(data.Cooldown,data.Windup+data.ActiveTime+.12) local start=os.clock()
 tool:SetAttribute("Attacking",true)
 local trail=blade:FindFirstChildOfClass("Trail")
 task.spawn(function()
  local previous=blade.CFrame
  while tool.Parent==character and os.clock()-start<duration do
   local t=os.clock()-start
   local swing=math.clamp((t-data.Windup)/data.ActiveTime,0,1)
   tool.Grip=base*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(20+115*swing),0,math.rad(45-90*swing))
   local active=t>=data.Windup and t<=data.Windup+data.ActiveTime
   if trail then trail.Enabled=active end
   if active then
    local current=blade.CFrame
    for sample=1,3 do
     local cf=previous:Lerp(current,sample/3)
     for _,part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf,blade.Size+Vector3.new(.3,.3,.3),overlap) do
      local model=Damage:ModelFromPart(part)
      local h=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local targetRoot=model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if h and targetRoot and not hit[h] and (data.Kind=="MeleeArea" or count==0) and (targetRoot.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<=data.Range+2 then
       local obstruction=workspace:Raycast(root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1,0),part.Position-root.Position-Vector3.new(0,1,0),rayParams(character))
       if not obstruction or obstruction.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model) then
        if deal(player,character,part,data,id,0) then hit[h]=true count+=1 end
       end
      end
     end
    end
    previous=current
   else previous=blade.CFrame end
   RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
  end
  if tool.Parent then tool.Grip=base tool:SetAttribute("Attacking",false) end
  if trail then trail.Enabled=false end
 end)
end
local function startReload(player,tool,data)
 if data.Kind~="Gun" or tool:GetAttribute("Reloading") then return end
 local ammo=tool:GetAttribute("Ammo") or 0 local reserve=tool:GetAttribute("ReserveAmmo") or 0
 if ammo>=data.Magazine or reserve<=0 then return end
 tool:SetAttribute("ReloadWasEmpty",ammo<=0)
 tool:SetAttribute("Reloading",true) tool:SetAttribute("ReloadStartedAt",workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) tool:SetAttribute("ReloadDuration",data.ReloadTime)
 local sound=tool.Handle:FindFirstChild("ReloadSound") if sound then sound:Play() end
 task.delay(data.ReloadTime,function()
  local c=player.Character local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not player.Parent or not h or h.Health<=0 or not tool:IsDescendantOf(player) and tool.Parent~=c then
   if tool.Parent then tool:SetAttribute("Reloading",false) end return
  end

 end)

-- number macro item

local item = {}

local utilFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Util
local parametricEval = require(utilFolder.ParametricEval)


function item:New(itemContainer, macroItem, pluginSettings, updatePluginSettings)
	itemContainer.TextLabel.Text = macroItem.Text
	local fieldX, fieldY, fieldZ = itemContainer.Field.X, itemContainer.Field.Y, itemContainer.Field.Z
	
	local function updateDisplay()
		fieldX.Text = macroItem.Value.X
		fieldY.Text = macroItem.Value.Y
		fieldZ.Text = macroItem.Value.Z
	end
	
	local function valueSet(newValue)
		local oldValue = macroItem.Value
		macroItem.Value = newValue
		pluginSettings[macroItem.SettingId] = newValue
		updatePluginSettings()
		updateDisplay()
		if type(macroItem.Changed) == "function" then
			macroItem:Changed(newValue, oldValue)
		end
	end

	function macroItem:Set(value)
		valueSet(value)
	end
	
	function macroItem:UpdateText(text)
		itemContainer.TextLabel.Text = text
	end
	
	local function focusLost(enterPressed)
		if enterPressed then
			local x, y, z = parametricEval(fieldX.Text), parametricEval(fieldY.Text), parametricEval(fieldZ.Text)
			if x and y and z then
				valueSet(Vector3.new(x, y, z))
			else
				updateDisplay()
			end
		else
			updateDisplay()
		end
	end
	
	fieldX.FocusLost:Connect(focusLost)
	fieldY.FocusLost:Connect(focusLost)
	fieldZ.FocusLost:Connect(focusLost)
	updateDisplay()	
	
	
	--function macroItem:LoadSetting(storedSetting)
	--	macroItem.Value = Vector3.new(storedSetting[1], storedSetting[2], storedSetting[3])
	--end
	
	function macroItem:UpdateTheme(theme)
		itemContainer.TextLabel.TextColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.SubText)

		fieldZ.TextColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.MainText)
		fieldZ.BackgroundColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.InputFieldBackground)

end

-- Evaluate a string from a parametric input box and return a number.
-- Expressions are sandboxed with access to standard Lua math functions.

-- By Fractality

local parametricEval do
	local envTemplate = {
		abs = math.abs,
		acos = math.acos,
		asin = math.asin,
		atan = math.atan,
		atan2 = math.atan2,
		ceil = math.ceil,
		cos = math.cos,
		cosh = math.cosh,
		deg = math.deg,
		exp = math.exp,
		floor = math.floor,
		fmod = math.fmod,
		frexp = math.frexp,
		huge = math.huge,
		ldexp = math.ldexp,
		log = math.log,
		log10 = math.log10,
		max = math.max,
		min = math.min,
		modf = math.modf,
		pow = math.pow,
		rad = math.rad,
		random = math.random,
		sin = math.sin,
		sinh = math.sinh,
		sqrt = math.sqrt,
		tan = math.tan,
		tanh = math.tanh,
		pi = math.pi,
		tau = 2*math.pi,
		e = math.exp(1),
		phi = (math.sqrt(5) + 1)/2,
	}
	
	local envMt = {
		__metatable = false,
		__index = function(_, k)
			warn(tostring(k) .. ' is undefined')
		end,
	}
	
	local function parse(str, env)
		local f = loadstring(('return (%s)'):format(str))
		if f then
			setfenv(f, env)
			local s, ret = pcall(f)
			if s then
				return ret
			end
		end
		warn('Evaluation failed')
	end
	
	function parametricEval(str)
		local ret = tonumber(str)
		if ret then
			return ret
		else
			local env = {}
			for k, v in next, envTemplate do
				env[k] = v
			end
			local parseResult = parse(str, setmetatable(env, envMt))
			if parseResult and tonumber(parseResult) then
				return tonumber(parseResult)
			elseif ret ~= nil then
				warn('Evaluation output is not a number')
			end
		end
	end
end

return parametricEval

ServerStorage.MACRO_PLUGIN.MacroItemClas:
-- boolean macro item
local item = {}


function item:New(itemContainer, macroItem, pluginSettings, updatePluginSettings)
	itemContainer.TextLabel.Text = macroItem.Text
	local box = itemContainer.Box
	
	local function updateDisplay()
		box.Text = macroItem.Value and "✓" or ""
	end
	
	local function valueSet(newValue)
		local oldValue = macroItem.Value
		macroItem.Value = newValue
		pluginSettings[macroItem.SettingId] = newValue
		updatePluginSettings()
		updateDisplay()
		if type(macroItem.Changed) == "function" then
			macroItem:Changed(newValue, oldValue)
		end
	end

	function macroItem:Set(value)
		valueSet(value)
	end
	
	function macroItem:UpdateText(text)
		itemContainer.TextLabel.Text = text
	end
	
	local function buttonClick()
		valueSet(not macroItem.Value)
	end
	
	box.MouseButton1Click:Connect(buttonClick)
	updateDisplay()	
	
	function macroItem:UpdateTheme(theme)
		itemContainer.TextLabel.TextColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.SubText)
		box.TextColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.MainText)
		box.BackgroundColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.InputFieldBackground)
	end
end

return item

  local copy=p:Clone()
  for _,v in copy:GetDescendants() do if not v:IsA("DataModelMesh") and not v:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") and not v:IsA("Decal") and not v:IsA("Texture") then v:Destroy() end end

-- number macro item

local item = {}

local utilFolder = script.Parent.Parent.Util
local parametricEval = require(utilFolder.ParametricEval)

function item:New(itemContainer, macroItem, pluginSettings, updatePluginSettings)
	itemContainer.TextLabel.Text = macroItem.Text
	local field = itemContainer.Field
	
	local function updateDisplay()
		field.Text = macroItem.Value
	end
	
	local function valueSet(newValue)
		local oldValue = macroItem.Value
		macroItem.Value = newValue
		pluginSettings[macroItem.SettingId] = newValue
		updatePluginSettings()
		updateDisplay()
		if type(macroItem.Changed) == "function" then
			macroItem:Changed(newValue, oldValue)
		end
	end

	function macroItem:Set(value)
		valueSet(value)
	end
	
	function macroItem:UpdateText(text)
		itemContainer.TextLabel.Text = text
	end
	
	local function focusLost(enterPressed)
		if enterPressed then
			local number = parametricEval(field.Text)
			if number then
				valueSet(number)
			else
				updateDisplay()
			end
		else
			updateDisplay()
		end
	end
	
	field.FocusLost:Connect(focusLost)
	updateDisplay()	
	
	function macroItem:UpdateTheme(theme)
		itemContainer.TextLabel.TextColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.SubText)
		field.TextColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.MainText)
		field.BackgroundColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.InputFieldBackground)
	end
end

return item

local function melee(player,character,tool,data,id)

 local duration=math.min(data.Cooldown,data.Windup+data.ActiveTime+.12) local start=os.clock()

  local previous=blade.CFrame

   local t=os.clock()-start
   local swing=math.clamp((t-data.Windup)/data.ActiveTime,0,1)
   tool.Grip=base*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(20+115*swing),0,math.rad(45-90*swing))
   local active=t>=data.Windup and t<=data.Windup+data.ActiveTime
   if trail then trail.Enabled=active end

    local current=blade.CFrame

     local cf=previous:Lerp(current,sample/3)
     for _,part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf,blade.Size+Vector3.new(.3,.3,.3),overlap) do
      local model=Damage:ModelFromPart(part)
      local h=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local targetRoot=model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    end

-- string macro item

local item = {}

function item:New(itemContainer, macroItem, pluginSettings, updatePluginSettings)
	itemContainer.TextLabel.Text = macroItem.Text
	local field = itemContainer.Field
	
	local function updateDisplay()
		field.Text = macroItem.Value
	end
	
	local function valueSet(newValue)
		local oldValue = macroItem.Value
		macroItem.Value = newValue
		pluginSettings[macroItem.SettingId] = newValue
		updatePluginSettings()
		updateDisplay()
		if type(macroItem.Changed) == "function" then
			macroItem:Changed(newValue, oldValue)
		end
	end

	function macroItem:Set(value)
		valueSet(value)
	end
	
	function macroItem:UpdateText(text)
		itemContainer.TextLabel.Text = text
	end
	
	local function focusLost(enterPressed)
		if enterPressed then
			valueSet(field.Text)
		else
			updateDisplay()
		end
	end
	
	field.FocusLost:Connect(focusLost)
	updateDisplay()	
	
	function macroItem:UpdateTheme(theme)
		itemContainer.TextLabel.TextColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.SubText)
		field.TextColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.MainText)
		field.BackgroundColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.InputFieldBackground)
	end
end

return item

-- button macro item
local changeHistoryService = game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService")

local item = {}

function item:New(itemContainer, macroItem, pluginSettings, updatePluginSettings)
	itemContainer.Button.Text = macroItem.Text
	
	local debounce = false
	
	local function buttonClicked()
		if debounce then
			return
		end
		debounce = true
		changeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Macro button preactivate")
		macroItem:Activate()
		changeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Macro button postactivate")
		debounce = false
	end
	
	function macroItem:UpdateText(text)
		itemContainer.Button.Text = text
	end
	
	itemContainer.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(buttonClicked)
	
	function macroItem:UpdateTheme(theme)
		itemContainer.Button.TextColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.MainText)
		itemContainer.Button.BackgroundColor3 = theme:GetColor(Enum.StudioStyleGuideColor.Button)
	end
end

return item

local module = {}

function module:Generate(radius, width, height, sides)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Ring"
	
	local part_len =  math.tan(math.pi / sides) * radius * 2
	
	for i = 1,sides do
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Anchored = true
		part.FormFactor = "Custom"
		part.Size = Vector3.new(width,height,part_len)
		part.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi*2/sides*i,0) * CFrame.new(radius - width/2, width*2,0)
		part.Parent = model
	end	

	model.Parent = workspace
	return model
end

return module

function Config.Validate(id,value,playable)
 local weapon=Catalog.Get(id)
 if not weapon or playable and not weapon.combatId or typeof(value)~="table" then return nil,"Arma indisponível." end
 local clean={} local count=0
 for slot,attachmentId in value do
  count+=1 if count>Config.MaxAttachments or typeof(slot)~="string" or typeof(attachmentId)~="string" then return nil,"Configuração inválida." end
  local a=Attachments[attachmentId]
  if not a or a.status~="Available" or a.slot~=slot or not table.find(a.compatible or {},id) or not table.find(weapon.slots,slot) then return nil,"Acessório incompatível." end
  clean[slot]=attachmentId
 end
 return clean
end
function Config.Loadout(value)
 if typeof(value)~="table" or typeof(value.name)~="string" or #value.name==0 or #value.name>80 or not utf8.len(value.name) or utf8.len(value.name)>32 or value.name:find("%c") then return nil,"Nome inválido." end
 local primary=Catalog.Get(value.primaryWeaponId) local secondary=Catalog.Get(value.secondaryWeaponId)
 if not primary or primary.category=="PISTOLS" or not secondary or secondary.category~="PISTOLS" then return nil,"Escolha uma primária e uma pistola." end
 local p,err=Config.Validate(primary.id,value.primaryAttachments or {},true) if not p then return nil,err end
 local s,why=Config.Validate(secondary.id,value.secondaryAttachments or {},true) if not s then return nil,why end
 local melee=value.meleeWeaponId or "Sword" local data=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.KitDefinitions).Weapons[melee]
 if not data or data.Kind=="Gun" then return nil,"Corpo a corpo inválido." end
 return {name=value.name,primaryWeaponId=primary.id,secondaryWeaponId=secondary.id,meleeWeaponId=melee,primaryAttachments=p,secondaryAttachments=s}
end

-- Adaptação de compatibilidade: armas do núcleo legado são adicionadas dinamicamente.
-- Mantém o comportamento original para cada nova arma do KitDefinitions.
for id, data in Kits.Weapons do
    if data.Kind == "Gun" and id ~= "ArenaPistol" and not Catalog.Weapons[id] then
        local key = "legacy_" .. id
        Catalog.Weapons[key] = {
            id = key,
            name = data.Name,
            category = "LEGACY",
            family = id,
            sourcePack = "Crossgrounds",
            status = "Playable",
            combatId = id,
            assetId = id,
            slots = {},
            publicationBlocked = false,
        }
    end
end

-- Compatibilidade com IDs e categorias já utilizados pelo menu.
Catalog.Weapons.legacy_Shotgun725.supersededBy = "725"
Catalog.Weapons.combat_knife.category = "MELEE"
Catalog.Weapons.combat_knife.sourceCategory = "SPECIAL"

function Catalog.Get(id)
    return Catalog.Weapons[id]
end

function Catalog.List(slot)
    local out = {}
    for _, weapon in Catalog.Weapons do
        if not weapon.supersededBy and (
            (slot == "secondary" and weapon.category == "PISTOLS")
            or (slot == "melee" and weapon.category == "MELEE")
            or (slot == "primary" and weapon.category ~= "PISTOLS" and weapon.category ~= "MELEE")
        ) then
            table.insert(out, weapon)
        end
    end
    table.sort(out, function(a, b)
        return a.name < b.name
    end)
    return out
end

-- Shared, deterministic control policy. No services: safe to exercise in isolation.
local Policy={}
local combat={"ctf","arena"}
local world={"ctf","arena","survivor","hacking","beast","waiting","hub","admin"}
Policy.Contexts={
 Fire=combat,Aim=combat,Sprint=combat,Perspective=combat,SwitchWeapon=combat,ShiftLock=combat,Shoulder=combat,
 Jump=combat,ReloadInteract={"ctf","survivor","beast"},
 Menu={"ctf","arena","survivor","hacking","beast","waiting","hub","admin","menu"},
 KitMenu={"ctf"},VoteMenu={"ctf","arena"},Leave={"ctf","arena","survivor","hacking","beast","waiting"},
 AdminMode=world,AdminSpeedUp={"admin"},AdminSpeedDown={"admin"},AdminPreviousMap={"admin"},AdminNextMap={"admin"},AdminClean={"admin"},
 GetOutCrawl={"survivor"},GetOutAttack={"beast"},GetOutDrop={"beast"},GetOutCheck={"hacking"},GetOutHacker={"beast"},
 MenuPrevious={"menu"},MenuNext={"menu"},
}
function Policy.Context(s)
 if s.modal then return "menu" end
 if s.admin then return "admin" end
 if s.mode=="get_out" then
  if not s.alive or s.result and s.result~="active" then return "waiting" end
  if s.role=="beast" then return "beast" end
  if s.role=="survivor" then return s.hacking and "hacking" or "survivor" end
  return "waiting"
 end
 return s.mode
end
function Policy.Conflicts(a,b)
 local first,second=Policy.Contexts[a],Policy.Contexts[b]
 if not first or not second then return true end
 for _,context in first do if table.find(second,context) then return true end end
 return false
end
function Policy.Available(action,s)
 if s.suspended then return false,"suspended" end
 local context=Policy.Context(s)
 if not table.find(Policy.Contexts[action] or {},context) then return false,"context:"..tostring(context) end
 if action:match("^Admin") and not s.authorized then return false,"permission" end
 if action=="Menu" and s.modal and not s.settingsMenu then return false,"another-menu" end
 if action=="AdminMode" and (s.inMatch or s.mode=="arena" and s.arenaPlaying) and not s.admin then return false,"in-match" end
 if action=="GetOutCrawl" and s.victim~="Active" and s.victim~="Crawling" then return false,"victim" end
 if action=="GetOutDrop" and not s.dragging then return false,"no-victim" end
 if context=="ctf" or context=="arena" then
  if action~="Menu" and action~="KitMenu" and action~="VoteMenu" and action~="Leave" and action~="AdminMode" then
   if not s.alive or s.spectating or context=="ctf" and not s.inMatch or context=="arena" and not s.arenaPlaying then return false,"inactive" end
  end
 end
 return true
end
function Policy.Resolve(actions,s)
 local winner
 for _,action in actions do
  if Policy.Available(action,s) and (not winner or Policy.Priority(action)>Policy.Priority(winner) or Policy.Priority(action)==Policy.Priority(winner) and action<winner) then winner=action end
 end
 return winner
end
function Policy.Priority(action)
 if action=="MenuPrevious" or action=="MenuNext" then return 800 end
 if action=="Menu" then return 700 end
 if action=="AdminMode" then return 600 end
 if action:match("^Admin") then return 500 end
 return 100
end
-- Reassign every overlapping action, then verify the entire graph before committing.
-- Incompatible legacy profiles fail without partially changing any binding.
function Policy.Plan(definitions,bindings,action,device,name)
 if not definitions.Actions[action] or not definitions:IsAllowed(device,name,action) then return nil,"invalid" end
 local plan=table.clone(bindings) local old=plan[action] plan[action]=name
 local affected={[action]=true}
 for other in definitions.Actions do
  if other~=action and Policy.Conflicts(action,other) and plan[other]==name then
   if not definitions:IsAllowed(device,old,other) then return nil,"reserved" end
   plan[other]=old affected[other]=true
  end
 end
 for first in definitions.Actions do
  for second in definitions.Actions do
   if first<second and (affected[first] or affected[second]) and plan[first]==plan[second] and Policy.Conflicts(first,second) then return nil,"conflict" end
  end
 end
 return plan
end
function Policy.Normalize(definitions,bindings,device)
 local result={} local order={}
 for action in definitions.Actions do table.insert(order,action) end
 table.sort(order,function(a,b) local x,y=Policy.Priority(a),Policy.Priority(b) return x==y and a<b or x>y end)
 local function free(action,key)
  if not definitions:IsAllowed(device,key,action) then return false end
  for other,value in result do if value==key and Policy.Conflicts(action,other) then return false end end
  return true
 end
 for _,action in order do
  local key=bindings[action]
  if not free(action,key) then
   local candidates={definitions.Actions[action][device]}
   if device=="Gamepad" then for _,value in definitions.GamepadKeys do table.insert(candidates,value) end
   else for _,value in {"F8","F9","F10","F11","F12","Z","X","C","B","N","H","J","U","I","O","P","T","Y","Equals","Minus","LeftBracket","RightBracket"} do table.insert(candidates,value) end end
   key=nil for _,candidate in candidates do if free(action,candidate) then key=candidate break end end
  end
  if not key then return nil,"no-free-binding:"..action end
  result[action]=key
 end
 return result
end
return Policy

  return record.callback(state,input) or Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink

 if state~=Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
 local s=Router:Snapshot() local candidates={}
 for action in listeners do
  if (Router:Key(action,"Keyboard")==name or Router:Key(action,"Gamepad")==name) and Router:IsAvailable(action,s) then table.insert(candidates,action) end
 end
 table.sort(candidates,function(a,b) local x,y=Policy.Priority(a),Policy.Priority(b) return x==y and a<b or x>y end)
 for _,action in candidates do
  local result=Router:Dispatch(action,state,input)
  if result~=Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass then return result end
 end
 -- UI navigation owns its own keys at a higher priority. Swallow world buttons
 -- below it so Tool.Activated/native jump cannot leak through a modal.
 if s.modal or s.suspended then owners[input]=false return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
 return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end
local function bind()
 Router:CancelAll()
 for name in bindings do CAS:UnbindAction("CrossgroundsInput:"..name) end
 table.clear(bindings)
 for action in listeners do
  for _,device in {"Keyboard","Gamepad"} do
   local name=Router:Key(action,device)
   if not bindings[name] then
    bindings[name]=true
    CAS:BindActionAtPriority("CrossgroundsInput:"..name,function(_,state,input)
     return route(name,state,input)
    end,false,5000,Definition:Input(name))
   end
  end
 end
end
function Router:Register(action,callback,options)
 assert(Definition.Actions[action],"Unknown control: "..tostring(action))
 local previous=listeners[action]
 if previous then
  for token,record in owners do if record and record.action==action then cancelOwner(token,record) end end
 end
 local registered=table.clone(options or {}) registered.callback=callback
 listeners[action]=registered bind()
end
local function reconcile()
 local s=Router:Snapshot()
 for token,record in owners do
  if record and not Router:IsAvailable(record.action,s) then cancelOwner(token,record) end
 end
 local context=s.suspended and "suspended" or Policy.Context(s)
 if Router.Context~=context then Router.Context=context contextChanged:Fire(context) end
end

function Router:Commit(action,device,name)
 local current={} for id in Definition.Actions do current[id]=self:Key(id,device) end
 local plan,reason=Policy.Plan(Definition,current,action,device,name)
 if not plan then return false,reason end
 self:CancelAll()
 for id,value in plan do if value~=current[id] then player:SetAttribute("Setting"..Definition:Attribute(id,device),value) end end
 update:FireServer(Definition:Attribute(action,device),name)
 return true
end
local function finish(success,name)
 if not capture then return end
 local request=capture capture=nil player:SetAttribute("Rebinding",false)
 if success then success=Router:Commit(request.action,request.device,name) end
 captureChanged:Fire(false,success and "Controle atualizado. Atalhos em conflito foram trocados." or "Controle não aplicado. Conflito ou captura cancelada; o anterior foi mantido.")
 local completedGeneration=generation
 task.delay(.15,function() if not capture and generation==completedGeneration then CAS:UnbindAction("CTFCaptureBinding") end end)
end
function Router:Capture(action,device)
 if capture or not Definition.Actions[action] or (device~="Keyboard" and device~="Gamepad") then return end
 Router:CancelAll()
 generation+=1 local token=generation
 capture={action=action,device=device,ready=os.clock()+.2,deadline=os.clock()+5}
 player:SetAttribute("Rebinding",true)
 local inputs={Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3}
 for _,key in Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems() do if key~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then table.insert(inputs,key) end end
 CAS:BindActionAtPriority("CTFCaptureBinding",function(_,state,input)
  if not capture then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
  if state==Enum.UserInputState.Begin and os.clock()>=capture.ready then
   if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB and capture.device=="Keyboard" then finish(false) return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end
   local name=input.KeyCode.Name
   if input.UserInputType.Name:match("^MouseButton") then name=input.UserInputType.Name end
   if Definition:IsAllowed(capture.device,name,capture.action) then finish(true,name) end
  end
  return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
 end,false,10000,table.unpack(inputs))
 captureChanged:Fire(true,Definition.Actions[action].Label)
 task.delay(5,function() if token==generation then finish(false) end end)
end
function Router:CaptureRemaining() return capture and math.max(0,math.ceil(capture.deadline-os.clock())) or 0 end
function Router:Reset(deviceOnly)
 self:CancelAll()
 for action,data in pairs(Definition.Actions) do
  for _,device in {"Gamepad","Keyboard"} do if not deviceOnly or deviceOnly==device then player:SetAttribute("Setting"..Definition:Attribute(action,device),data[device]) end end
 end
 update:FireServer("ResetControls",deviceOnly or true)
end

  for field,number in value do

   local valid=Definition:Sanitize(field,number) if valid==nil then return end clean[field]=valid
  end
  if count~=expected then return end for field,number in clean do set(p,"Device:Touch",field,number) end

  if rule.Device then
   if not rebind(p,rule.Action,rule.Device,clean) then return end
  else set(p,scope,key,clean) end
 end
